tei:div.tei:p: badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje'i snying po las: che mchogardo rje khro bo lod nyu sgrub thig le'irgya can gyi sgrub pa'i wan thabs zab mo bzhugs so:

bsgo/ cha na mo gu ru pad+ma kar ye 1khu11thargyad rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snya tig gdams pa zab pa'i skor byin rlabs khyad par 'pha gas pa'i chos che mchog rdo rje khro bo lod chung ba ltar rdzogs pa sa lhan thabs snying ga bang mdzod bstan sa ma yu de mang spyor ba gsum gyi rim maṇ+ḍal gzhung bzhin bkod pa dang phya nang gsang ba' rdzas rnams bsags dam rgya bcad nas bde ba'i stan sa bzung blo sems bag pheb nas sgos bsregs dad pa'i dpa' bskyed nas dang po rdor drilabyan masani rdo rje bsor la 'di skad gyer oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ྅: mtshan ma rdzas kyi rdo rje stong pa'i ngang snang cha ma 'gags thabs kyi rdo rjer bzhengs: yar gyi rwa lnga yab lnga mar lnga yum: yas pad sems dpa' ma'i pad sems mar rdzogs: lte ba zlum po chos dbyings kun tu bzang: yar la bsor bas srid pa zil gyis gnon: 'og mar gdengs bas sa gsum drungs nas 'byen bde gshegs thugs kyi rdo rje e ma ho: de nas dril bu bsten byas la o dz+nyā na tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma yu hūṃ sum̐ snang ba dzos kyi dril bu stong par gyur: mi dmigs shes rab stong pa dril bur sad: yar rtse rwa lnga ye shes lnga ru bzhugs: pad+ma 'dab brgyad spros mtha' brgyad bral mtshon rigs kyi

ba:tshu zhal ni rnam par snang mdzad dpal: srog zhu rnam lnga sku dang rigs kyi dal: pho brang zlum po nam mkha' rnam par dag thig le'i mdzes pa stong pa'i 'odagasal mtshon drwa ba drwa byed rdo rje lu gu rgyud: badz+ra phreng ba gzung 'dzin bcom pa'i brda: gsung dbyangs grags stong na das 'khor ba stong ma rig mal dub 'gro kun chos skurasad: thabs shes dbyer med zung 'jug ma brten par: mthar phyin 'bras bus khyab brdal thob mi srid: yang dag snang stong sbyor ba'i lam la brten:skye badz+ra garnye dharmā hūṃ a: denas thod rnga byan rlabs ni mtshan bcas thod rnga mi dmigs stong par sbyangs: grags stong zung 'jug bcu drug ltag sprod gyur: ma 'gags zang thal skye med dpa' bo'i brda: a ra lidang pho gyi rang sgra ldir: ngo bo chos dbyings kun bzang yab yum rdzogs: rnam pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bzhugs pa'i gnas: gnyis med dag mnyam 'khor ba'i gnyen por shar hūṃ badz+ra tsit+ta badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra e a ra li dz+nyā na phe po : de nas rnga za byin rlabs ni rnga chen mi dmigs stong dbyings rol pa las grags stong zung 'jug ye shes gsang ba'i rdzas ma

'gags che mchog yab yum bzhugs pa'i gnas: raja gdangs brjod med gsang sngags sgra chen sbir: rgyud dang sgrub sde'i khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor rdzogs: sa gsum g.yo zhing srid pa chos skur bshig: skye med rgyal ba'i rang sgra rmad byung shar: yo badz+ra kro dha ma hā gri he ru ka hūm̐ sa ma ya pho tisgo badz+ra: de nas rol mo byin rlabs ni ā rol mo sil snyan stong pa nyid du gyur: sgra grags rang bzhin ye shes chen po'i gdangs: ngo bo don grub yab yum rdzogs pa'i gnas: rang gdangs ha te sgrogs pa'i skad snyan 'byed bde gshegs ma lus bzhugs pa'i da lar rdzogs: snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod: ma rig dub pa'i 'gro kun bag chags bsgral: rang byung ye shes rol mo'i rnam par shar: ha pra dz+nyā dhig rta badz+ra ra ti s+t+waṃ sa ma ya pho tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas bsang chu byin rlabs ni ::bhisnan ta krid phaṭa: bsang chu mi dmigs stong nyid rol ba las: khro bo rdo rje bgegs tshogs mthar byed dang: gnyis med yum mchog shes rab rlung 'byin 'khril: 'phro 'dus 'od zhu bdud rtsir gyur pa las: 'bags rtsogs ma dag sbrang zhing dag par bsgyur:

ba tshu mchod rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i rol bar spel: 'tshe zhing mdangs 'phrog rku ba'i 'byung po rnams: mthong ngam thos sam dran nam reg tsam gyis: lus ngag yid gsum bsreg cang brlag byed gyur: 31 badz+ra a mṛ ta kun li s+t+waṃ: sarba bhisnan tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa: sa spa ra ṇa phaṭa: seng ha ra ṇa hūṃ: nyer gcig brdzod la byan r+shabs bya de nas mchodatshogs byan rlabs ni 31 badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs 31 swā bha was sbyangs mchod rjas mi dmigs stong nyid rol pa las: 'bru lnga 'od du zhu las byung ba yi bye nang gsang mchod kun tu bzang po'i sprin: rmad byung ti 'dzin nam kha'i gter du spel: ma ma hā sarba pañca puts+tsha la kha ram kha dī: de nas spos byu bya ba ni ā ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i rol ba las: 'od phung dkar dmar mthing gsum rnam par byung: spos dang bzang shing la thim nus ldan gyur: gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i dri ma dag byed cing: 'dod rgur spel bas rgyal ba mnyes gyur cig: bla badz+ra du baṃ pra ti tsa puts+tsha me ga sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ de nas skyabs yul bskyed pa na 3 ma hā shu bye ta sogs ko3r+ha: rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar ma chags pad+ma 'dab

brgyad nyi zla dang bam ro'i gdan gyi steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam patsas rgyan rak+ka thod phreng rtsal sku mdog smug nag zhi ma khro 'dzum gyi nyams dang ldan pa phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la phyar zhing g.yon pas bhan thod dku la bsten zhing rnal 'byor he ru ka pa'i cha byad can zhal 'dzum spyan dngas dgyes pa chen po dang ldan pa'i mtha' bskor 'gro 'dul gyi gu ru drug: mchog gi riga'adzin brgyad: sprul ba'i gu ru mtshan brgyad: rdze 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga: lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho: brgyud gsum bla ma'i tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i tshogs rnams kyis rang cag la zhal gyis phyogs: spyan gyis gzigs: thugs brtse thugs rje dang ldan pa'i gnas gsum las 'od 'phros pas zhi khro rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyi 'khor ma lus shing lus pa med pa spyan drangs la bstim mo: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: de nas gnyen po lha gsal ba 31 hrī pad+ma ta krid badz+ra kro dha rgyasnyi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa:

btsasdo: rdzogs par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros pas sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'dre bdud bgegs rigs 'byung po malus pa rang dbang med par mdun sar bkugs nas 'dud par bsam la: na mo dkon mchog rtsa gsum srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis bgegs rigs 'byung pom lus myur du khug cig: badz+ra aṅku sha dza: rat+na pa sha hūṃ: pad+ma sboṭa bam: karma snyespyo ho de nas bgegs gtorabyin rlabs ni sa swā bha was sbyangs stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang lasasgolas rin po che'i snod yangs par oṃ las: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur: 37 ā2) lan gsum da ni sam bha ra a ka sdo yis byin gyas brlab de nas mtshams lha bskyed pa ni skad cig gis rang nyid dbang chen rta mgrin gnas su gyur pa las dpal chen pordo rje khro bo 'o/da spug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa smar sminalas me yi tshwa tsha 'phros pas bdud bgegs bsreg cing brlag par byed pa: am gtsigs man du bsdam pa: dbu skra dmar ser waṃ mig tu 'khyil ba: thod skam rim pa gsum

gyis mdzes pa:rin chen dung gi snyan cha bkra ba phyag g.yas rig stong rdo rje nam mkha' la phyar bas bdud dang bgegs kyi mgo bo 'gems pa:g.yon pa lcags kyi phur ba sa la gzir bas dam sri'i snying khrag gtor ba:sku la za ber thang sham 'dung ma klubs pa:zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs su bsgrad pas sag lho 'ja' khra mdzes pa:rab 'jigs stag mo rngams pa'i khri la rol ba:ye shes kyi me dpung dmar nag rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du khrag 'thung rngams brjid 'bar ba'i skur gyur zhi badz+ra gu ru khro bo lod lo ka sarba duṣ+ṭan hūṃ phaṭa:de nas bden brjod bya ba na na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang:sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang:chos kyi bka' bden pa dang:dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang:yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang:rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams gyi lha sngags

pa:tshu phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' lha las khyad par du gyur ba pad+ma drag po rdo rje khro bo lod kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang: bden pa chen po' mthu dang nus pa la brten nas: deng 'dir sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i bdud bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi glud gtor rgya chen po 'dis dga' mgu yi rang nas tshim par gyis la gnas 'dir ma gnas par byer cig: dengs shig: gal te bka' la mi nyan cing sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po' lus srog thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur ta re de bas so so rang rang gi gnas su bde bar dengs shig: u tsa ta ya phaṭa: rtsa sngagasadang ni hūṃ bzhi brjod drag sngags brkyal la thun gyis brab de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni me dpung mtshon thun de dag tshur 'dus pa las steng 'og bar gsum thams cad chos dbyings ye shes 'od zer 'bar ba'i gur khaṃ: de'i phyi rol me long ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba'i gur sa de'i phyi rol mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen 'bar ba'i gur kho: de'i phyi rol sor rtog ye shes pad+ma

'bar ba'i gur khe: de'i phyi rol bya grub ye shes rgya gram 'bar ba'i gur kho: de'i phyi rol me dpung 'bar ba'i gur kho: de'i phyirol rdo rje'i rlung nag spu gri reg gcod kyi gur khaṃ de'i phyi rol rdo rje'i chu bo rba rlab 'phyo ba'i gur dza: de'i phyi rol khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa'i gur dza: nang du bsrung byed kyi khro mo hūṃ hūṃ dang ru lu'i sgra sgrogs pa'i gur kho: steng du ali dkar po g.yas su 'khor ba'i gur kho: 'og tu ka li dmar po g.yon du 'khor ba'i gur dza: de yi nang du bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad yi dmardo rje khro bo lod kyi nga rgyal dang ldan par sgom la: ye dhar brjod cing rab tu gnas de nas byin 'bebs bskul ba ni rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba 'dzadar dang bcas: phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan dang rnam par sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las dbang byin dngos grub rnams kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin: byung te bdag gnas rdzas yo byad: bum sogs la bstim lha sngags dang: phyag rgya dam rjas 'og min du: dag grol rol bar rdzogs sangs rgyas badz+ra sa ma ya e a ra li pho pho : de nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab na rang nyid lhar

bsgo/ cha gsal thugs ka nas: 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phros: dag pa dbyings gsum la bzhugs pa'i: rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams: rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs nas: rin chen bum pa dri bzang chus: dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu yi lhag ma 'khyil ba las: snang ba mtha' yas gtsor gyur ba'i: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan ldan par bsam: tsheḥkakakaka.e ha a snyi ṣiñca oṃ āḥka:kaX gnas gsum pad nyi zla ba'i steng: rab brten 'bru gsum sa bon la: rgyal ba ma lus rab bstim nas dbyer med bde ba'i klong rgyas gdab: kwa ya wak+ka cit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas bsgrangs phreng byin rlabs ni tse( sarba dharmā ga ga na āX sor mo rnams rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhus pas sras su bsgrang phreng rnams zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'bor gyi rol ba chen por gsal ba'i gnas thams cad nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim mo badz+ra bsham ya dza dza: e a ra li phe phe : lan gsum nge sa su rten snying dang dbyangasagasaladag gis rab gnas bya grub pa'i sngags ni 'di ltar ro 31 ru ci

ra ma pra war+bha na ye swā hā: nyer gcag brjod la 'di skad do de ltar lha tshogs gsal ba rnams kyi sku yis gar mdzad cing zhal nas sngags sgra sgrogs par sgom la: bzlas pa'i rjes su lasabazhi'i sham nad gdon 'jigs pa brgyad tshogs shidz+nya ku ru ye swā ྅ tshe dang bsod nams 'byor ba drug gas ku ru ye swā hā: khams gsum srid pa'i zas nor wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā:gzung 'dzin gnyis snang dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad phaṭa phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par gyur cig: dbyangasadang gsal byed yi ge brgya rten snying ci nus bskyal bas mjug gzhung ga mchod bstod song bas rjes tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus lasakyi rdo rje yar lang nas phyogs su 'dud rgya bca' bzhin par ho dgongs su gsol lo: ho dgongs su gsol lo: ho dgongs su gsol lo:rang bzhin chos dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i klong nas lhun grub bde ba chen po: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas: longs sku thugs rje chen po sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas: che mchog rdo rje khro lod: rig 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mo: king dang rgyal chen sde bzhi srung ma dam can rigs bzhi: 'khor dpung dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol: 'dir 'dus rdo rje slob

—41: dpon: mched lcam rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu 'dus pa rgya mtsho ma lus pa bdag la dgongs su gsol: lhun grub 'gags med tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba la thugs brtse ba chen po'i dgongs te bzhes par ci gnang: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis ho 'dir 'dus rdo rje rgyal theb: las kyi rdo rje: karma gdengs chen rdo rje mched lcam ston 'khor rgya mtsho ma lus pa rnams gsan du gsol: deng gi sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru tshogs kyi 'khor lo gzhung bzhin du drongs dang bzhes par gnang ngo: de nas mched lcam ma lus pa mdun gyi nam mkhar che mchog rdo rje khro 'o da kyi lha tshogs sprin dpung gtibs pa ltar gsal bar byas la de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa gtang bsgral ba 'gug bstim rim pa ni tshogs snod e las lcags khaṃ 'bar ba'i nang du dmigs pa'i rdzas dgra bgegs dngos su gsal bar gyur: na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i mthus: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la myur du khug cig dza hūṃ baṃ ho: de nas lag gtor byin rlabs ni sa badz+ra a dṛ tas

bsang o swā bha was lhung ā:las bharnya lcang lo can yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lhag gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: o badz+ra spra ra ṇa kho:lhag sdud kyi pho nya rnams dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs shig byon cig: e a ra li pho pho : de nas gtor ma byin rlabs ni ā: las bhan+ta 'bar ba'i snod du gtor ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: snyen ātsho/: lan gsum brjod nas bskul bar lajug: de nas gtor ma gtong ba la e yig las byung gtor snod 'bar ba'i nang: dṛ dang dri las dgra bgegs dngos su gsal: na moḥ rin 'dzin bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bden mthu yisaḥ sangs rgyas bstan dgra dkon mchog spyi yis dgra: dge 'dun dgos dgra bla ma'i sku dgra rnams sngags 'chang bdag gi ting nge 'dzin mthu yis khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza: ske nas chings shig badz+ra pa sha sa yan lag sdom mdzod badz+ra sbo ṭa baṃ dbyer med mdzod cig a we sha ya ā: zhes brjod nas bdag mdun lha yi thugs gas dza: dmar nag 'phros pa las dgra

bsgo/: bgegs kyi sna bug dang gshang lam nas zhus pas snying gar sleb tshe zangs lcags kyi 'khor lo gnyis g.yas g.yon du si ri ri 'khor ba las byung bas dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag nam mkha'i gtos dang mnyams par gyur: ngo bo zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zad pa med par gyur bla ā:/ ha ho hrī lan gsumabarngo da la pha mdo bskyal de nas bstan gtor byan rlabs ni rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bshal chu'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur:31 a:hūṃ:ha ho trī: lan gsum brjod nas bstan ma gtong de nas bro mnan bya ba la gtor gzhong sbub nas 'di skad gyer na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum dam can rgya tsho'i bden pa'i mthus gnod byed dam sri 'gab 'dre bse rag mi la spun dgu thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og rol tu khug cig: dza snobaṃ:ho: lan gsum: pro mnan gzhung bzhin bskyal ba'i mjug gtor snod rin chen yangs pa ru bde legs dpal gyi ga bar gyur hūṃ a yu tsa n+d+rapu/ ku ru ye swā snya de nas mchod bstod byas nas slar bkra shis brjod pa'i rim pa ni mdun je nam mkhar lnga lam

yangs pa dza rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus kun: thibs kyis byung nas zhal nas bden tshig brjod: phyag nas me tog sil ma bkram par gyur: rten snying dang ni bkra shis rigs ci lasab bskyal la smon lam ni na mo phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas bden mthu yis: bdag gi smon lam grub pa'i dpang po mdzod: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du:dal 'byor rin chen gru gzings rnyed nas su: thos pas rgyud kyi blo sems zhi zhing dul: bsam byung zhi gnas zab mos las su rung: bskyed rim spros pas lha sngags chos skur grol: rdzogs pa'i lam gyis rtsa rlung thig le smin: shes rab bsgom pas bdag med rnam gnyis rtogs: ye shes rig pa rtse mo byung rgyal 'di: ji bzhin rmad byung mngon du mthong bar shog: gsang sngags rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa mchog mi nub phyogs kun dar zhing rab rgyas nas: 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dge mtshan dbyar rnga'i sgra gong nas gong 'phel phyogs rnams dge ba dang: mdzad phrin yar ngos zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas rdzogs ldan gsar du 'khrung bas bkra shis regag: ces dang bsngo smon rgya yis gdab bsam pa ma lus lhun rgyas

btsakhri 'grub sa ma yā ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng gis snying tig gdams pa zab mo'i chos mdo khams rtse shod ma du sbas nga sprul nu ldan rdo mis bsom nams rgyas pa'i mtsho las bar+ṣa rin chen shog ser ngos las phab chos bdag dh+warma'i mtshan can dang ra med blo gros rgya mtsho la spel na bstan pa'i mnga' thang rgyas man ngag sgrub pa 'a lan thams 'di shan dmar rgyal pos thub pa ra srungs dam nyams lag du mashor rgya snyi gi bu dang phrad par shog sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di 'ang chos kyi bdag po ra med rgya margyasayangayangabaskul ngorasngagasa'achang nu ldan 'dusapa rtsal rgyasomakha' 'gro'i shog ser las zhal bdus te dag pa ra pha ba pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma lam bhi dza ha ro

( pa( 7 zab gsang rto rje snying po las: nyu: sgrub thig le'i rgya can gyi: dkar gtor gtong ba'i rim pa bzhugs soḥ—41 zhe na mo gu ru we bsgomarjes ma 'ongs pad+ma' rgyud 'dzin rnams sgrub pa lhur len byed pa'i tshe sde brgyad yul la thams cad la da po skyems da thur ro phul na las gang mthar phyan bsam myur 'grub de min gegs dang rkyen sna spa sa ma mā dkar gsum mngar gsum gtor ma la 'bru sna mang pos brgyan byas te skyems mchod bas sbyang spel bsgyur bya de nas dza zhes skad cig gis dkar phyogs skyong rnams spyan dra sa la kye ye shes dang ni las la grub pa yi: pho rgyud mo rgyud bka' bsrung rgya mtsho'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas skyems gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor las bzhi'i bsam pa myur du sgrubs: khyad par bod khams mgur lha bcu gsum dang: sa yi lha mo bstan ma sa bdag dang: dpal mgon bdun cu yul lha gter bdag rigs:gnas bsrung dam can nor lha rgya mtsho la zag med dam rdzas skyems gtor 'di 'bul bzhes: rnal 'byor las bzhi'i bsam pa myur du sgrubs: gzhan yang sgrab pa'i gnas

'dir nye ba yi: bka' srung dregs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i sde: dkar phyogs skyong bar byed pa'i tshogs rnams la: gtsang ma dam rdzas skyems gtor 'di 'bul bzhes rnal 'byer las bzhi'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod rin chen sa 'di bdag la rtsol ba dang: 'tsho ba kun spel nad dang gnod pa bzlog: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i rgud pa mtha' dag sol: ci bsam don rnams myur du 'grub par mdzod: sarba bā ling ta khā hi: ces brjod gtor skyemasagatsang sar 'bul bsam pa'i don rnams lhun gyis 'grub the tshom med do sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya dzi ces 'di yang bdag 'dra nu ldan rdo rjesashog ser las zhal bdus te dag par phab pas 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i thugs 'dun rdzogs par shog cag dge'o sarba ma lam

( badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las /:sgrub zeg le'i rgya can gyi: dmar gtor gtong ba'i rim pa bzhugs so:de pa na mo gu ru she can sna10/ ma 'ongs skal ldan skyes bu yas sgrub la brtson par brtsam pa na dang po sde brgyad lha srin la gtor skyems phul la phran bcol na gang bsam las de gegs meda'agrub sa ma yu sha khrag dmar gya gtor ma la 'bru sna bza' bca' btung ba'i brgyan sbyang spel brgyur brlab legs par byas ཿ dza zhes pas la srin bkug de nas 'di skad gyer bar bya kyi dpal mas na sangs rgyas bstan skyong ba'i: lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad rnams: sha khrag gtor skyems 'di bzhes la: rnam bzhi'i las rnams grub par mdzod: bod khams gangs ljongs yul gling 'dir skyong byed zo dor sde brgyad rigs: sha khrag dmar la dga' ba rnams: dam rdzas gtor skyems 'di bzhes la rnal 'byor bsam pa'i don rnams bsgrub: khyad par yul phyogs 'di skor gyi: pha ri g.yas dang tshur ri g.yon: gangs ri dkar dang brag ri rdza skye ba shing dang 'babs pa chu na ba spang dang rgya lam skya: kun la gnas bcas sde brgyad

rnams:'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma bzhes:rnal 'byor bsam pa'i don kun sgrubs rin chen sa 'di rtsol ba dang:rkyen ngan nad dang dgra gdon bzlog dus 'khrugs rtsub 'gyur ri 'dzings thul:bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs:don rnams 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod:ces brjod gtor skyems bcang sar gshegs gang bsam ma lus 'grub par nges ga ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces kya chos kyi bdag po 'gyur med rgya ma bshad ngo ra sngag 'chang nu ldan rdo rje brda ris las bras dge'o sarba ma lam/

( rwadz+nyā: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: hūṃ sgrub thig le'i rgya can gyi bgegs la gtor ma gtong ba'i rim pa bzhugs so:btsa( cha na mo ma hā krodha rwa dza ye shānadza/31 rab 'jags pad+ma drag po yi sa sgrub la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor bas sngon 'gro'i gdams pa 'dir brtson 'bad gegs sel g.yul bzlog gdams pa 'o sa ma yu oṃ badz+ra kro dha rgya spri wa hūṃ phaṭa: rang nyid skad cig gis stong nyid snying rje'i rol rtsal thabs bde ba chen po ye shes rdo rje'i rnam par shar ba 'jigs gzugs rdo rje khros pa'i rang skad can: dpal chen rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum bzod par dka' ba: g.yas thod dbyug dang g.yon sdag mjub mdzad pa: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs su bsgrad pa: dpal dang dur khrod chas rnams sku la rdzo gas pa: ye shes kyi me dpung dmar po rab tu 'bar shing 'khrugs pa'islong du bskyed do: thugs ga'i /ཿlas hūṃḥgrangs med pa dang: sku las khro chung dpag med 'phros pas stong gsum gyi gdon bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas bdag gis ci bsgo bas bka' nyan pa ra

sgom la bden bsdod 'gugs pa lan mang bya de nas byin rlabs bya ba ni gtor sku chang bu mar me da zhal zas 'bras chan la sogs rnams bkod la 'di skad gyer bar bya yin badz+ra 11 dha rgya snyi wa hūṃ phaṭa: cesabasang chaswā bha wa sogs nya: ces pas sbyang stong pa nyed du gyur stong pa'i ngang las ram̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las byung ba'i bgegs kyi gtoram kha tog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam: se bha ra spel a ka ros brgyur ro de nasaskad cig lha ru bskyed phrin las rdo rje'i go ltar gsal de nas bka' bsgo gzhungaltar 'jug lag len theb pa 'a gdam pa 'ad gegs sel zab pa 'i man ngag yin sa ma wā ces kyang slob bu'agyur med rgya mtsha'i bzhed ngorabadag 'dra nu ldan rdo rje dag par phab pa dge'o dge'o dge'o legs so sarba maṅga95bye

( badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las gyi bsgrub thig le'i rgya can gyi: gsol 'debs tshangs pa'i gdung dbyangs bzhugs so:gtsakhri na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yi thathatha/ dad mos gdung ba drag po yis snying nas 'di skad gyer bar bya e ma ho chos sku'i ston pa kun bzang yab yum la: skye med ka nas dag pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: dgongs pa 'ub chub ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: blo bral gnyug ma'i klong nas byin gyis rlobs: hūṃ hū hū: longs sku'i ston pa rdor 'chang yab yum la: 'gags med lhun grub rigs lnga'i 'khor gyis bskor: rang rig so ma'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: 'dzin bral ye shes klong nas byin gyis rlobs: hūṃ hū hūṃ: sprul sku'i ston pa thod phreng yab yum la 'khrul med rig 'dzin rje 'bangs 'khor gyis bskor gsal sangs mos pa'i dbyangs gyis gsol ba 'debs: mnyam nyid thugs rje'i klong nas byin gyis rlobs: ṭ+wāṃ hūṃ hā lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje khro bo lod: gnyis med ḍak+ki phag mo yum dang bcas: dag pa rab 'byams ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: mkhyen brtse

lhun grub klong nas byin gyis rlobs: hūṃ hū hūṃ: dbyings snang mkha' 'gro sde bzhi las la 'byed: ye shes rtsal shar dpa' bo king chen bzhi: mnyam nyid ro gcig ngang nas gsolab 'debs: dbang dang dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ rgyal chen sde bzhi zhing skyong yab yum dang: shan pa dmar nag tsa ti kha mo che: sna tshogs mos pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs: phrin las lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: hūṃ hū hūṃ: snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang srid pa bcud kyi sems can lha ru shar: dag pa rab 'byams ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: rang grol dag mnyam klong nas byin gyis rlobs: nyu hūṃ ( gang shar yul rtog thams cad lha ru dag: 'dzin rtog klong nas g.yo ba chos skur smin: ma lus thugs dgongs chos nyid chen por rdzogs: zung 'jug gnyug ma'i lha sku myur 'grub shog: 〉 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ —: — hūṃ hūṃ sa ma yā de ltar mos gus drag po yis gsol ba 'debs pa'i gang zag la dbang dang byin rlabs daro sa grub 'thob nyams dang rtogs pa 'i yon tan 'phel don gnyis lhun gya grub par nges sa ma yu bka' srung zhing skyongasayab yum dang shan dmar srog gi spu gri

gas/: gzer thub par srungs shag dam tshag can sgod min rnams la a tham rgya snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog rgya rgya rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po sa bha wasamadzad pa rdzogs so snyi bdag 'drakhye'u chung lo tsa dang bud med yi shesamatsho rgyal gyis ḍak+ki'i 'phrul shog la bkod de mdo khams rtse shod gsham du gter rgya bsdams nas ma 'ongasang sprul las can bu dang 'phrad par shog maṇ+ḍalagu bye 211/can/ ru ces kyang rangaslob 'gyur med rgya mtsho dang shes rab rgya mtsho sogs kyisayang yang bzhed ngor bdag 'dra rol ba'i rdo rjesa'aphrul ba'o dge'o dge'o dge'o legs so sarba maṅga lam

lhar snang lta ba gyad sku ni ā: gzhi med rtsa bral chos sku'i rol ba las: bdag snang mi shig rdo rje khro bo lod: gang shar rang grol dkyil 'khor spro bsdu 'gyed:/ma lha sngags phyag rgya che byas badz+ra gu ru khro bo 31da kro ta rā dza hūṃ phaṭa yul 'dzin rgyal bsen rang ngor sang ye rdzogs rig pa'i lha zhal mthong sa ma yā ces kyang bla ma bkra bzang gis ldan pas smras pa dge'o sarba masgo la : hrīḥ bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: pad+ma 'byung gnas 'chol bor khros pa'i lha: gnyis snang mtshan 'dzin /dud: rdo rje khro yod rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstodaX cesanus ldan pas so/

tsho ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las hūṃ:sgrub thig le'i rgya can gyis: las byang bsdus pa khrag mtsho khol ma bzhugs so:sa7): na mo gu ru pad+ma kwa ra ye rgatha 1shi he ru ka laphyag 'tshal lo bdag 'dra rdo rje gshog rgod ngas ma 'o sa 'gro la snyang brtse nas dug gsum gdon gyi g.yo 'khrugs la btab — sa rabs gzhom snying gi chos gtad do spel lo sa ma pā de yang seng lding phur — / ni gru ga khro zhal mtshan nyid tsha sa snya po rten gzhug dar gyis dril dal dbus bkod la byugs bdug brab rnam lnga nyer spyod mchod pa'i bskor de na rnal 'byor bde bar gnas blo sems dngas la rag pa hur rtog med ye shes chen ro 'i nga dug gsum gdon la lta stangs bsgrad lta ba' 'tshams gcod bya ba ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃḥ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos nyid dbyings: ma dag log rtog bgegs kyi ming yang med: 'on kyang glo bur dug gsum rnam rtog bgegasaḥ rang grol sku gsum ngang du mtshams bcad do: a hūṃ phaṭa de nas bka' bsgo ba ni hūṃ hrī bla med gsang chen rang byung dkyil 'khor 'dir 'dzin rtog a 'thas dug gsum rgyal bsen bdud: ye shes rol ba'i ting 'dzin glud gtor 'di: rnam par

khyer la phyogs 'dir ma ldang cig: gal te bka' las dam las log pa rnams: sems rtog rig pa'i klong du gzhig ta re: u tsa ta ya phaṭa: / bzhi drag sngags thun gyis brab de nas bsrung ba'i labar lo ni hūṃ hūṃḥ rna dag ye shes rang byung 'od lnga'i klong: mi 'gyur ngo bo rang gsal bsrung ba'i gur: log rtog mtshan ma'i gdon gyis glags mi rnyed 'di la su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: badz+ra rak+ta hūṃ: de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na mo bdag ni dnge bzung rig pa chos sku'i bar: gnyug ma'i ye shes dkon mchog kun 'dus dpal:gus pa'i skyabs mchi ma gyur 'gro ba rnams: rig dbyings sgrol phyir rtag tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum oṃ āḥtrīḥ mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum gyi lhar: dran rig gsal sangs rjen pas phyag 'tshal ma : 'khor 'das spangs blangs bral ba'i rgyan mchod 'bul gzung 'dzin gnyis snang dbu ma'i klong du bshags: ka dag zang thal slong la rjes yi rang: 'pho chen klong nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: na la bral 'ja' lus sgyu ma'i klong du bzhugs: zag bral snang sems chos nyid dbyings su bsngo: lan gsum ma tram̐

badz+ra bsgral ba ni hū hūṃ: nga bdag gzung 'jin las byung ma tra ka gnyis su 'chang bas dam du bcing ba'i bdud: rtog bral rig pa chos sku chen po yis yul medazang thal klong du mā ra ya: ma tram̐ ka du dra mā ra ya: phaṭa: de nas brda sgo dbye zhing brda phyag 'tshal la dam bca' ni hū /tsho ma rig bag chags dug lnga'i ling thog gis: sku gsum zhal ras sgribapa dbyings su phye: don dam snying po'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sgog gi phyir yang mi gtong lha khyod sgrub: phaṭa na mo tsirta 〉: de nas byan 'bebs bya ba ni hū hū: 'og min mi 'gyur gsangaba'i da la nas sku gsum ye shes chen po'i skur bzhengs la kun btags snang bar yongs grub byin chen phob: 'gyur med rang sa zin par dbang bskur stsol: e a ra be+etring hring pho pho : de nas mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni hrī: 3 nang gsang gsum snang ba'i 'dod yon chos ngo mtshar yid 'ongs kun bzang mchod pa'i rdzas: ma tshang med pa mig 'phrulabakod pa'i sprin: zad med yid 'ong nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ de nas dngos gzha lha bskyed ram pa na hu hūṃ hu: chos rnams mi dmigs gzhi rtsa kun dang bral: ma

'gags rol ba ye shes snying rje'i mdangs thabs shes zung 'jug snodamar 'du 'phro shar: de las 'od 'phros 'byung lnga'i rten snang chags: ko yig las byung rus pa'i ri rab brjid: thod pa'i sku mkhar me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs mi mgo tsit+ta zhing lngags rgyal mtshan phyar: rgyu ma nang khrol lda ldi chun po 'phyangs rū dra ka gdan chu srin gzhi chen bteg 'byung po ya them gdug sbrul ma them byas: gza' brgyad ka chen rgyu skar gral kheb bkrab: rak+ta zhag gis chag chag legs par btab: de dbus pad+ma nyi zla ༄ dra'i khar: (ཿbab bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa: rdo rje khro lod dmar smug khros pa'i nyams: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gnam lcags rdo rje dang: lcags nag phur pa dam sri'i snying la gzir: sdigs mdzub rtse las phag khyung sdigs seng 'phro: rgyal bsen 'gong po pho mo'i snying rtsa 'dren: zhal gdang ljags 'dril smar smin me ltar 'bar: spyan gsum sdang mig srid gsum 'byung po bsngangs ral pa dmar ser g.yas su 'khyil ba las: sgrub mchog rjes 'dzin zar bu sku rgyab 'phyangs: khrag 'thung yongs rjogs thod skam dbu rgyan mdzes: ye shes

btsasdo lnga yi dar sna'i 'phyang chen 'phuraX rno dkar mche ba dgra la e gtsig bsdams:za ber mthing ga chos gos dmar ser bkra:thang sham 'dung ma mi mgo'iphreng ba dang gdug pa sprul bcas dug gsum rtsad gcod rtags zhabs gnyis rol stabs sag lham 'od ldan mdzes:phag mo khros pa stag gi khri la bzhengs:me dpung dmaranag 'tshubs ma'i slong na 'gyengs:ye shes 'od snang 'ja' lus sgyu mi'i sku:phyogs bzhi mkha' 'gro sde bzhi las mdog can:gri gug thod 'dzin gar stabs kha ṭa brten gcer bu rus rgyan dar dathu ngas 'ja' klong bskyedaḥmatshams bzhir dpa' bo sde bzhi dmar spug mdangs:thod rnga dril bu bzhengs stabs e rag shamaḥdar dpyang nyi zla'i phrengab 'od phung 'bar:sgo bzhir kaing chen sde bzhi dkar gsal mdangs:rus pa'i gzugs can kaing rus ha ha rgod gtum drag me 'bar bu gar dug rlangs 'khrigs phyagamatshan lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril gar stabs dril g.yer mi mgo dar snas brgyan:bar mtshams ye shes dregs tshogs sprin ltar gtib:de ltar gsal ba'i lha

tshogs thams cad kyang: me long gzugs brnyan chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: ye shes 'od sku'i gnas gsum rdo rje'i sgog: dam tshag yi ge'i 'od kyis lha rnams bskul: rigs lnga'i rnam par byon nas dbang mchog bskur: mi 'gyur gsang ba chen pos rgyas gdab gyur: sgo hūṃ tram̐ hrī a sum̐ le me bye lta: sa ma ya dza dza s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas bskul ba ni zod rnga'i sgra dngasbyar spos dud sprin spro gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis dam tshag gnad bskul ni hūṃ hūṃ shā lto nub ma rung rakru srin po'i yul: zhing gi g.yang gzhi thod pa'i sku mkhar nas rngam brjid pad+ma 'byung gnas drag po'i skuḥ rdo rje khro lod rnam par skur bzhengs shing: chos dbyings klong las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar ngoms: drag po'i hūṃ sgra 'brug stong sdir bzhin sgrogs: khros pa'i sbyan gyis dus gsum sa ler gzigs: bskul lo 'gro ba'i mgon po he ru ga: bzhengs shig mtha' dmag dus 'khrug nad yam bzlog: gsol lo rgyal bsen dam sri'i snying khrag bzhes mdzod cig dgra bgegs ma lus tshal bar thul: gson cig dam log slob ma hur thum rbad: dgongs shig snyigs ma'i rgyal bstan 'di la gzigs: spel cig skal bzang

btsa/: skyes bu'i tshe chos bskyed: skyongs shig bod khams dkar po'i chos ltar 'tsho bzlog cig snyigs dus rgud pa mtha' dag sol dam tshag thugs rje ma g.yela'agro ba'i mgon: rtag par stobs shugs dpa' bskyed thod phreng rtsal: nus mthus 'gong po rtsad chod he ru ga: ma 'da' ma ldogs badz+ra sa ma yā: ces skyems mchod thugs dam bskul denas spyan 'dren pa ni hūṃ lha rnga yab zang mdog dpal gyi ri bo nas: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje thod phreng rtsal: rdo rje khro lod rnam par gshegs su gsol: ska ldan sgrub pa po la dbang bzhi bskur: gnas mchog 'di ru byin chen 'bebs pa dang: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad bsal ba dang: mchog dang thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol: kheng badz+ra kro dha sa ma yā dza dza: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni hūṃ hūṃ: rang byung dam chig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: gdan gsum tshang ba lha yi pho brang 'dir: ye shes dbyings nas drangs ba'i lha tshogs rnams: du ma ro gcig brtan par bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma yā tiṣ+ṭha lhan de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni na mo sme 'gags 'byur med rang byung ye shes lha: brtse chen

stobs kyis srid gsum dbyings su 'dren:thugs rje'i shugs kyis 'gro khams mun sel ba:pad+ma drag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo:na mo na ma ho:de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni tī gnyis 'dzin blo bral ye shes mchod pa'i rdzas:phun tshogs me tog bdug spos mar me dri:dgyes bskyed gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos:ngo mtshar rmad byung pañca a pra ta:'khor ba dbyings sgrol rak+ta khrag chen 'khyil 'dod yon rnam dag dpal gyi gtor ma spungs:bde stong 'gyur med ye shes byang chub sems:dga' bzhi'i rang gzugs rigs ma lnga dang ni:dug lnga rab bsgral sha khrag mchod pa dang:bsod nams sgo chen bskyed pa'i tshogs rdzas bkram:dmigs med blo bral ga ga ma'i mchod chen po:thabs dang shes rab snang stong glu bro 'bar:ma lus bde ba chen po'i bkod pa 'di:pad+ma thod phreng yab yum dgyes par 'bul rnam par bzhes la dbang dang dngos grub stsol:sa sarba pañca pu tsa khā hi de nas bstod pa ni hā hā:lho nub rak+ka srin po grong dbus kyi:thod pa'i sku mkhar bkod ldan gzhal yas khang sgo gru rta bab tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs: pho brang rnam par

badz+ra: dag la phyag 'tshal bstod: de dbusarang byung badz+ra khro bo lod: sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung bla ma drag po'i sku: 'khor gyi las mdzad sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed: mi shigs rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhal dang shangs khungs 〉ཿsgra drag po dang: haḥriḥniḥsaḥraḥtsaḥtrīḥyaX sgogasaḥ dgod gshe gtum rngams nga ro 'brug stong ldir:'gags med rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i blo mtsho rgyas: zab dang rgya che'i ye shes klong nas rdol: snying rje rngam zhi gar dgu'i cho rol brgyur:'khrul med rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod bdag ni 'di bzung byang chub ma thob par: lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje khro lod kyis: skad cig 'bral ba med par rjes bzung nas: bla med rdo rje snying por grol bar shog: de nas bshags pa na rdo dpang gyur skyabs mchog bla ma dgongs su gsol: bdag ni ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur nas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnamasaḥ mi 'chab mi sped gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i bshags: klong yangs chen po'i nga du bzod par gsol: ma badz+ra sa twa a de nas rta bro bya ba ni hū stsa

rang bzhin gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: bar chad dam sri 'dul ba'i phyir khro rgyal 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyis: rol ba'i lta bro chems se chems: bgegs dang log rtog dug lnga'i gdon: ye shes lnga yi mnan no rgya: nam yang ldang bar ma byed cigs: ma hūṃ swā e ha: s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: de nas 'a ba bzlas na hūṃ rang nyid rdo rje khro lod kyi: thugs dar pad+ma zla ba'i steng: gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu ba'i: lte bar nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs: rig pa hūṃ dmar mtha' bskor du: rtsa ba'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas mgal me ltar 'khor bas: snod bcud dkyir 'khor gsum gyi ngang dag grol rol bar rdzogs sangs rgyas: au āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru khro bo lod lo ka sarba sirnyi hūṃ ā: yengs med rag pa' btsan sa 'dzin gsal stong rol ba'i 'bru 'bum bzla dbang dang daro sa grub thob par re sa bslu med pa d+ma rgyal po'i gtam sa ma yā: skabs su sgrub pa' las bzhi ni 〉ཿ bdag 11ga tsha(da kyis mdun bskyed bskul: de dag las ni 'od 'phros pas: rgyal ba'i dkyir 'khor rab 'byams dang: snod bcud bkrag mdangs gzi byin kun: bstus nas bdag la thim pa yis: mchog thun dngos grub

btsan stsol bar dmigs: o badz+ra gu ru khro bo lod hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta kiṅka ra sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā: ma yengs chu tsho rgyun bal brkyal dbang dang dngos grub thob par nges sa ma yu de nas las la sbyor ba ni ñca rang nyid drag po'i lha tshogs kyi: sku las 'od phung me rlung dang: drag sngags thun mtshon sdigs khyung spros: gnod byed nad yams rgyal bsen gdon: ma lus rtsa sbur me mched bzhin: rjes shul lhag med bsregs gtub brlag ming tsam med par tshar bcad bsam: skyid badz+ra tsasgosarba duṣ+ṭhakhya ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ gnod byed rge'is lus ngag yid gsum la ma ra ya rbad: lha hūṃ hūṃ: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ci nus bzlas

( badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las (0 sgrub thig le'i rgya can gyi tshogs mchod bsod nams gter bcud bzhugs so:bsgo(: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye mthasheg bsod namasaye shes tshogs rdzogs phyir bza' btung ci 'byor 'tshogs byas la bsang sbyang spel brgyur rim pa ni dang po 'di ltar gyer bar bya re ye khe phyi nang bkod pa yo byad gsang ba'i rdzas: rmad byung 'byor tshogs yid 'ong brten pa'i bcud: dngos 'dzin 'khri bag bcad pa'i dri ma rnams: shes rab mes bsregs zag med chu yis bkrus: ye shes rlung gis mtshan 'dzin rang sar gtor: 'dzad med yid 'ong kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rol bar brlabs: a:nyu:de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni hūṃ trī: sku gsum rig 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: gnyis med mnyam sbyor gu ru khro bo lod: rdo rje phag mo gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs la: tshogs mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa kha ram kha hi: de nas bsgral ba ni 'gugs gzhugs grangs ldan rnga rol 'di skad gyer hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ rngam brjed pad+ma drag po khro bo lod: mi

'gyur 1nga las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la log rtog mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rū dra kun: rig dbyings mi 'gyur klong du mā ra ya: sarba sha tsu mā ra ya phaṭa de nas bstabs pa 'i rim pani hūṃ trīḥ pad+ma drag po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs log rtog mtshan 'dzin phung po khams: ma lus chos nyid rig pa'i zhal du bstabs 'gags med chos sku'i dbyings su byang chub po: sarba gnod byed sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa khā hi: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni ho bdag ni gsang sngags lam mchog sgor zhugs nas: bag med dbang gyur sor byangasngags sogs kyi: sdom dang bslab pa dam tshig nyams pa kun: gnong zhing 'byod sems drag pos mthol zhing bshags sa ma yā shukhye ā de nas drangs ba ni kye theg chen bla mad gsang sngags dam pa'i rdzas: bzang ngan che chung mtshan 'dzin dngos po med: gang la reg tshad ngan song sgo bcad nas: myong tshad theg chen spyod pa chos nyid yin a la la ho: denas wag ma 'bul ba ni hūṃ bh+yo: sngon tsho 'das dus bskal ba'i dang po la spyi dpal chen por khas blangs ma sring sde dam rdzas lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor

badz+ra las bzhi'i bsam pa myur du sgrubs:bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā:utsu gro bha lirnya khā hi:de nas chad bstan bya ba ni hūṃ bh+yo sngon tshe 'og min chosadabyings pho brang du:ston pa kun bzang chos sku rdor 'chang gis:rigs lnga'i 'khor la 'od gsal chos bskor tshe:pho rgyud che btsan ma ha ka la da :mo rgyud dbang phyug e ka tsati sogs:rang rtags sgog gi snying po phul nas kyangaX bka' dang dam tshig bsrung bar ma chad dam:zag med rang byung mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:rnal 'byor bcol ba'i brinalas grub par mdzod:de 'og bar dus rig 'dzin rnam brgyad kyis: dur khrod gnas brgyad brtul zhugs spyod pa'i tshe:ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can thams cad kyis:sgogasnying phul nas bka' bsgo dam bzhag tshe:bka' dang dam tshig bsrung bar ma chad dam:zag med rang byung mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:rnal 'byer bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod de rjes dpal ri pad+ma'i 'du gling nas slob dpon chen po rdo rje thod phreng gis:slob ma 'brog mi khye'u chung lo tsā la:gsang ba yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor zhal phyes

tshe: dregs pa'i gtso mchog ma lus thams cad kyi: srog gi snying po phul nas dam bzhag tshe: bka' dang dam tshig bsrung bar ma chad dam zag med rang byung mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: khyad par snying dbus zangs mdog dpal ri nas: grub pa 'i rnal 'byoranus ldan rdo rje la: gter bcu rgya mtsho'i sang brda' ston pa'i dus: bsrung ma gnyan po'i srog snying phul ba'i tshe: bka' dang dam tshig bsrung bar ma chad dam: zag med ra byung mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: gzhan yang bod khams skyong byed brtan ma'i sde yul la gzhi bdag gnas bdag srung ma rnamasaḥ dam rdzas bshal chu'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byer bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: snyed ma ma hrīng trīng bha lirnyi khā nyi de nas dngos grub blangs ba ni hoḥ skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma dgongs su gsol: gsang gsum rdo rje'i dbang dang dngos grub rnams: ma g.yel da lta nyid du bdag la stsol: rang byung ye shes rtogs pa sbar du gsol: rtsa sngags dang ka ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba

gas/ji sidhi pha la hūṃ ā: de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni ho zag bcas zag med dus gsum dge rtsa kun: dmigs med spros mtha' bral ba'i dbyings su bsngo khams gsum snang char zhen pa'i 'gro ba rnams: zang thal sku gsum sa la phyin par shog: lan gsum de nas bsdu rim bya ba na āḥ snang cha rten cing 'brel 'byung chos rnam kun: mi dmigasazang thal gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag: slar yang mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin: ye shes sgyu ma'i lha skur sad byas la: a phaṭa hūṃ nyu: de nas bkra shas bya ba na ho ma bcos zang thal rjen pa lta ba'i gshis: rang byung rtog bral ye shes sgom pa'i gdengs: 'dzin med blo bral gnyug ma spyod pa'i bab: ye rdzogs lhun grub 'bras bu'i bkra shis shog: ces dang bsngo smon mthar rgyas bya sa ma yu e ma rgyal ba'i dab po pad+ma nga sa snyi tig gdams pa zab mo'i chos ma 'o sa'agro ba'i don du bkod sngags srung ral gcig ma mor gnyer thub par sru sa shig sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye snyi ces pa 'ad 'a rnal 'byor ba shes rab rgya mtsho dang 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i bskul ngor sngags 'chang nusaldan rdo rje shog ser las dag pa ra phab pa dge'o dge'o dge'o legs so sarba maṅga lam

btsar+sha zab gsang rdo rje snying po las tu sgrub thig le'i rgya can gyi: bskang ba dri med shel dkar bzhugs so:—4khri na mo gu ru pad+ma kwa ra ye sgomagabyu11 rnal 'byor nyamasachagasabaskang ba da bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs phyir bskang ba dra med shel dkar stan dang po spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ hūṃ hrī:rab 'jigs rngam pa'i grong khyer srin yul dbus: tsit+ta lhun grub zangs mdog dpal gyi ri: pho brang pad+ma 'od 'bar gzhal yas nas: rang byung rdo rje thod phreng gshegs su gsol: gtum drag 'bar 'khrugs zhing rus thod pa'i mkhar: zhing gi g.ya gzhi rū dra'i rgyan phreng mdzes: rnam dag pho brang gsal ba'i dal khang nas: che mchog rdo rje khro lod gshegs su gsol: mkha' spyod gsang chen rol ba'i dur khrod nas: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo rdo rje phag mo da : ḍak+ki rigs bzhi dpa' bo king chen rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spran 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ bka' gsang dam tshig gnyan gyi pho brang nas: bdud mgon yab yum dbang drag shan pa dmar: sngags bdag ral gcig sha za kha mo che:

zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ snang ba 'ja' 'od sna tshogs lam se lam: lha tshogs sku yis gar byed khrigs se khrig: cang ti'u rol mo sna tshogs khra la la:mi rkang rba gling bshugs pa ti ri ri: tshogs rdzas 'dod yon longs spyod sbungs pe spungs: rnal 'byor gdungs dbyangs sgra skad 'u ru ru byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thu lu lu nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phel thibs se thibs: ma lus dag pa rab 'byams byin chen phob: badz+ra sa ma mā dza dza: de nas bskang rdzas byin rlabs gang 'os 'don bskang ba dngos ni 'di skad doḥ hūṃ hrī ma bcosaspros bral bla ma chos kyi skuḥ bde chen ye shes rang shar longs spyod rdzogs pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul ba'i sku dbyer med ma hā gu ru'i thugs dam bskangs nga bdag gzung 'dzin las byung rgyal bsen gshed: log rtog sgog gi shan pa khro bo'i sku: 'jigs byed dmar nag drag po'i tshul du bzhengs rdo rje khro lod rtsal gyi thugs dam bskangs: rang byung mkha' spyod gsang chen rol ba nas: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i dgongs pa gcig sdud dpal: log 'dren tshar gcod stag mo krus ma'i

badz+ra cha gzugs: mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskangs melong yi shes 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas nas: zhe sdang 'joms mdzad gsal stong ngo bo nyid:dga' ba'i ngo bo sku yi dbang chen 'beb: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: mnyam nyid ye shes 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas nas: nga rgyal rtog pa 'joms mdzad bde stong dang: mchog dga'i ngo bo gsang ba'i dbang chen spel: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: sor rtog ye shes 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas nas: 'dod chags rtog pa 'joms mdzad snang stong nga : khyad dga'i ngo bo shes rab zab dbang bskyed: pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: bya grub ye shes 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas nasaX phrag dog rtog tshogs 'joms mdzad rig stong dang: lhan cig skyes dga' ka dag tshig dbang stsol: las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangaḥ phung po rnam dag 'byung ba dbyings su spyor: ye shes bzhi ldan dug lnga ma lus 'joms: stong pa bzhis drangs gnyug ma'i rang zhal spel: dpa' bo sde bzhi'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang:

gnyis snang sgyu ma'i yul la bro ra byed: sna tshogs 'khrul ba'i snang ba dbyings su gzhig: zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i don rnams bsgrub: gsal byed king chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i pho brang nas: rgyal bstan srung mdzad gnod sbyin dmar nag dang: zhing skyong seng gdong sngags bdag ral gcig sogs: las byed srung ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol : rnal 'byor bdag gis g.yar dam sor rtsol cig nyam chags skongs la rtog sgrib byang ba dang: las ngan dag cing khams gsum 'dza ra ba stong 'bras bu sku gsum dngos grub stsal du gsol: ces bskyal nyams chags skong ba dang phrin las 'grub cing bsam pa'i don ma lus yongs su ngesapar 'grub the tshom med do sam mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya lha ces kyang slob bu 'gyur rgyam dang sher rgyam gnyis kyis bskul ngor nu ldan rdo rjes bris pa'o dge'o dge'o dge'o sarba masgo lam

bsgotshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las : dpal chen bla ma drag po yi: hūṃ sgrub thig le'i rgya can las tshogs mchod bsdus pa bsod nams 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs tre(: badz+ra: na mo gu ru parnya ka ra ge zababyu10bkazhes ma 'ongasalasaldan pho mo yis tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir tshogs bsdus bsod nams 'byung gnas nyid rin chen sgog las gces par zungs sa ma yā de yang bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs dum gcig sgod du bsags byas te bsangs sbyang byin gyis brlab nas slar 'bul mchod bstab pa 'i rim ba ni re ye kho: yin aX/ mtshan ldan bharnya yangs pa'i snod nang du: bza' bca' btung bar bya ba'i rigs rnams spungs: myong grol ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs: kun tu bzang po'i rol pa la dmigs te: mchog gsum kun dngos bla ma pad 'byung mchod: yi dam rdo rje khro lod dgyes pa bskangs: gnas gsum ma dang mkha' 'gro'i mnyes pa bskyed: gzung 'dzan las nyon dri ma mthol lo bshags: ma rtog log rtog ྅ dra kun bsgral nas: ye shes gsang ba chos sku'i 1nga du bstabs: bka' nyan pho nya pham phab lhag mar brngan: 'dod yon

bzhes la phrin las lhun grub cing tshogs chen rab dzadags don gnyis myur 'grub re ga: ces brgya stong khri babum sogs skabs dang mthun par gras sa bsogs na tshogs gnyis rdzogs la sgrib pa dag don gnyis lhun grub ze tshom med sa ma wā ye maḥ rgyalaba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas ma 'ongasa'agro la brtse sems kyis snying 'dra'i man ngag rmad byung ba 'brog mi lo tsā khyod la sbyin da dung ma spel brda la bstims mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rdzongs la thob gnyer byang klu bdud btsan la gtod dus bab snyigs ma'i ru 'dza skabs nga sprul nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed bslu ba med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya tshogasamachod bsdusapa bsod nams 'byu gnas rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya yo rgyan gyi brda thim snyi ces pa 'di 'a lung zin 'gyur med rgya mtsho chos bdag rdarma ku mud kyis yang ya bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rjes dpal ldan brag la mgon po'i gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa dge legasa'aphel sarba masgo lam

badz+ra: nye bar mkho ba'i tho gsos ni: mchod gtor zhal shes bzhin du gshams bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs grub pa'i rjes:badz+ra rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: sgo bzhi skyong ba'i tha tshig can: rgyal chen 'khor bcas sa ma dza: dzaX hūṃ baṃ ho: re ye kho o āḥsno nam mkha' mdzod sngags dang oṃ dhita ra ye sa pa ri wā ra e dam oṃ be+e ru ta ka ye: tshe be+e ru bak+ta ye: tshe be+e ma ṇa ye: be+e phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi po: rang rang g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcas: 'dir gshegs mchod gtor skyems bzhes la skrub pa po yi phrin las kun: thogs med stsol zhig dam tshig can: sgo byang khro bo brngan pa ni ā las bhan+ta yangs pa'i nang gtor ma zag med bdud rtsir gyur: cha aX hūṃ ho ma badz+ra kro ta ya marnya ka sa ma ya e dam bā lirte kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun gyis phul la hoḥ dkyil 'khor phyi yi sgo srung ba: khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po yis 'dod yon mchod pa rab bzhes la: gzhal yas chen po'i sgo srungs shig: dngos grub rku zhing 'phrog pa'i rigs: ma lus thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlog: sgrub pa'i

'bras bu mchis par mdzod: byin rlabs gong ltar grub pa'i rjes: ma badz+ra kro ta a bṛ ta kun li sarba sa ma ya e dam sogs ho: dkyil 'khor nang gi sgo srung ba'i: khro chen rdo rje bgegs mthar gyis 'dod yon mchod pa rab bzhes la: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya srung: dus drug nyul zhing 'khor ba'i bgegs: chos kyi dbyings su bsgral ba dang: rtags mtshan mi 'gyang mi g.yel bar: sgrub pa po la 37pa du garbe1la: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: sgrub dus rgyun ma chad pa ru nyan bzhin gtor ma 'di btang bas gegs rnams zha zha phrin las 'grub ya mtshan med byu dngos grub 'bebs sa ma wā 'di yang nyer mkho' cha pag du nus ldan rdo rjes bris pa dge sarba mabe lam pa(: rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros te rang bzhin 'og min gyis gnas dang dur khrod chen po brgyad gnas yul he ru'i zhing khams gsum dbang sdud lha yi pho brang nas sman srung rdo rje'i pho nya rnams sngon gyi tha tshig gnyan po dran nas dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs nas sgrub pa po'i phrin las yid du rtsol ba'i las byed par bsam:

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las che mchog rdo rje gro lod kyi: hūṃḥbasgrub thig le'i rgya can las:bka' them byang shel gyi me tog zhes bya ba bsdo/gas theg: btsa/: na mogu ru pad+ma kwa ra ye ga59564shā rwa thathanas rab 'byam rgyal ba' spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung gdug pa kun 'dul gu ru khro bo lod rnam 'phrul ma 'gags pad 'byung bye phrag brgya mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo' rgyan du rol bsam masalhun gyis grub pa 'i da la ru mnyam med ston mchog gu ru rin po che'i zag med chos kyi 'gro la bde spel tsha grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung lo tsā da snod ldan gzungasam ye shes mtsho rgyal ma rma ban rin mchog rtse mang cog ro dang 'byu ban rdarma gnub kya brte da ro sngags nyi ma lha dpa la rgyal byang chub de sogs las can rje 'ab sum cu yi nor sna khyad 'phags du ma phul nas su lha phyag mang btsal mgran gcig gsol bta pa kye stomanyam med ston mchag gu ru rin po che mkhyen brtse nus pa 'i bdag la dgongs su gsol bstan da 'gro la phan bde 'byu ba'i phyir gu ru nyid kyis zab sgrub med byung ba sla ba'i donachen 'grub pa'i man ngag zhig rje btsun chen po pad+ma'i gnang bar mdzod zhes zhus ma hā gu ru'i zhal snga nas kye stonyan ceg 'bang lo paṇa rag 'dzan rnams ma 'ongs bstan 'gror phan pa 'a thugs bskyed ni rnams par dag

pa'i ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos bdag gas thugs kyis bsgrub pa khyad 'phags sgo zab gsang rdo rje snyang po' chos sde'i skor khyad par dpal chen rdo rje khro bo lod bla ma ya dam dbyer med bsgrub pa' thabs rgyasa'abring bsdus pa 'i lasarim rnams pa gsum skabs 'dar bsdus pa'i sgrub skor gsal ba ya bka' rtsis phyag rgya'i btabs so legs pa ra zung them byang shel gyi me tog zhes pa dang zhal byang le'u bcu pa rno ba'i sgo sgrubs pa'i lan thabs zab mo' chalags dang gsol 'debs tsha sa pa'i gdung dbyangs zhes su grags las byang bsdus pa khrag mtsho khol ma da sgrub pa' phog phub rdo rje'i rgya mdud can phyi na gsang ba'i sgrub pa rnam pa gsum tshogs mchod bsod nams gter ba da 'dod 'byung sgo bskang ba dri med shel dkar phreng ba dang gnam phud gter srung bskang ba phrin las sgo bshagasapa ma rig mun sel sgron ma'i sgo rdzas bskang tshogs bsdus dngos grub 'byung gnas dang dkar dmar bgegs gtor gtong ba'i rim pa gsum dam can sde lnga'i zab bsgrub dug khrag khol gsol mchod phrin las lhun grub rnam pa lnga drag bskul za ngu 'bod rbad bsad pa'i las 'khrugs bskang byang bu gcig rgyug rim pa'o bum gnyis bsgrub pa byin rlabs 'byung gnas da dbang gi lhan thabs las la lajug pa'i sgo byin rlabs dbang mchog srog tag dmar nag dang don dbang bsdus pa spros med rgyun khyer ro dpa la gyi srog dbang byin rlabs 'byung gnas dang

bsgo/ lo rgyus dad mos bskyed pa 'i lcags kyu'o bsregs blugs las bzhi lhun grub zab mo dang dpa la gyi srog 'khor zab pa 'a rgya can no rno mthong gsal ba dpal be'u'i rgya can dang brda byang snying bya gab byang rnams pa gsum 'ub chub chen ngo gas lam zab mo 'o bstod pa dad d+ma bskyed pa'i lcagabangakyu dang la tshogs bskul ba zil gnon se ge' sgra gser skyems 'bul ba phrin las lhun grub dang gdab las las kya ram pa bco lnga'o bzlog pa bar chad b.rūgs pa'i tho lum da mtha' dmags bzlog pa drag po smrar chen mo gegs bzlog bden pa 'i stobs bzlog da bcas so phya na sgo dbye zor bskul zor las da drag po'i zor 'phen tho chen 'bar ba'o daro sa grub bskul len nyul le mnan bsgrad da man ga zab mo nya shu rna lnga bcas dpal chen kro ta rwa dza'i chos kya skor las rim bsdus pa'i rnam grangs de ltar ro ma brjed brda la thob cag sa ra phyo grub pa'i dab phyug khye'u chung khyed la gtad da lta ma spel rtse 30da gshams du sbos za gsang gnyer kha klu bdud btsan la bstems gdams bcud thub par srungs shag dam tshag can skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya nga sprul snying gi budang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya bka' them byang shel gyisame tog zhesabya ba sheg so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya yo rgyan gya slob dpon pad+ma se nyi wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen

gza'i bkod pa'o brda tham lha ces pa 'di 'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chosa'aphelargya mtsho' ran po che'i sbos shel dang bkra shisal reg da bcas nas ya yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bos ldan rdo rje'i 'bros phug mkha'a'agro'i 'du gling gi g.yas log gnod sbyin rdzongs gi ba gam chen po bkra shis skyo sangs byed pa'i gnas nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang bdo zab mo lhag chad med par gtan la dbab pa' ya ge pa ni pad+ma dbang chen gyis bgyis pa dge legasa'aphel sarba masgo lam

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying pa las:che mchog rdo rje khro lod gyi man ngag zab pa'i bka' rgya ma las gtso sgrub rak+ka gdon 'dul zab pa'i chos skor sa bdag klu gnyan 'joms pa'i tho lum zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

—41 na mo gu ru kro dha ra dza ye cesargachenargyasmrasgosgardo ze/ chosadabying sprosapa bral ba' 'od gsal klo lhan skyes bde pho mchog ldan ye shes gshis sku gsum mnyam nyid rags 'dus pad+ma 'byung rdo rje khro lod mchog la phyag 'tshal lo lnga brgya'i gdul bya yang dag lam bsgrod ci bde chen ye shes rang byung byas pa da lan skyes gzhug ma sku gsum mazo ba'i thabs man ngag thugs kyi yang bcud zab mo bstan sa mayu de pang rig 'dzan gong ma byan rlabasaganas dur khrod g.ya' gangs mtsho gli la sogs par phyin nas sde brgyad tshogasal sa bslang zhi dkar dmar gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol lan chags bgegs bskrad bsrungazhing 'khor lo sgom ba gnasadakyila'akhor mjesapa 'a da la bya phyi yi sgrub rten dam sa gtor ma bkod nang gi sgrub rten seng ldeng phur pa bya gsang ba'i sgrub rten tsakra srog 'khor bzhag phyi nang nyer spyod 'dod yon mchod pas skor bar chad kun bsal blo sems bag phab nas rig pa shung bsla rnal 'byor lta gdengs bskyed lus ngag yid kyi gsang mtshams dam bcad nas bla ma sgom la gsol ba yang yang gdab dbang bzha blang la thugs yad bsres te bzhag rjes thob skabs su le'u bdun ma bskyar sbyor ba sngon 'gro rim pa'i snyirgya sa ma wā dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba ni na 23rang byung rig pa sku gsum mnyam brdal klong skyabs kyi

bsgo/: mchog tu byang chub thob par 'dzin: 'khor 'das spang blang bral lo bzhi la rdzogs: ye grol rig pa byang chub sems mchog bskyed: lan gsum gnyis pa bgegs bskrad bsrung 'khor sgom pa na hūṃ hrīḥ ngar 'dzin rnam rtog nyon 'khrul 'khor ba'i bdud: zang thal dbu ma chos sku chen por bskrad: 'gyur med ye shes pha lam ra gur las: mi 'da' rdo rje gsum gyi dam bca' 'dzin: hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa: dz+nyā na badz+ra rak+ṣa: gsum pa byin 'bebs mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni hū hrīḥ gzhi dbyings gdod nas rnam dag phyam brdal klong: 'gyur med gsang ba gsum gyi byin phob cig: snod bcud 'dod yon rab tu bkod pa rnams: ma spang ye dag don gyi mchod sprin che dz+nya na a we sha ya pho : sarba pañca pu tsa spar ṇa kho:bzhi pa ting 'dzan gsum gya khog phub ni āḥ khyab brdal chos dbyings smra bsam brjod las 'das: ma rung ye shes dag gsal bde ba che: zung 'jug rol rtsal snying po hūḥdamar nag:thabs shes mkha' las ye shes sa bon btsas: 31 shu h+ye ta dzā na hūṃ sto dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya ā: dzā na tsit+ta tshe: lnga pa gzhal yas lha bskyed rim pa ni hāḥ rang byung rgya yi sa bon 'bar ba las

eḥye taḥsaḥkeḥre s+t+waṃ 'phros pas : nam mkha' rlung nag rak+ta'i rba rlabs g.yo: dbang chen sa gzhi rus pa'i ri rab brjid: 'od 'bar ye shes me dpung dmar nag 'khrigs:lhun 'grub thod masher rin chen sna lngas mdzes: ye shes bzhi phyogs dkar ser dmar ljang mdog: tshad med 'char sgo phrin las dbyibs mjes pa: 'dod snam dmar po mchod pa'i lha mo sproX bang rim brgyad rdzogs rta bab bzhi yis mdzes 'od 'bar nyi ma zla ba'i sang skar har: gser 'bebs g.yu'i bad ri dwags chos 'khor gdugs: gru bzhi rin chen sna tshogs rgyan 'phyang mdzes: rnam rgyal ba dan g.yul bzlog rgyal mtshan ldeng: 'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor bus dbul ba sel: gzhal yas nang 'khyud thod pa'i rtsig pa mdzes rgyu ma'i drwa phyed tsit+ta'i lda ldi 'phyang: rak+ta'i rba rlabs glad zhag zha la bkram: mig 'bras phreng ba rab 'jigs me dpung 'bar bskal pa'i rlung 'tshubs ye shes gzhal yasadabus sna tshogs pad+ma rtog bral ro yi khar: nyi zla'i gdan steng hūṃ dmar bab pa las 'od zer 'phro 'dus 'khor bcas dwang bcud bstimasaḥ yongs gyur rang nyid rdo rje

khro bo lod dmar spug zhal gsum phyag drug rngams pa'i sku:zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan dgu sdang mig bsgrad:mche ba rab gtsigs smar smin me ltar g.yas dkar g.yon dmar e gtsigs man du bsdams:dmar ser dbu skra wa mig g.yas su 'khyil:dung gi snyan cha thod skam dbu rgyan bca sa:dar sna'i cod pan spyi rje 'bar:g.yas kyi dang po gnam lcags rdo rje phyar:bar mas she rab ral gris bdud bgegs bsgral:'og mas tho chen 'bar bas log 'dren brdung:g.yon gyi / ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum phyaraḥbar mas chos nyid dril bus gsung dbyangs sgrogs:'og mas gnam lcags phur pas rgyal bsen brlag:dpal dang dur khrod chas rnams sku la phod kha za ber 'dung ma chos gos gsol:ha ha hūṃ phaṭa nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs:zhabs gnyis 'gying stabs sag lham mdzes pas brgyan:ba spu'i bu ga'i me 'od thog :rngams brjid stag mo grus ma'i gdan la rol ye shes me dpung 'ja' 'od klong na bzhugs:bde chen 'khor lo bhurnya thod phreng rtsal mthing gsal rdor dril bsnams

nas gar bsgyur rol: longs spyod 'khor lor pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dmar gsal gri thod 'dzin cing brdul zhugs rol: chos kyi 'khor lor badz+ra thod phreng rtsal: dkar gsal ḍā ru me long bsnams nas bzhugs: sprul pa'i 'khor lor rat+na thod phreng rtsal ser gsal be con lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o: bde skyongs 'khor lor garma thod phreng rtsal: ljang gsal ral gri phur ba 'dril bar gsal: kun kyang gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug spras zhi 'dzum khro sgegs dpal dang lang tshos 'khrud dar dang rin chen nor bu'i phreng ba mdzes zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur thabs shes gdan la rol kun kyang rig 'dzin paṇa grub rgya mtshos bskor ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' 'od sang du gsal: spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng: rigs kyi bdag po rakru thod phreng rtsal: dmar sgrug zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod bsnams zhi ma khro 'dzum dpal dang lang tshos 'khyud: dar dmar e rag rus pa rat+nas spras: mchan g.yon sbas pa'i kha t+t+waṃ 'bar ba brten phyed skyil stabs bzhugs rdo rje'i gar chen bsgyur: dngos grub 'byung gnas rigs kun 'dus zhal bskyed

'tshos ba spu rtsa khams bsam yas dkyil 'khor la sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad mdzes 'dzum bzhad: rje 'bangs nyer lnga grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad: lo paṇa rgya mtsho nya rdul 'khrigs bzhin rdzogasaḥ gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon gsal ba las: 'od zer rab 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang skur rgyas gdab bsam slar yang 'od 'phros bde gshegs spyan drangs bstims drug pa spyan 'dren bya ba'i rim pa ni hū hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings skye med rang grol pho brang nas rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams: rdo rje khro lod rnam par spyan drangs nas: bde chen rang byung rol par sa ma dzaḥ sa badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa ma ya dza dza bdun pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal bya ba ni hūṃ hrīḥdabyings nas drangs ba'i ye shes 'khor lo kun: gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bzhugs: rang gsal 'gags med don dam gnyug ma'i gshis: ye rdzogs rang grol lha la phyag 'tshal lo: tshe badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo na ma ho: brgyad pa mchod pa 'bul ba'i rim pa ni ṭ+wāṃ rjiḥ bdag 'dzin rwa tra bsgral ba'i dam rdzas dang: dkar dmar bā ling

phyinang gsang mchod rigs sna tshogs snang ba'i 'dod yon bkod pa rnams khrag 'thung lha tshogs dgyes phyir gus pas 'bul ma hā pañca sarba puts+tsha ho dgu pa bstod pa bya ba' rim pa ni hūṃ sa: sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung rdo rje srin po'i sku: rgod gshe gtum rngams pad+ma drag po'i gsungs: snying rje zhi ba ye shes blo 'das thugs: rdo rje khro lod lha la phyag 'tshalabastod: skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du: log lam bdud kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar: wa mchog khyed kyis 'bral med rjes bzung nas: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsal du gsol: snyen badz+ra sa ma ya ā ya ge brgya yis nongs bshags bzod pa ra gsol bcu pa 'dzab bzlas bya ba 'di lta te bdag nyid rdo rje lnga 81da du gsal ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i badz+ra he ru ga'i thugs 1nga tsit+ta rin po che mchong gur phub pa lta bu zur brgyad pa'i klong ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa'agu ru a tsar+ya sku dkar la dmar b.limadangs chags pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa tshon gang ba rgyan med gcer bu 'od phung 'bar ba: de'i thugs gar pad zla'i steng pad+ma rā ga'i rdo rje nas 'bru tsam gyi lte ba zlam po'i klong nyi

ba:tshu zla'i ga'u kha sbyor ba'i nang du thugs sgog rdo rje'i ngo bo (ཿdmar gsal la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yas su 'khor ba 'od zer mu med pa 'phro zhing phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras da bcas pa'i sku gsungs thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub ye shes yon tan thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par thibs se byung: bdag gi snying gar thim pas dngos grub rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas kyi gter chen po thob par bsam bzlas pa bya yangs 'od zer sna chogs mar 'phros khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog: lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dag: rigs drug gi sdug sngal rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa sbyangs: bde chen ye shes kyi sa la bkod: sgod bcud 'byung lnga'i dpal yon dwang bcud thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas bdag nyid la thim pas dpa la 'byor mthu nus thams cad rgyas par bsam la bzlas pa bya yang 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros dag pa rtsa khams kyi klong na bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin paṇa grub lo tsā skye mchog thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskulaḥ bde stong

'gag pa med pa'i sbyor ba mdzad: zag med byang chub sems kyi rgyun dkar na ra ra bab: lus kyi rtsa 'khor thams cad khyabaḥ dga' stong mchog gi ye shes rgyas par bsam lhan skyes spros pa dang bral ba'i gnas lugs de bzhin nyid kyi ngang la blta zhing bzlas pa bya yang 'od zer dpag med 'phros: snang ba thams cad yi dam rdo rje khro lod kyi sku yi rolapar sad: sgra grags thams cad drag po'i sngags 'brug stong ldir ba ltar sgrogs sems gyi 'gyu 'phro thams cad gang shar chos nyid kyi rol bar blta zhing: skye 'gags bral ba'i gsang sngags rdo rje lta bu'i rang sgra ti ri ri bzlas pas dam chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings su brdal zhing: o badz+ra gu ru gro rnge 81da sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā: ting 'dzin gsal dag brtan pa' ye shes kyis drag sngags rdo rje'i rgya can 'bru 'bum bzla dngos nyams rmi lam dag pa 'a snang ngo ru ya dam zhal mjal lung bstan gnang ba dang gnamalcags rdo rje rted cing dril bu dkrol chu bo' bar brgal gser gya ral gri rnyed bya khyung zhon phag sdig pa zhen zhang bkol gtor ma me 'bar bum chu khol ba dang phyi nang gsang ba'i 'grub pa'i rtags mtshan 'byung bden rdzun

—4rdo lag tu longs da nges shes gsal ya dam gcag 'gyur 'di yis dam sri 'dul rā dza bsen cho 'a g.yul las rnam par rgyal bkra shas yon tan bcu drug gsar du 'khrung legs pa 'a dpal 'phel dge ba'i snyi ma 'byu the tshom med do pad+ma rgyal po'i bka' sgrub dang las sbyor rams pa dmigs pas dbye dngos gzhi nyams len rim pa 3nargya sa ma yu de nas rjes la las kyi rim pa gsum da po gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa ni dza gad skyems dang bā lang sna tshogs spu sa 'bru gsum nus pas byin rlabs zad med spel de nas spyan 'dren bya ba'i rim pa ni stsa rang bzhin chos dbyings rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: gsol 'debs rjes chags brtse ba'i thugs rje can: yi dam che mchog rdo rje khro bo lod dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol rmad byung bde chen gdan la bzhugs su gsol dngos grub mchog rtsol khyed la phyag 'tshal lo: 'dod yon phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang: dam rdzas med byung dpal gyi gtor ma 'bul: dgyes bzhes 'dod rgu'i dngos grub zad med stsol: rtsa sngags mthar e dam rat+na bā lirnya la kha kha khā twe khā hi lan bdun brjod la dpal chen po'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gur gyur nas dam rdzas kyi bcud drangs te gsol bas

) gyes pa bskangs: bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar mdzad du gsol: de nas phrin las zab mo bcol ba niḥ hūṃḥ mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya dra/ sna drogs thabs kyis skal ldan smin grol bkod: gdul bya'i re skong yi dam lha mchog gis: dam rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes: sku gsung thugs bskangs brin pas bcol ba ni: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams la: brtse chen chags pas 'bral med rjes bzung nas: lus ngag yid gyi sdig sgrib dag pa dang: chos mthun bsam pa pa'ib pa'i phrin las mdzod: mi mthun 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba dang: legs tshogs dpal 'byor yon tan gong 'phel rgyas: khams gsum 'dod rgu'i phyu g.yang sdud pa ) nga dgra bgegs bsgral sogs phrin las grub par mdzod: kla klo gdug pa'i cho 'phrul bzlog pa dang: smon log rā dza dam sri'i za kha snubs mi phyugs yam nad dus kyi rgud 4 sogs: bar chad 'gal rkyen bsal ba'i phrin las mdzod: nad gdon sdig sgrib ming gi lhag mar gyur: rtsa rlung thig le'i rgud pa bsal ba dang: bde stong ye shes chen pos

bsgo/: smin grol nas: rang byung sku gsum mjal ba'i phrin las mdzod: sgrub pa gnyan po'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing: rtags mtshan mang po mngon sum byung ba dang: lha mchog rdo rje khro lod wa tshogs kyis: dngos grub 'dzad med stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod: thugs dam ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma yā ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs pa dang 'dod pa'i 'dod gsol phrin lasag bcol 'grub sa ma pā gnyis pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la phya nang gsang ba'i yo byad kun bsags nas rang nyid la yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis dkyel 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed byed mi āḥrang byung bhan+ta yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: dam rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lnga'i gter: ye shes rol pa chen por byin rlabs nas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i daphyid du gyur ram̐ yi dzaḥ au ā hūṃ lan gsumaḥ brjod la spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ rang snang rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nas bden chen pad+ma 'od 'bar rig 'dzin tshogs rdo rje khro lod lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: ma sring rgya mtsho las byed dam can rnams: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ma badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa ma ya dza dza de nas tshogs phud 'bul bshags

jem pa ni hoḥ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod dang zhal zas ga ṇa tsakra'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs 'gal zogs kyi 'khor los bshags: ma ga ṇa tsakra puts+tsha ho: badz+ra sa ma ya ā: de nas bsgral bstab bya ba 'ad ltar ro hūṃ dzaḥ spros bral bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: dpal chen pad+ma drag po'i skur bzhengs la: gzung 'dzin bstan pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: gzugs phung ye shes lha yi zhal du bstabs: rū tra ma ra ya rbad: sarba dz+wa la ram̐ khā 'i: de nas bskang ba byed pa 'a jem pa na hūṃ trīḥ ma bcos ye grol chos sku mngon gyur pa'i: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i thugs dam bskang: sgrub la dngos grub rtsol zhing bar chad sel: yi dam rdo rje khro lod thugs dam bskangs: phyi nang gsang ba'i rkyen bzlog bde stong bskyed: ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: sgrub pa po la ma yis bu bzhin skyongs: las byed dam 5na grang ma'i thugs dam bskangs: ye shes chen po 'gags med rol pa las dkyil 'khor lnga tshogs rnams kyis thugs dam basmangs: basmang ba med de khams gsum yongs

ba:tshu kyis bskangs:sbyor ba med do khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor:sgrol ba med do khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol:ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dmabaskangs dmigs med ye dag lta bas thugs dam bskangs:yengs med 'od gsal sgom pas thugs dam bskangs:'dzin med rnam rgyal spyod pas thugs dam bskangs:dngosapo tshos nyid yangs ba'i 1nga du bskangs:snang ba ye shes chen po'i 1nga du bskangs:gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i ngang du bskangs:sdug bsngal ka nas dag pa'i gshis subaskangs kun rdzob don dam gnyis med dbyings su bskangs khams dang skye mched gnas su dag pa yis rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:nyon mongasartogs tshogs ma spang rang grol bas rdo rje khro lod lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol:chos dbyings brdal khyab chen po'i ngang du.a:dmags bsam dag pa sa de skad bska bar bya de nas lhag ma 'bul ba'i rim pa ni sa spyo na tshe dpal chen khrag 'thungs spyan snga ru khas blangs dam bcas ma bdun sring bzhi'i sde:king ling

'bar ma dbang phyug dam can rnams: lag gtor bzhes la phrin las grub par mdzod: ma ma trīng hrīng bā lirnyi kha kha khā twe khā hi: de nas chad mdo btang pa 'i rim pa ni hūṃ bya spyod che bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la khas blangs dam bcas mna' bor srung ma rnams: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po rdul du rlog/sgrub pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa phyogs bcur spel: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe zhabs pad brtan mdzad phrin gdul bya yar ngos zla ltaraspel: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: de nas bshal chus brtan ma brngan pa ni hūṃ : dpal tsugabaka' nyan ma sring bstan marnams : 'dir gshegs dam rdzas bshal chu'i mchod pa bzhes: dpal gyi tha tshig dam las ma 'da' bar: las kyi 'bras bu 'byung bar mdzad du gsol:yi/ ma ma hring hring bhalisto kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas rta bro brdung ba'i rim pa ni ྅ཿ pho brang 'bar ba eX yi klong dkyil du: dgra bgegs 'byung po dam sri nyal le brub: ye shes lnga yi klong du byang chub bar

bsgo/: ma ldang ldang med rang byung bro rgyas 'debs: slo sto bha ya nan nan āḥm ra ya nan nanaḥ/ na sha ya nan nan de nas daro sa grub blang ba'i ram pa ni sno sku gsum yeshes klong chen nyi ma shar: bde legs nyams rtogs yon tan sbrang char 'bebs: dad ldan gdul bya'i lo bcud smin pa'i gter: 'dzad med gsang ba gsum gyi dngos grub stsol rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā: de nas nongs bshags bya ba'i rim pa ni sa gsang sngags bla med mchog gi dkyil 'khor duḥ sgrub rdzas ma tshang lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs: ma rig dri ma'i nyes 'gal ci song yang: ye shes lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags: sa ma ya ā: yi ge brgya pa sa lag chad kha bska bya de nas bsngo ba smon lam bya bani ho 'dusadang 'dus byas kun rdzob don dam chos: rang rig phyam brdal 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: 'khrul snang las kyis bsdus pa'i sems can rnams: 'gags med yegrol chos skur sangs rgyas shog: lan gsum rjes su bsdu lngang ni hūṃḥ gsal dag lha snang sgyu ma'i bkod pa rnams: dmigs med khyab brdal chos sku'i ngang la bsduḥ slar yang mkha'

las glog 'od 'khyug pa bzhin: ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i sku ru sad: a༅ phaṭaphaṭa: de nas bkra shis bya ba'i rim pa ri (ཿ ye dag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid las: lhan skyes bde chen zag med byang chub sems mnyam nyid rang shar gsal dag thig le'i klong: mnyam brdal bde ba chen po'i bkra shis shog mtha' rten dga' ston rgya chen bya ba dang yongs su dge ba smon lam rgya yis gdab gsum par tsakra bcing ba'i thabasarim la dri med sman shog 'jam mnyen kha gang bar mu khyud rim pa bcu ru bskor bar bya ste bar sku gzugasamatshan ldan hūṃ gi mtshan de yi phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs lnga pa'i mdun nas rim par 'ad bzhan legs par bri oṃ bhurnya thod phreng rtsal kā ya sirnyi pha la (ཿ oṃ badz+ra thod phreng rtsal sirnya pha la hūṃ yo rarna thod phreng rtsal ā yu pukhye sarba sirnyi (ཿ tshe pad+ma zod phreng rtsal wāk+ka sarba sarnya pha la hūṃ oṃ garma sgod phreng rtsal sarba du dra mā ra ya phaṭa bā su kha dhe sirnyi / de phyir pad+ma 'dab bzhir 'di ltar bri theg/gasgonā/11 'jigs pa brgyad dang r+sā drug shirnyi ku ru ye swā snya thugagagruspu/snye/rnya/ tshe dpal 'asgor zu ga dza/ ku ru ye swā snya zung/dra/grudranagla/bye smra1 khams gsum srid pa'i phywa g.yang wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā snya 34dza/bgrugrusgare/yigagrwa gnod byed dgra bgegs sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa ཿswā snya de phyir rtsa sngags rgyal

btsaX po 'di yi bskor yo badz+ra gu ru sa bo lod kro dha rā dza sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ che mtshog rdo rje khro bo lod kyi sku gsu thugs yon ma phran lasarnam 'gyur ba med pa ra brten cing bzhugs su gsol badz+ra sa ma ya ras hūṃ de phyar lnga par 'di ltar bri bar bya 'chang ba po rnamasal yi dam rdo rje khro bo lod kya rtag tu bsrung zhing skyabs pa dang mtshog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lusapa stsol ba da 'gyur ba med pa'i sku 'gags nga med pa 'a gsung 'khrul ba bral ba'i thugs re ba skong ba'i yon tan 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phrin las kyi dpal da ldan par gyur cag de phyir drug par dbyangasogasal rten snyang bri bdun pa ra me ri brgyad pa ra pa tra bri de mthar rdzasartags bcu pa ra rgyal srad bkod rdzasani ran chen phye ma chos sman dang seng lang phur pa tsan ldan rdo rje gzhug mtha' nas nag po dgu sbyor byugs par bya da la' dbus gzhug rnam lnga nyer spyod bkram bsnyen sgrub zab mo' rtags mtshan zeb bar gtong de nas 'bral med rgyun du lus la bcing 'jigs sa mi tshugs rgyal bsen 'bog cing brgyal tshe bsod nyamasartogs yon tan gong 'phel rgyas bslu ba med do pa d+ma rgyal po 'a bka' lag len rjes kyi rim pañcārgya sam yu ye maḥrgyal ba kun dngosagu ru pad+ma 'byung o rgyan slob dpo na rdo rje thod phre ngas ma 'ongs snyags ma'i 'gro la rjes chagasanas gdams pa yang bcud thugs kyi bcud byung ste grub pa'i dbang byug khye'u chung khyod lagatad chos kyi bdag po 'byu ban dharma dang smon lam

'brelaba'i las can nyi shu drug lnga brgya mtha' la nye ba'i dus skabs su gter ston nus ldan rdo rje zhes bya 'byung chos bdag pad+ma'i mang can rin chen rigs 'dzoms nas gdamasapa zab mo 'di rted 'gyur da lta spel ba' dusal ma babatha sa brda ya ris su thob cig sar rdzu bstan pa 'i 'gro don myo byang gnyis las 'byung gdul bya 'bum phrag dpal gyi ri la 'dren bka' 'ad rtse shod gsham du dgo sa pra thob skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya las can snyi gi bu na nga 'phrad par shog bstan pa'i snying ba da 'dzin pa'i shan dmar daja yak+ka nag mor bka' yi gnyer byang gtad klu bdud btsan gsum mel rtse'i pho nyar bsgos g.yel med rtag tu skyong shig sam mā rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya zab rgya sbasargya gsang rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'ad yang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho sgrub pa 'i me tog bkra shis wa reg rin chen dang po dbang lnga'i cod paṇa gser mdog reg bya bri gzhi shog dkar dri bral bcas te yang nga bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bonusaldan 'du pa rtsalagyisamado khamasatsā ri'i myo phyogs bsod nams rgyas pa'i mtsho las gter du bton te ma lo dgu la bka' rgya byas mthar rten 'brel dus la bab tshe mkha' 'gro'i brda dang slob bu dharma girtiyisang shadasald brtan pasaskyes bcas yang ya bskul ro ra rin po che' shog ser las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa phyogs dang gnas skabs kun tu dge zhang bkra shas par gyur cag sarba ma lam snyi dza ha ram dza yan+tu

badz+ra byin bskul ni 'dir 'tshogs rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyis dad pa mos gus gdung shugs drag po'i sgo bskyed pa dang mnyam du: snying ga'i 'od zer bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'phros nas bskul de: lho nub rnga yab kyi gling nas o rgyan rje 'bangs brgyud pa dang bcas pa thams cad bag bro byin chags dgye brtse'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas de byon nas: dam tshig phun tshogs lnga'i bkod pa rnams kyang bde chen pad+ma 'od kyi ston 'khor zhing dang gzhal med khang ye shes sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa chen por byin gyis rlabs par dmigs la byin dbab yang rtsa ba gsum dang phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dpal chen bla ma drag po'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkod par byon nas: bdag gnas bsgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams la thim te dngos grub char ltar dbab cing byin rlabs sprin bzhin 'khrigs par dmigs la: sa ma yā 'di yang sgrub pa chen po' dus su nye bar mkho phyir chos bdag dharmās bskul ngor nus ldan rol pa' rdo rjes dag par phab pa mabye ma

badz+ra bskang rdzas byin los ni hū trī kun khyab chos sku'i mkha' glong yangs pa phu rig rtsal sgyu 'phrul bkod pa phyi'i tshogs: ro mnyam dga' ston 'byed pa nang gi tshogs ma 'dres mnyam rdzogs 'ub chub gsang ba'i tshogs: thams cad ka nas dag pa chos sku'i tshogs: lhun grub rang byung 'od snang longs sku'i tshogs: ma 'dres rang gsal 'dzin med sprul sku'i tshogs: dngos mtshan yongs su dag pa bsod nams tshogs: nyag gcig mtha' bral rig pa ye shes tshogs: rtsa gsum dgyes sprin bkod pa rnam mjes shārdo ṅga sdi ma'aphrul rdo rje'i ltad mo phun tshogs gyur: sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyasarlabs de nas them med bskang ba bya 'di yang cha lag don phyir dang snying slob dharmā dgyes pa' phyir nus ldan rol pa'i rdo rjes so

bas/: sbyangs — sngon song smon lam mthu can 'brel tshad don lngan dngos grub bskul ba na hūṃ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: mi gnas ye shes thugs mchog 'gyur med sku: dbang chen 'chor bor khros pa'i lha tshogs rnams: yang yang bsnyen cing gsol ba 'debs lags na: rdzu 'phrul rkang pa gter mthong mig rnon dang: nus pa mthu dang tshe chos dpal 'byor grags: gzi mdangs srid nor zas dang 'dod rgu'i gter: mngon shes grub rtags mkha' spyod bsgod la sogs: thun mong yon tan rgya mtsho'i dngos grub stsol: ces dang yang na sno sku gsum klong yangs gzhon nu bum mdzod las: bde gshegs 'dus zhal bla ma khro bo lod: mnyam nyid dbyings las dgongs pa'i rtsal phyung la mos ldan sprul sku'i 'khor tshogs sgrub pa por: gnas lugs gcer mthong rig pa'i rang zhal ston ma rig gzhi la sangs ba'i phrin las dang: kun tu bzang po'i sar 'khod dngos grub spyodapa: ces bskul nas rol mo bya'o zem med rtsa sgrub kyi kha bska du gter ston nyid kyis spyor ba maṅga lam
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snyeng po las che mchog rdo rje khro lod kyi dgos sgrub bcu pa rigs bdag rak+ka dbu dbum rtsal kyi zab sgrub shinatu gsang ba'i bka' rgya can bzhugs so:

btsaX na mo gu ru pasdi gar ye tsan1 stesri51 dusagasum rgyal ba grasabacas ma lus pa' ye shes gcig gyur mchog gi rdo rje 'dzin rmad byung gsang ba gsum gyi mdzod 'chang ba pad+ma nga gnas mchog la phyag 'tshal lo bdag 'dra rig 'dzan pad+ma sa bha was ma 'ongs gdul byar brtse ba chen po yis shan tu zab pa'i gdams ngag mchog gi bcud legs pa ra bstan no brtson pas nyams su longs sa ma mā de yang lasarim sbyor dngos ris gsum las dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro'i ram pa la dkyil 'khor bkod cing se lding phur pa ni tag la sor gcig rgya mdud sor mo gang 'chang zung sor bzhi rgya mdud 'og mar gcag dbal phur zur gsum so bzhi legs par bya mgul du drag po' rdzas dgu gdags par bya byug bdug brab cing da la' dbus su dgod sgrub gtor brten sa mchod pa' po byad bsags rnam lnga nyer spyod dag gis legs par spras khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro byas la sgrub gnas yo byad sa dus lha nyid gsang bag yangs rgyud klod sna sems dag pa'i mthus zab mo'i nyams len gzhu bsrang bya ba na dang po skyabs su 'gro zhang sems bskyed na na 31ཿ khyab brngal rig pa sna gsum ye shes la: blo 'das bde chen ngo bor smrabs su mchi:'khor 'das spang blang bral ba'i gzhi rig klong:nasal 'khor dbyings su sgol phyir sems

btsa(: bskyed do: lan gsum gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa'i rim pa ni na mo bde gshegs snying po sku gsum ye shes la: dran rig gsal sang rjen pas phyag 'tshal lo: ye grol rang snang rig pa'i rgyan mchod 'bul: ma rig gnyis 'dzin dri ma mthol lo bshags: shar grol ris med ye shes rjes yi rang: 'pho chen don dam sang nas chos 'khor bskor: rang snang ston pa g.yo med 'od gsal bzhugs dge rtsa zag bral khyab brdal 'gro la bsngo phyam gcig gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par regag: lan gsum gsum pa bgegasabaskrad bsrung 'bar sgom pa ni hūṃ hrī: nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i 'dre bdag med dbu ma chen po'i dbyings su bskrad: ye shes rang gsal 'gyur med bsrung ba'i gur gzhom med rdo rje pha lam sra brtan brjid: (sngag tsa ta ya phaṭa: dz+nyā na rak+ka sbyo: bzhi pa byin dbab mchod rdzas byin rlabs na hū hrī:'og min chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba nas rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i byin pheb cig: gzhal yas bkod pa lha sngags mchod pa'i rdzas: ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol par byin brlabs gyur: 31 dzā na e wa sha ya ā: badz+ra spra ra ṇa sa:
