sbyor ba sngon 'gro'i rim palha sa ma yu shā1thagru gnyis pa dngos gzha lha bskyed rim pa ni 31ཿ chos rnams mi dmigs gzhi rtsa kun dang bral: smra bsam brjod bral don dam stong pa nyid: blo 'das gnyug ma ye shes de bzhin nyid: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis 'di don bstan: sa ma hā shu h+ye ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bha wa at+pa ko3nya: de bzhi nyid kyi ting 'dzan rim pa'o ā: ka dag skye ba med pa'i ye shes las lhun grub 'gags med blo bral bde ba che: kun gsal zang thal 'gyur med snying rje'i gdangs 'phaṭa mchog spyan ras gzigs kyis 'di don bstan: o dz+nyā na dharma dhartu sā bha wa at+pa ko3nya: kun tu sna ba'i ting 'dzin rim pa'o hūṃmigs rab 'gyur med stong chen rol pa las: thabs mchog gsal khyab ye shes zung 'jug brdal: gnyis med klong las rgyu yi sa bon ni: dmar gsal hūṃḥyig nam mkha'i go ru shar sa dz+nyā na badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya (: rgyu yi ting 'dzan bskyed pa'i rim pa'o shāḥ bskyed byed rab 'bar tīḥmathing gsal ba las: eX 'phros khyab brdol nam mkha' 'byams su klas: ye las rab g.yos rlang gis ba dan brngal: ra 'phros rakā'i gro mtshos rba rlabs gasku :

ba:tshu (ཿlas dbang chen sa gzhi sra brtan brjed re las bskyed pa'i ye shes me dpung 'bar: o ཿ'phros rus pa'i ri rab zur brgyad pa: rgya che khyon yangs brdal khyab chen por gyur: eḥ yeḥreḥsaḥre ke spra ra ṇa phaṭa saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ pho brang ra byung lung lnga'i rim pa'o hūṃḥrang byung rgyu yi sa bon 'od zer gyis: phyi snod rnam dag he ru'i bkod pa che 'gyur med dur khrod brgyad kyi mtshan nyid rdzogs: tshogs brgyad rang grol rig 'dzin grub thob brgyad: yul brgyad rnam dag ko seng phra men brgyad: phra yul rnam dag me mtsho rlung shing sprin: phra rtog rang grol klu zhing phyogs lce spyang: ye shes rang gdangs 'jigs rung srin po'i zhing: rdo rje can dang khro bcu rgyu mi nus: de dbus lhun grub rin chen gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan dang rta babs rdzogs: na ni thod pa'i sku mkhar zla gam pa: rak+ta'i mtsho 'khyil glad zhag zha la bkram: mi 'gyur 'ur mo rdo rje'i gzer gyis bsdams: klu brgyad ka gdan lha chen ka ba byas: gza' brgyad ka zhu rgyu skar gral kheb byas: tsit+ta'i pho long rgyu ma'i drwa phyed 'phyang: zhing gi g.yang gzhi mig 'bras lda

ldi spud: gser gyi thog phub g.yu yi kha bad mdzes dar rgyan 'phan phran rnga yab ba dan phyar: bum pa bre dang chos 'khor gdugs kyis mdzes: de dbus chos 'byung zur drug dmar nag 'bar: gru gsum mthing nag e yi mtshan par gyur: phyi gsal nang gsal dri med zang thal klong: tshad med ye shes brda don rtags bkod che: spyo dz+nya na badz+ra marnyal sba ra ṇaḥ phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa hūṃ 'gyur med gzhal yas bskyed pa'i rim pa'o hūṃḥ rgyu yi sa bon hūṃḥlas 'od zer ni meḥdang ma yiga.ā ru chad pa las gzhal yas dbus su rin chen yangasapa'i khri byol song gtso bo chen po brgyad kyis btegs: de steng paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma ni: dri med 'od gsal 'dab stong bkra ba'i mdzes: āḥlas thabs mchog zla ba rgyas pa'i khar: maḥlas shes rab nyi ma 'od zer bshad: bde chen mi 'gyur mchog gi zhu bder spyod dpal chen khro bo 'degs pa'i gdan du shar: e rat+na masnyol: saṃ pad+ma marnyal aḥtsan+t+ra maṇ+ḍal: ma sur+ya marnyal: spra ra ṇa phaṭa: paṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ rab 'degs 'gyur med gdan bskyed rim pa 'o (ཿ mi 'jigs sku yi sa bon gdan steng bab: de las 'od zer 'phro

badz+ra: 'dus don gnyis byas:hūṃ zhu gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu pa:sra brtan g.yo med rang byung brdal ba che:bdud bgegs 'byung po zer gyis tshar bcad 'dus:gnyis snang rang sar gcod de zhu ba las:bdag snang mi shig rak+ka dbu 'bum rtsal:sku mdog smug nag srin po khros pa'i sku:mdun zhal khri phrag gnyis ni mthing la rngams g.yas zhal khri phrag gnyis ni dkar la bzhad:g.yon zhal khri phrag gnyis ni dmar la gdengs:rgyab zhal khri phrag gnyis ni ser nag gtum:steng zhal khri phrag gnyis ni smug nag 'bar :spyan mig 'bum phrag gsum gyi khams gsum thabs smar smin 'bum phrag me yi gdon bgegs bsregs:zhal 'bum gdang bas srid gsum shub kyis rngubs:mche ba 'bum phrag bzhi gtsigs bdud rnams rlag:g.yas phyag khri phrag lnga yi rtsa ba rnams:yon tan lha tshogs zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis:'jam dpal sku dang yang dag thugs mchog 'bar:pad+ma gsung dang phur pa phrin las kyi:lha tshogs ma lus phyag sor rtse la gdegs:lhag ma rnams kyi sgrol byed sbu gri dang:byad phur rbod gtong bzlog pa'i

ba dan phyar:nyon mongs tsha gdung 'joms pa'i zla ba bzhad:brlag byed rdo rje tho lum mkha' la gdengs:phung byed 'byung po kun 'joms sdig mdzub brten g.yon phyag khri phrag lnga yi rtsa ba rnams:lnga bcu rtsa brgyad khrag thung khro bo' lha:ma mo rig 'dzin mchod bstod drag sngags dang:dpal gyi bka' srung phyag sor rtse la bkod:lhag ma rnams kyi brlag byed thog mda' dang rgyal bsen 'joms pa'i sdig pa'i tsha tsha 'phro:ma rig mun sel 'od 'bar nyi ma brten:gdug pa rab bcom ye shes me dpung bsnams:bzlog pa'i phyag rgya rdo rje thal mo sdebs:nga rgyal ma spang glang po 'bum phrag klubs:'dod chags ma spang mi lngags 'bum gyis dkris zhe sdang ma spang stag sham 'bum gyis brgyan:gti mug ma spang sbrul nag do shal 'phyang:phrag dog ma spang rdo rje'i bde ga pa gdengs:zhabs ni 'bum phrag gnyis kyis dam sri gnon yan lag med pas rtsis las 'das pa'o:ba spu'i khams nas gnyan lcags thog gzer 'phro:sku las me rlung nad sprin phyogs bcur 'gyed:sprul ba'i khro chung sdig khyung phag seng 'phro:bar chad 'byung po ming tsam

btsa/ 7 med par brlag: gzung 'dzin nag bsreg ye shes me dpung 'bar: nyon mongs g.yul bzlog bskal pa'i rlung dmar 'tshubs: bdud bgegs brlag pa'i rdo rje'i thog ser 'bebasaḥ sku dbyings dwangs gsal rgya mtsho lta bu'i klong: bde chen 'khor lor 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed ser nag khro gtum ral gri thod dbyug bsnams: long spyod 'khor lor dbang chen rta mgrin dmar dmar nag khro rgyal lcags kyi phur pa 'dril : chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag he ru ga: mthing nag gnam lcags rdo rje gri gug brten: sprul pa'i 'khor lor rdo rje gzhon nu ni: mthing gsal khro gtum rdo rje phur pa gdengs: bde skyongs 'khor lo bla med he ru ga: spug nag khro gtum thod rnga bhan+ta bsnams: brla g.yas dregs pa kun 'dul khro gar gtum: lha brgyad mgo bo tsit+ta bhan+ta rol brla g.yon stobs ldan nag po khro la sgeg: klu brgyad mgo bo tsit+ta thod zor thog:bsnams 'tshams dpal gyi bka' sdod gtso bo ni: rgyud sde srung mdzad legs ldan nag po ni: srin po khros pa'i nyams rgyas bam chen phyar: thod khrag bsnams shing rgyan dang cha

lugs rdzogs: dkyil 'khor pad+ma nyi zla gdan gyi khar: rig 'dzin rdo rje chos ni dmar skrug 'dzum: phyag gnyis thod rnga dril bu gsung snyan sgrogs: snang stong ye shes 'dzin medachen por bskyed: rtsa rlung thig le'i bkod pa bsam yas la: rgyud sde sgrub sde'i dkyil 'khor bsam yas 'gyed: snang stong 'dzin bral ye shes 'od skur bskyed: doyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba sras dang bcas : rigs lnga'i rnam par byon nas dbang bskur gyur: la bskyed gsal dag stong ba'i rim pa'o de nas spyana'adren bya ba'i rim pa na hūṃ trī rngams brjed rnga yab zangs mdog dpal gyi ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas chen po nas: 'gro ba'i mgon potsan rgyan thod phreng rtsal: gdug pa 'dul mdzad gu ru drag po'i sku: che mchog ra dbu 'bum rnam pa nas spyan 'dren sgrub pa po la dbang bzhi bskur: dus 'khrug mtshon chas gzeng ba bzlog pa dang: bde chen ye shes mchog thun dngos grub rtsol: sgo badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: de nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ram pa ni hūṃḥ chos nyid dbyings las drangs ba'i ye shes lha: gdan gsum tshang ba'i 'khor

'amatshu lor brtan par bzhugs: la snang 'gyur med phyag rgya'i lha tshogs la: rang gsal 'gags med klong nas phyag 'tshal lo: tho dz+nya na sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo bṛ na ma ho: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba' rim pa ni hūṃ hrī: 'od gsal sgyu ma'i lta bu dbyings klong las lhun 'grub 'gags med rang gsal mchod pa'i sprin: phyi nang gsang gsum rnam dag 'dzad med kyis: rig 'dzin bla ma'i la tshogs dgyes gyur cig: ma ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha ram̐ khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ trī bde chen spros pa bral ba'i ye shes las: lhan skyes 'gags med sku gsum lhun rdzogs gar: snyigs ma'i 'gro ba dmu rgod skyobs pa'i dpal: rak+ka dbu 'bum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye dang tshe rabs ma lus thams cad du: las nyon dbang gyur lha tshogs thugs 'gal bas: nyon mongs mi dge'i bya ba gang spyod pa: gnong 'gyod sems kyis mthol bshags bzod par bzhes:oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ā yi ge rgya ba bzla zhing lha ga lo bska sa rang nyid che mchog rakra dbu dbum rtsal gsal ba'i thugs gar yang dag he ru'i sgo klong dwangs gsal rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang du

thugs tsit+ta rin po che mchong gur phub pa ltar gsal ba'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa' gu rupad+ma thod phreng rtsal dmar po tshon gang ba rgyan med gcer bu 'od phung 'bar ba phyag gnyis ḍa ma ru dang thod khrag bsnams pa de yi thugs gar nyi steng gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nas 'bru tsam gyi lte ba zlum po'i dbus su nyi zla'i ga'u yungs 'bru tsam kha sbyor ba'i nang du thugs sgog hūṃḥdamar po spus bris pa tsam la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yas su kyi li li 'khor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul thugs rje'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus te bdag dang mdun bskyed phur pa'i dam rdzas la sib sib thim pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob par bsam: la bzlas pa bya yang 'od zer mar 'phros gang la gang 'dul gyis 'dza ba sems can thams cad la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs tshe dpal bsod nams thams cad bsdus nas bdag mdun la thim pas ye shes chen po'i dbyings su brtan pa thob par bsam

'a:tshu la: bzlas pa bya yang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros 'khor 'das snod bcudakyi dwangs ma tshe dpal nus bcud thams cad bsdus nas bdag mdun la thim pas dag grol mngon sangs rgyas par bsam la: bzlas pa bya yang bdag mdun gyi sku las thun mtshon lcags sdig grangs med 'phros chos byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa rnams rdul phran bzhin du brlag cing mi mthun pa'i g.yul las rgyal bar bsam la bzlas pa bya sa badz+ra gu ru kro dha rā dza ma hā mṛ he ru ka hūṃ badz+ra phaṭa: yengs med rtse gcag ting dzin dag pa sa bskul ma ni phyag rgya chen po'i gnad dang 'grogs gsal dag sto pa'i sgrom du bcud pa las phyi nang gsang ba'i 'grub rtags nges pa ra 'byu sa ma yā skabs su rtsa khamasalha tshogs bzlas bskul ni bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer mu med pa 'phros: rtsa khams kyi slo na bzhugs pa'i bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa phul: thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul: thugs rje'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub kyi char chen po bab: rtsa gnas thams cad khyab: bde stong ye shes kyi gtum mo bskul: rjes chags rang byung gi me

'bar rtog bral shugs 'byung gi rlung g.yos: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'du brdal: ma dag pa nyon mongs dug gsum gyi bag chags gtor: las rlung gi rgyu ba dbu mar dag: bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes nyams su myong bar bsam la rtsa sngags mthar oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shā ri badz+ra ki li gī la ya ma hā yakru ka la ru pa darma ram̐ re dz+wa la ram̐hūṃ phaṭa: a haṃ sarba sirnya pha la shā: phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags tshad ma byung bar ting 'dzan gnad gzir lha sngags phyag rgyas bcing ma 'da' rdo rje' dam tshag zab mo yis bskyed rdzogs bzlas dmigs bya ba'i ram pa'o sa ma yā yang bdag dang rtsa gnas kyi lha thams cad las khro chung me rlung sdigs phag khyung nag grangs med pa 'phros las ngan gyi rgyus bskyed pa'i shi 'dre grong 'dre rgyal bsen the'u rang dam sri 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad rdul du brlag: rnam shes 'og min gyi dbyings su spar dus mtha'i nad yam tsha rim 'byung po' sbyor ba gso ru mi btub pa ngos mi zin pa'i rigs thams cad sbur ma me dang 'phrad pa bzhin bsreg nas brdal khyab stong pa chen po'i rol par sad par bsam la drag sngags me ya 'khor lo' gsham du sarba du tra ra dza

ba:tshu rasmo yasmo shwa na mo bse rag gson 'dre mo the'u rang 'byung po thams cad ma ra ya phaṭa rbad sod: thim tha ra ti sa durnye dz+wa la ram̐ bha ye swā hā: dmigs gsal ldan pas spu gri'i 'khor lo 'di 'bum phrag bzla zhing rgyun du bskyar ba'i na phyi nang bar chad bdud las rnam pa ra rgyal the tshom med do rdo rje pad+ma'i bka' sa ma mā skabs su gtor ma skyesam phud bshams la brlabs lhar gsal ting 'dzan gnad dang mi 'bral bar rang nyid dpal chen po rag dbu 'bum las sprul pa'i khro chung grangs med pa 'phros bdud bgegs rgyal bsen 'byung po thams cad rdul du brlag par bsam la: rka gling bshug pa rol mo'i sgras bskul pa hūṃḥ ga ma drag rab 'jigs rngams pa'i pho brang nas: khro rgyal yongs 'dus rak+ka dbu 'bum rtsal: gdug pa 'dul ba'i smon lam dam bcas pa'i: mthu stobs mnga' bdag ye shes khro bo rje: thugs dam gnad bskul spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: byad ma rbod gtong 'khrul 'khor ngan pa bzlog: dus 'khrugs mtshon chas gzengs pa zhi ba dang: nad yams bskal ngan g.yo rtsub slong ba thul: rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhon sgrol: du

ru ka yi 'tshubs ma sna tshogs gzhom shi 'dre grong 'dres gson la 'tshe ba bzlog: rgyal 'gong dam sri'i cho 'phrul ngan pa bsgyur thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i brin las grub par mdzod hūṃ mi 'gyur chos dbyings brdal ba chen po las gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs che mchog he ru ga: gti mug gdon 'dul sgeg pa 'jigs rung sku: mthu stobs mnga' bdag ye shes lha mchog ni thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod (ཿ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal kun thugs kyi gsang ba mdzod 'dzin pa: zhe sdang gdon 'dul yang dag he ru ga: khro rgyal mthu stobs mnga' mdzad he ru ka thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: rnal 'byer bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaX sno ser nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan gsang ba 'dzin: nga rgyal gdon 'dul 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: las mdzad dpa' bo gar je mnga' bdag mchog: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: rnal 'byor

badz+ra bcol ba'i brin las grub par mdzodaḥ hūḥ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi mdzod 'chang ba: 'dod chags gdon 'dul dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal dmar nag me phreng bde chen ye shes skuḥ thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ (ཿljang nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal kun phrin las gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa: phrag dog gdon 'dul rdo rje gzhon nu che gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs dpal chen yongs rdzogs dpal: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ (ཿ sha khrag rgya mtsho 'byil ba'i dkyil 'khor nasaX rgyal kun bla med gsang ba'i mdzod chen 'dzin: mo rgyud gdon 'dul bla med he ru ga: mthu stobs dpal dang ldan pa'i ye shes skuḥ thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ hūṃ: thugs rjes gdung 'tshob sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rjes mdzod 'dzin paḥ gzung 'dzin gdon

'dul rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal: phyogs med rtsol bral ldan pa'i lha mchog nyid: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā rnal 'byor bcol ba'i brin las grub par mdzodaX hū:mazing gsal mtshon cha 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal kun 'jigs bral don dam mdzod 'dzin pa: rtogs tshogs kun 'joms dregs pa kun 'dul ni: 'jig rten sde brgyad kun gyi gshed po che: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i brin las grub par mdzodaX hūX gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal ba ma lus kun gyi gsang mchog 'dzin: dregs tshogs zil gyis gnon pa'i dpal chen po: stobs ldan nag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā:rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ (ཿ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bar khyams 'khor yug nas: rgyal ba kun gyi tha tshag la gnas pa'i: dgra bgegs rdul brlag dpal gyi bka' srung ni: rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan yab yum 'khor dang bcas: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ khyad par

gas( rnal 'byer bdag gis phrin bcol ba: phyi ru rgyal khams dus 'khrug nad yams dang btsa' sad ser gsum lo nyes bskal ngan bzlog: 'jigs brgyad dgra 'dre gdon gyis gzengs pa thul: nang du sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing : sangs rgyas bstan skyongs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod: rnal 'byor tshe bsrengs snyan pa'i ba dan phyor phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis dge mtshan spor: rdo rje'i snying po'i bstan pa phyogs bcur bskyed: rdzogs ldan lang tsho rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: gsang ba rnal 'byer bar chad rgud pa sol: rtsa rlung thig le'i dwangs bcud nyams pa gsos tshe bsod dpal 'byer dbang thang rlung rta bskyed: snyan grags gdul bya mdzad phrin rgyas pa dang:nyams rtogs yon tan phyogs bcu'i pha mthar rdol: dam sri nyu ming tsam med par rlog: gdul bya 'bum phrag dpal gyi ri la drongs: las ldan nyer lnga 'od skur grol bar mdzod: bka' dang dam tshigs la gnas dregs pa'i tshogs: rnal 'byer bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yu: ces bskul gser skyems

gtor ma gtsang sar gshegs gnad des phrin las rab 'byams gegs med 'grub phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad g.yul las rgyal ze tshom med do gu ru pad+ma'i bka' sa ma mā skabs su mchod cing bstod par bya ba la dbyangs gsal rten snying yag brgyas lag chad bskangs de nas mchod pa 'bul ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ trī: bla med gsang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dzab bsnyen mchod pa 'bul: lha tshogs sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul: nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bzod par gsol: bde chen ye shes dngos grub stsal du gsol: ka ma hā pañca puts+tsha la khā hi: de nas bstod par bya ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ trī ma bcos sprol bral bla ma chos kyi sku : rang bzhin ma 'gag bla ma long spyod rdzogs thugs rje zang thal bla ma sprul ba'i sku: rigs 'dus rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'bum phrag gdul bya 'dren pa'i dbu mar pas: log rtog rang sar sgrol ba'i phyag dang ldan: sgrub sde yongs rdzogs spro ba'i brda thabs bsgyur : rak+ta thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshogs brgyad rang grol gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad: 'gyur med rang grol gu

pa( — ru sde lnga rdzogs: nyon mongs rang grol dkyil 'khor lha rnams shar: mchog gi rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du:lha mchog khyod dang 'bral med smon lam stobs: bar chad bdud kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin zas kyi 'tsho ba dang: nyams rtogs yon tan nar son rig 'dzin gyi: go 'phang myur du grub pa'i dngos grub cesal: ces pas gsol gdab yo sa su 'grub pa da phya nang gsang ba' g.yul las rnams pa ra rgyal 'di phya'i dge mtshan yon tan gong 'phel rgyas dang sa gzhi nyams len rim pasnyi rgya sa ma ya gsum pa rjes kya rims pa rnam gsum las dang po tshogs kyi 'khor lor bskor ba la bza' bca' btung ba' rigs rnams 'tshogs par spungs rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis dang po byin gyis brlabs pa' rim pa ni hūṃḥ rang nyid lha yi sku ru gsal ba yi thugs ga'i /:las 'od zer reḥyeḥkhoḥ 'phros pas tshogs kyi nyes skyon bsreg gtor bkrus rdo rje lta bu'i me rlung chu ru bsgyur: slar yang snying po 'bru gsum 'phros pa las: snyed las sku yi bdud rtsi dkar la 'tsher: āḥlas gsung gi dwangs bcud dmar gsal bskyil: hūṃḥgis 'gyur

med thugs kyi bdud rtsi mthing rgyal kun ye shes chen por byin gyis rlabs reḥyeḥkhaṃ: ma āḥ(ཿ lan gsum gnyis pa tshogs zhi spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ hrī bde chen rngams brjed rnga yab dpal gyi ri pho brang pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: 'gro ba'i mgon po rakru dbu 'bum rtsal: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mi 'gyur 'od gsal bde chen pho brang mchog: lhun grub 'gags med rang byung dkyil 'khor nas che mchog dpal dgu bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:gang shar rang grol dag pa'i zhing khams nas: 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje khro lod rtsal rgyud dang sgrub sde'i wa tshogs ma lus rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rig 'dzin sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol: ma badz+ra sa ma ya ja dza: gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ hrī: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañca a dṛ ta: 'dod yon lnga ldan ye shes mchod pa che: rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin chen po: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus 'bul lo bzhes snye ma hwa ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa la kha ram̐ khā hiX de nas bskang ba bya ba'i ram pa ni hūṃ hrī ka

bsgo/: dag gdod nas mngon sangs rgyas pa yi chos sku kun tu bzang po'i thugs dam bskangasaḥrang gsal 'gags med bde chen lhun grub pa'i longs sku snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskangasaX ma chags dri bral thugs rjes 'gro ba skyobs:sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs dam bskangasaḥdur khrod chen po brgyad la brdul zhugs mdzad:sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad thugs dam bskangasaḥye shes lnga ldan nyon mongs rang sar grol:gu ru thod phreng sde lnga'i thugs dam bskangs:rngams brjid thod mkhar bde chen dkyil 'khor nas:dpal chen rdo rje khro lod thugs dam bskangasaḥbade stong zag pa med pa'i ye shes bskyed:mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskangasaXsnyigs ma'i dus 'khrug nad yams rab gzhom pa'i rak+ka dbu 'bum rtsal gyi thugs dam bskangs gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes sku:che mchog yon tan lha tshogs thugs dam bskangasaX zhe sdabhe rang grol me long ye shes sku:yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥng rgyal shar grol mnyam nyid ye shes sku:'jam dpal sku yi lha

tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥ'adod chags klong grol sor rtog ye shes sku:pad+ma gsubhe gi lha tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥphrag dog mnyam nyid bya grub ye shes sku:phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bska saXrbod gtong g.yul bzlog bla med ye shes sku:ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs thugs rjes brtse bas sgrub mchog rjes su 'dzin:rig mchog thod pa rtsal gyi thugs dam bskangs dregs pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus tshar gcod pa'i:'jig rten mchod bstod la tshogs thugs dam bskangs ngan sngags gdug pa'i g.yul ngo rab bzlog pa'i dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥbaka' nyan dam tshig mchog la gnas pa yi:dpal gyi bka' srung lha tshogs thug dam bskangs byin rlabasadangos grub 'byung ba'i gter chen po:bla ma dgongs 'dus lha tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥgasang gsum 'gyur med gshis kyi gnas lugs mchog 'dus pa mdo yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥzung 'jug 'ub chub rol pa'i pho brang nas:sgyu 'phrul rgyan gyi la tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥ

bsnye bde chen ye shes yangs pa'i pho brang nas:bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskangs rtsa rlung thig le rang grol pho brang nas:dpal mchog gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ'adzin rtog dbu ma'i dbyings sgrol pho brang nas:'gyur med kyi rdor la tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥgasang ba bla med yongs rdzog pho brang nas:dpal ldan dus 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥbastan bshig rū tra bsgral ba'i pho brang nas:'jigs byed gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs rab 'byams phrin las lhun grub pho brang nas:gaka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangasaḥphyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun sel ba'i:srog bdag las byed sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs:hrīḥthugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni:phyi mchod nyer spyod bdun gyis thugs dam bskangasaḥnang mchod 'dod yon lnga yi thugs dam bskangs gsang mchod sman gtor rak+tas thugs dam bskangasaḥyang gsang sbyor sgrol mchog gis thugs dam bska saX bla med ga ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskangasaXrmad byung lta spyod dag

pas thugs dam bskangasaḥgrags stong snying po 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskangs rkyen snang rang grol glu gar thugs dam bskangasaḥdug lnga rang grol rigs ma lnga yis bskangs:gzung 'dzin rnam dag ye shes chen pos bskangs dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskangs snang ba shes rab 'bar ba'i ngang du bskangs:sdug bsngal bde stong zag pa med par bskangs:'khor ba rang grol kun tu bzang por bskangs:'das pa dag mnyam gzhon nu bum skur bskangs:kun rdzob 'khrul 'khor don dam dbyings su bskangasaḥlta ba blo 'das khyab brdal yangs bar bskangs:sgom pa rang grol dmigs gtad bral bar bska sa:spyod pa dag mnyam 'dzin rtsol bral bar bskangs:'bras bu rang byung ye sangs rgyas par bskangs:bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin rnams dag pas:ma bcos khyab brdal rang grol lhug par ā:lnga pa bshags pa bya ba'i rim pa ni hūṃḥdapang gyur skyabs mchog rig 'dzin bla ma dang:yi dam yongs 'dus rdo rje khro bo lod:gdug pa 'dul mdzad drag po dbu 'bum rje dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus dgongs su gsol:bdag

bsgo/: ni gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te: gsang sngags sor byang mchog gi sdom pa las: 'gal 'khrul nyams par gyur ba ci song yang: snying nas 'gyod pas bshags so bzod par gsol: ces badz+ra sa ma ya a: yi ge brgya ba bzla zhang jongs pa bshags drug pa tshogs bsgral bya ba'i rim pa mi hūṃ rngams brjed srin yul thod pa'i sku mkhar nas: 'gro ba'i mgon po rak+ka thod phreng rtsal sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po ma g.yel bar: snyigs ma'i rū dra 'byung po bsgral ba'i phyir: dpal chen rak+ka dbu 'bum skur bzhengs la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs lus la mtshon char phob: gnod byed rdul du rlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: sa badz+ra ma hā gu ru hūṃ sarba ༄ dra ma ra ya rbad sod: bdun pa bstab pa' rim pa 'di ltar ro hūṃḥ chos nyid mi 'gyur gsal ba'i zhal phyes shig: rnam rtog rū dra bsgral ba'i phung po khams: skye mched lhag ma med par zhal du bstabs bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā twe sarba ru dra ma hā me sa rak+ta tsit+ta ba su ta ko ro tsa na king ni ri ti la kha kha khahi khā hiḥ brgyad pa lhag ma 'bul ba' ram pa ni hūṃ bh+yoḥ sngon tshe dpal chen spran sngar khas blangs

pa'i: bka' nyan dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang: ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma chen mo brgyad: zhing chen bco brgyad lang ka bcu drug dang: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas : 'dir gshegs bstan la gdub ba'i mos gus kyis dam rdzas gtsang ma'i lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan skyongs sgrub la rtag tu srungs:rnal 'byor rkyen sol las bzhi lhun grub mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' dam tshag can sarba sa ma ya u tsu ḍa bha lirnyi kha ram̐ kha twe dgu pa chad mdo bstan ma skyong ba ni hūṃ bh+yoḥsngon tshe kun bzang che mchog he ru ga': spyan sngar khas blang dam la bzhag pa yi: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu la sogs pas: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang: dam rdzas gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: sgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam:rnal 'byer sku tshe bsreng sa bar ma chad dam rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bsal bar ma chad dam: rdo rje snying po spel bar ma chad dam: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la sngon gyi chad don dam tshig dran mdzod cig: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā:sno de 'og

bsgo/ rgya gar 'phags yul chen po na slob dpon pad+ma dur khrod brgyad bzhugs nas: ma mo mkha' 'gro dpal mgon bdun cu sogs: khas blangs dam bzhag srung ma rgya mtsho rnams: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang: dam rdzas gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: sgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam:rnal 'byor sku tshe bsrengs bar mchad dam: rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bsal bar ma chad dam: rdo rje snying po spel bar ma chad dam: 'dod yon brgyan pa 'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi chad don dam tshig dran mdzod cig bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yu: nyu: de 'og gang chen bod yul dben gnas su: rig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma dbang chen gyis: ma mgon gza' rdor spu gri mched gsum sogs: khas blangs mna' bor dam can rgya mtsho rnams rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang: dam rdzas gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: sgrub pa' bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam:rnal 'byor sku tshe bsrengs bar ma chad dam :rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bsal bar ma chad dam:rdo rje snying po spel bar ma chad dam: 'dod yon

brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ sngon gyis mtshod don dam tshig dran mdzod cig: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: hū: rgya bal bod yul sa mtshams bsrung ba dang: mu steg kla kle'i mgo 'phang bcom pa'i phyir: gar gyi dbang phyug rdo rje thod phreng gis: bstan ma ya ma skyongs ma bcu gnyis po: bka' la bzhag cing lce la bdud rtsis bran: dam rtags rdo rje gtad nas spyi bor bcings: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas thob par lung bstan gnang: gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung ba'i gnyer byang gtad: dam ldan rig 'dzin skyongs ba'i tha tshag bsgos: sngon tshe pad+mas dam bzhag dran mdzod la: da lta rnal 'byor bdag gis ci bcol sgrubs: ma ma hrīng la la le le rta rta te te sring 'gro ma bha lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi: bcu pa rta bro mnan pa 'a rim pa ni hūṃ beḥ pho brang 'bar ba e yi dkyil 'khor du: gzung 'dzin rū tra dam sri 'byung po brub: mnan no ma shor ma ldang sku gsum rgya nam yang ma 'da' byang chub sems rgyas 'debs: tshon ā hūṃ swā hā: stam bha ya nan: de nas mchod cing bstod pa grub nas slar bcu gcig dang sa grub blangs pa'i rim pa ni he gsang gsum 'gyur

ba:tshu med bde ba chen po'i dbyings: lha tshogs thugs rje byin rlabs nyi ma 'khrungs sgrub pa po yi rig pa'i lo 'dab rgyas: tshe dpal myu gu 'khrung ba'i dbang na ngos grub: da lta nyid du bdag la rtsal du gsol: dbang bzhi'i dngos grub chu rgyun ltar 'bebs nas lhan skyes dpa' bo chen po'i zhal mthong nas: rang rig gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par thegag: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya wāk+ka tsat+ta sarba sidhi pha la hūṃḥ bcu gnyis bsngo ba smon lam gdab pa ni na mo: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba ci mchis pa: zag dang zag sted las rnams gcig bsdus nas: 'khor gsum yongs dag khyab brdal chen por bsngo: phyam gcig gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par regag: lan gsum bcu gsum rtag chad mtha' bsal bya ba ni ā: snang cha lhun grub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams bde chen rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' la bsdu: slar yang mkha' las glog 'od 'khyug pa bzhin: snang stong phyag rgyas sgyu pa'i rnal 'byor spyod: a ā hūṃX bcu bzhi bkra shis bsdo da pa 'i rim pa ni na mo kun gzhi chos khams chos skur sangs: gdod ma'i kun bzang bkra shis shog: gting gsal phra ba'i ye

zhes gdangs: snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis re ga: rtsol med rang byung sprul pa'i sku: pad+ma 'byung gnas bkra shis shog: log 'khrul 'khor ba'i mtsho mo skems: raka thod phreng bkra shis shog: bde stong zag pa med pa'i gter bdun brgya nyer lnga'i bkra shis shog khyab brdal phyogs mtha' yas pa'i klong: rdo rje snying po'i bkra shis shog: sgrub pa'i bar chad sel mdzad pa'i: dam can srung ma'i bkra shis shog: dam pa chos kyis khams gsum khyab: bde legs mchog gi bkra shis re ga: ces sogs dga' ston bsngo smon rgya chen bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag dbang bzha thob phyi nang bar chad ma lus sel bar 'gyur the tshom med do gu ru pa d+ma' bka' sa ma yu gnyis pa bsru ba'i 'khor lo bra ba' thabs shog dkar dbus su ma la dang bzang drug gis mu khyud rim pa lnga ru bkod par bya dbus su drag po 'i sku gzugs srog yig bcas mu khyud gnyis par 'di bzhin bri bar bya mo badz+ra ma hā gu rba gro dha rwa dza byurnya he ru ka hūṃ pha ṭa oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa ri badz+ra kai li ki pa ya ma hā yasna ka la ru pa na ram ram dz+wa la ram hūṃ phaṭa mu khyud gsum par 'di bzhin gsal bar bkod yo badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa hūṃ phaṭa pa d+ma sha ba ri phaṭa nan par shig na ga nan tadu thā sarba wi ra ta ha na ha na badz+re na rakra

btsa(: rakraḥ 'chang ba po'i lus ngag yad gsum la dus min 'chi rkyen nad yams rims gdon nag po gsum sbrel ltas mtshan ngan pa byad phur rbod gtong 'jigs tshogs ma mthun pa 'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad shirnye ku ru ye swā snya mu khyud bzhi par dbyangs gsal rten snyi mjug dkyil 'khor lha tshogasarnams kyisasku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams 'gyur ba med par rab tu gnas shi rab tu bstan pa ra gyur cig yo su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā mu khyud lnga par ye shes me ri bri dzos ni yungs dkar spang spos ngad can dang gla rtsa mu zi shu dag nag po dang klu bdud rdo rje pha 'ong long bu dang ran chen bye ma ja nyi rnam rgyal dang gas rdzas dkar dmar byugs shing tshon gyis dkris: dal gyi dbus gzhugs phyi nang mchod pas bstor 'od zer 'phro 'dusargyal kun byin rlabs bstims me tog 'thor zhang rab tu gnas par bya gza' skar bzang po 'phrod sbyor 'dzom pa 'a dus mgul du btags shing 'bral med bcang ba des tshe da bsod dmas dpal 'byor gong 'phel rgyas bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rnam pa ra rgyal: ze tshom med do gu ru pad+ma'i bka' sa ma phu gsum pa rjes kyi ral bu bya ba ni gtso bo a ru gser mdog nyid la bya blon po bong nag bong dkar bong ser dmar gtso bo yungs dkar yungs nag gla nag rtsa gsangs na spang spos shu dag tang chen dang rgya tsha dom mkhris cu gang gur kum li mu zi nag po ru rta bcu po gdab: chang gi

brlan cing rdo yi steng du btags tshag ma bkod nas phye mar gyur pa las spang rtsi sdong ros bsnan nas ril bu bya che chung tshad kyang sran ma'i myog po'i tsam mtshal gyas mdog bsgyur ran chen lcags snod bzhag rnam lngas bskor la bsangs khrus sngon du bya sgrub pa byed cang lha ru shes pa gsal bzlas pa'i dmags rim bsgyur ba'i bya ba la che ril bu rnams khrag 'thung rakru dbu 'bum zhal phyag rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs pa grangs med pa nyi rdul 'brags pa ltar gsal ba'i sku las me rlung lcags sdigs grangs med pa 'phros nas dus mtha'i nad yams rim gdon 'byung po thams cad sbur ma me la bsreg par gyur: rtsa sngags mthar skyid a ra pa tsa mi ta hrī dwa ye swā hā sarba dz+wa ra pra ro/ ma ṇi swā hā brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs ci 'grub bskyar de nas dngos grub blangs shing shel bum gzhug tsha grang rkyen gyis ma gos legs par bzhag tsha ram gnyan nad dus nad ngan pa sel rgyab brten gdon kyang nye mi nus par 'gyur bden rdzun lag du longs dang nges shes gsal byin rlabs zab khyad rdzogs so rjes 'jug rnams bslu ba med do gu ru pad+ma' bka' mtha' sdud rjes kyi rim pa snyi rgya sa ma pā ye ma ཿbdag 'dra o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng ngas snying gi yang bcud shan tu zab pa' gter byin rlabs nus pa 'i gter chen rdzogs pa yi zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa mchog rmad byung ye shes mchog gi gsang lam 'di grub

gtsa/ pa'i dab phyug khye'u chu khyod la gtad da lta spel ba' dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la thob cig mtsho rgyal ma mdo khams rtse shod gshams du dgongs pra thob ma 'ongs lnga brgya snyags ma'i dus kyi tshe nad du ngos mi zin pa'i rims yams 'byung gdon ni rwa dza shi gson dam grar gyur dam chos sgrub la bar chad sna dgu 'byung bla slob sde dpon bar la phra ma byed bstan pa'i 'od snod khrag gis bskyil ba 'byung sad ser btsa' than 'khrug pas mu ge ldang dmag jag mtshon chas bze'i sa pa sna dgu dar sngags pa dmar las bu gos bya mang 'byung btsun pa khrel med spyang gi rgyab ser mang nga sprul yin zer gter rdzun sna dgu 'gyed kye 'gro mang po'i kha lo sdag la bsgyur lha dang srung ma'i bka' chad sna dgu ston de dus mdo khams a lcags 'bru rigs 'dzan grub pa'i gdung 'dzin sngags kyi rnal 'byor ba khye'u chung khyod kyang nus ldan 'dusapa rtsal rtogs pa klong rdol dpa' bo chen por bzhengs de yas khams kyi tsā ra' myo phyogs nas ra chen 'gyur med gsang mdzod gter nas bton de dus 'byu ban dharmā rtse mang nyid pad+ma chos 'phel dge btsun brtul zhugs can gter kha yongs kyi chos bdag dpa' bor shar gnubaban badz+ra sa mu dra nyid ni las bzhi sgrub pa 'i bka' bab dam pa'o 'o bran rim brgyudadharmā kirte nyid go cha la lnga sgrub pa'i gnyer kha thob shrī mtshan can smad las drag skor dbang rat+na'i mtshan can bskyed rdzogs lam la

rargyar bratsa'imatshan can rten 'brel nyes sel gtad sur ya'i mtshan la mthu gtad rags rnams sbyin de sogs ma nor yang dag ston nus na las ldan nyer lngas bstan pa'i 'gro don 'byung lho byang gnyis las gdul bya 'bum ga 'dren zang thal bsgrod pa'i skal ldan rigs lnga 'byung the tshom med do pad+ma bdag gi bka' bka'i srung ma shan dmar yasga nag bcud kya drod 'dzin spu gra mched gsum bskos skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya las can steng gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya zab rgya sbas rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya snyi ces pa 'di 'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshosarin chen dang po sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bkra shas lha reg na gar po dbang lnga'i cod pan gser ldan reg bya bri gzhi shog dkar zhal gsu rdo rje'i sgras yang yang bskul ba dang rang slob dharma gartis zhabs brtan pa' skyes dang bcas nye gnas dz+nyā na zhes pa'i kyang bskul ba' ngor bdag 2dra dpa' bo nus na 'dus pa rtsal rgyasamado khams tsā ri'i lho phyogs gsod nams rgyas pa 'i mtsho las bton te mi lo dgu la bka' rgyas btab nas mthar rten 'brel dus la bab tshe chos kyi grogs po ma da mkha' 'gro rnams rkya yang thang brdas bskul ba la brten nas mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i shog ser las zhal bshus te dag par phab sa dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ legs so/ sarba maṅga lam/

ga(: zab gsang rdo )snying po las: dpal chen bla ma drag po'i yi: hūṃḥsgrub thig le'i rgya can las thom med rgyal rān lde la 'brab sgrub bde ba'i 5byungs gnas bzhugs so: ba tshu na༄ gu ru padha ka ra la 4/shathutha41 las can sgrub geng rus can bskyed rdzogs lhur len byed pa 'i tshe nyer mkho'i rgyal chen sde bzha yi zab sgrub ma med gab yig bstan sa ma mā las gzhung bsrang la sde lnga' mgor sprad pa 'i tshul ni 'di ltar ste dokyal 'khor bsnyegs /zharapad+ma nyi zla'i steng: shar du rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dkar /sal zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan pi waṃ bsgyur dung rmog dung khrab rat+nas sag lham brgyan: 'od 'bar 'ja' sprin khu sbrang 'khrigs pa'i klong: las byed dri za'i dmag dpung 'bum ) nga bcas zhi ba'i las mdzad snang stong 'od skur bskyed: lho phyogs rgyal rwa chon sku'iphags skyes po: sngon po khro gtum am gtsigs man du bsdams: shes rab ral gri ngar 4 phred byang ba: lngags rmog khrab dang dar dpyang sag lam mdzes me dud rlang gsum rab tu 'khrigs pa'i dbus bka' nyan gral bum dmag tshogs 'bum dang bcas: drag

po'i las mdzad ye shes 'od skur bskyed: nub phyogs rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang: dmar gsal 'dzum sgeg mdangs ldan brjid pa'i sku: shel gyi mchod rten sprul gyi zhags pa bsnams: zangs rmog zangs khrab dar dang rat+nas brgyan: me dud rlung sprin 'khrigs pa'i gur khang dbus las mdzad klu dbang dmag tshogs 'bum dang bcas: dbang gi las mdzad snang stong 'od skur bskyed: byang phyogs rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: sku mdog ser gsal gzi brjid 'od phung 'bar: mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan 'dod 'byung ne'u le 'dzin: gser rmog gser khrab dar dpyangs rus rgyan spras: ye shes me dang 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong: las mdzad gnod sbyin pho nya 'bum dang bcas: rgyas pa'i las byed stong gsal 'od skur bskyed: kun gyi thugs srog rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rang bzhin gar bzhugs pho brang nas: lha tshogs spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstims: tshe be+e dhi ta ras ṭa ye sarba sirnyi hūṃḥ āX be+e ra da ka ye sarba sirnyi hūṃ: tshe be+e ru pak+ta ye sarba sidhi rgyu: tshe be+e shrī ma ṇa ye sarba sidhi hūṃ: rang sngags 'bum bzlas nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel phrin las
༷ ༷ rje de

pa(: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dpal chen bla ma drag po yi: shāḥsgrub thig le'i rgya can las: bden pa'i stobs bzlog byad ma rdul du brlag pa zhes bya ba bzhugs dregaḥ 'a tshu na mo gu ru shra kro ta ra dza ye 2rartakasgogru1 ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe mi mthun nyer 'tshes mnar gyur na bden pa 'i stobs bzlog zab mo yi gnad 'di shin tu gces pa ra zung sa rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa 'i mthu bslu med don la yid ches bya na mo: chos sku longs sku sprul pa'i sku: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun sde: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bden gnyis baspu med nus mthu dang: khyad par rdo rje khro bo lod: yab yum 'khor bcas bden stobs kyis: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams bzlog: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams bzlog: ban gyi byad phur mnan gtad bzlog bon gyi btso zor than dgu bzlog lha byad skar mda' thog zer bzlog: klu byad mdze tshom gnyan nad bzlog: mu stegs ngan sngags dmod sbor bzlog: sde brgyad g.yos pa'i dal kha bzlog: mi nag ste ba'i yos kha bzlog: ngan smas gleng mo bra mchu bzlog

nad yam 'tshub ma lang ba bzlog: rgya 'dre 'byung po'i la yog bzlog dme 'khrug mtshon chas rgol ba bzlog: sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin bzlog: gegs bdud sri yi rigs rnams bzlog: rta phyug nor gyi god yam bzlog: 'byung lnga'i g.yo 'khrug brda ba bzlog: du ru ka yis gzengs pa bzlog mi mthun mi 'dod phyogs rnams bzlog: sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la bzlog gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la bzlog za bar byed pa'i 'dre la bzlog: phung bar byed pa'i sri la bzlog byad ma'i nus mthu byad mar bzlog byad ma'i ngan sngags byad mar bzlog: byad ma'i phung 'byed byad mar bzlog: byad ma'i lus la bh+yo rbad nan: byad ma'i ngag la bh+yo rbad nan: byad ma'i yid la bh+yo rbad nan bzlog cig bsgyur zhig mā ra ya: ces pa bden stobs brjod gyur na thams cad ma lus bzlog par byed rig sngags byad ma'i 'khrul 'khor yang rtsad nas gcod cing drungasa'abyin 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma mā snyes hūṃ dza dza sheg khrom bh+yo: ma ni ma ra ṇi bh+yo: ma ra du na bh+yo: rasmo raku bh+yo ting ya rak+ka bh+yo: sarba du bh+yo: gī la ya bh+yo: gnod byed kyi sgog rtsa la bh+yo: byad zor phur kha bzlog bh+yo

ba tshu yang bzlog spu gri'i 'khor lo byad ma 'bum bzlog gi gzer tig ngan sngags dug gri nag po' rgyud zhes bya'o nus ldan pas so phrin bcol ni hūṃ hrī:rdo rje gar dbang pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dregs pa tshar gcod skur bzhengs khro bo lod:rgya bal bod phyon lha srin kun bsdus nas:gnad dbab sgog gzir mna' tho bor gzhugs tshe:dam chu lcer bzhag bka' rtags rdo rje bcing zab pa mi nyams rin chen sa yi gter:mtshan bcas dbyings sbyar dag snang 'phrul gyi mdzod:dgongs pa mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter:brgyud pa gcig 'dres rig mdangs snyan brgyud skor:sdon gnas rjes su dran pa'i man ngag sgrom bi ma'i gsang bcud lce btsun yang gter sogs:sher phyin 'dus mdo bka' la dbang thob pa'i:chu bo bdun ldan gter gyi dbang phyug gis rgyu dang 'bras bu thugs kyi bstan pa yis:gdul bya'i khams rnams smin grol mdzad bskyangs tshe:bzhed don ma lus yongs su sgrub byos zhes:gnyer thob khas blangs dam tshig 'di min nam:g.yel na bka' sdod khyed rnams nyams ta re:'da' dka' sngags ral na rag zug rngus gzir:

de phyir gangs ljongs la mi'i mgon gcig pu:o rgyan chen po'i bka' bgo phyag bzhes ltar:skye rgu yongs la dge bcu'i chos khrims sdoms:'gal ba can la bka' yi chad pa chod:gzu bor gnas la legs pa'i mdangs bzang ston:thub bstan mdo dang rang lugs gsang ba sngags:bka' bzhin skrub la dngos grub char ltar phob gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa'ang spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur:sde gnyis bshad sgrub gzhi 'dzug thugs mthun bzhin 'gro don mi g.yel dam bca' khur lci bas:dge mtshan chos kyi nyi ma 'od po che'i mdzad brin zer brgyas yangs pa'i khams kun khyab:rmongs pa blo yi grub pa'i mtha' 'gog bzhin:a ti 'bras bu'i rig par kun drangs nas rig 'dzin 'ja' lus rdo rje'i bshul lam la:dka' ba med par tshe 'dir 'khod par shog:smon tshig gsol ba btab pa'i re 'bras rnams:gegs med yid bzhin sgrub mdzod sa ma ya:'jig rten gsum na grags pa'i bkra shis dang phywa g.yang dge mtshan chos srid dar zhing rgyas rdzogs ldan gsar tshes lta bus 'tsho ba dang:don gnyis lhun grub dpal la mnga' brnyes re ga

gtsaX ces brjod skyems gtor bsangs nang du phul la rol mo rgyas pa ra byasan phrin las rnam pa bzhi gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub pa ra 'gyur ro sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya zhes pa 'di 'ang zab gter spyi la sbyar chogs pa'i srung ma'i phrin las bcol yang dgos khro lod (ཿsgrub la nyer bar mkho phyiranusaldan rdo rjesasgrub pa 'i thun gseng zhag la brda mdzod las shar mar spel ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo lam/

pa(: zab gsang rdo rjesnying po las dpal chen rdo rje khro lod kyi: smisgrub zig le'i rgya can las lha mo rang byung rgyal mo'igasol mchod bstan dgra'i dpung 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so: badz+ra na mo gu ru paṅgā ka ra pe gagabang basmo/ ma 'ongasalas ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa 'i tshe bar chad dgra yi rkyen bzlog phyir bstan srung sgrub pa zab mor brtson sa ma yu de yang bco brgyad rdzas yo byad bsags 'gugs gzhug bas sa sbyangs byin gyis brlabs rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis srung ma mdun du gsal byas te hū spyoḥ mu le mazing gi mtsho gling du: dbang bsgyur sangs rgyas bstan srung ba: lha mo rang byung rgyal mo dang: skem ma chu srin mgo bo can: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: ma mo 'bum phrag yangs pa'i 'khor: ma lus lus pa med pa ru dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs: bla rdo sgog 'khor brten la bzhugs: brin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal : gdung dbyangs rol mo'i sgra yis bstod: rgyal bstan srung bar mnga' gsol lo: dgyes bskyed mchod pa 'bul ba ni dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: nal ba'i gsur dud sna tshogs

dang:mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas rigs:nyer spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan gyis:dpal ldan lha mogasol zhing mchod:skem ma chen mo gsol zhing mchod:sku yi ma mo gsol zhing mchod:gsung gi ma mo gsol zhing mchod thugs kyi ma mo gsol zhing mchod:yon tan ma mo gsol zhing mchod:grin las ma mo gsol zhing mchod grub 'degs ma mo gsol zhing mchod:ro kha ma gsum gsol zhing mchod:dmag rgyal ma lnga gsol zhing mchod:gdong mched bzhi gsol zhing mchod:gsang ba'i ma gsum gsol zhing mchod:sbas pa'i ma gsum gsol zhing mchod 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro gsol zhi mchod:dbang phyug nyer brgyad gsol zhing mchod:brtan ma bcu gnyis gsol zhing mchod:sprul 'khor bsam yas gsol zhi mchod:khyed rnams mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis:rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa pos:bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe 'tsho ba sbyor la 'khor slob sdud nad mug mtshon 'khrug gzengs pa bzlog:dus kyi rgud pa mtha' dag sol:phyogs las rnam rgyal snang ba stsol:khyad par zab gsang rdor snying gi:bstan pa phyogs

ba tshu bcu'i pha mthar spel: gdul zhing sgrub mchog pho mo rnams: 'od skur grol ba'i phrin las mdzod: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor skyemasagatsang sar gshegs 'dod don gang bcol phrin las te gegs med yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma mā e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha la' ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis snyang 'dra'i man ga zab pa' skor 'brog mi lo tsā khyod la gtad da du ma spel brda la zob mi 'gyur bkra shis rdzo dus thob klu bdud btsan la gnyer byang gtod ma 'ongs snyigasam lnga yi dus nga sprul rol ba'i rdo rje yis bgo skal dam pa 'di rted nas bstan dang 'gro ba' phan bde spel don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya la mo rang byu rgyal mo'i gsol mchod bstan dgra'i dpung 'joms rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya o rgyan gya sgrob dpon pad+ma saṃ rgya wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim lha ces pa 'ad 'ang chos kyi bdag po 'gyur med rgya mtsho dang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel gnyis kyis rin chen dang po yid 'ong sbos shel bkra shis lha reg bcas te yang yang bzhed ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes dpal ldan brag lha mgon po'i gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni pad+ma smon lam pas so sarba ma lam/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo dze+esnying po las dpal chen bla ma drag po yi (ཿsgrub nig lelirgya can las: srung ma sde lnga'i 'khrugs bskang 'khru ldog tshar gcodazhes bya ba bzhugs so: badz+ra: na mo gu ru parnya ka ra ye canarten10tsa/snyeg bdag 'dra pad+ma sa snya was ma 'ongs las ldan don phyir du srung ma sgrub pa 'a las sbyor gyi cha lag 'brugs bskang zab ma bstan sa ma yu sha khrag dmar gtor ja chang skyems bza' bca' btu ba ldag gzhib rags bsags la bsangs sbyangs byin gyis rlabs rol mo sna tshogs sgra bcas te snyan pa 'a dbyangs kyi 'di skad do hūṃ bye gsang sngags rgyud sde'i gnyer 'dzin bstan bsrung ba: legs ldan nag po kro ti shwa ri yum: zhing bcu'i dgra sgrol shan pa me ru rtse: drag shul bdag po bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong/spyan gcig khrag khol g.yu yi zur phud can: sgrub mchog grogs mo dpal ldan re ma ti: rang rang g.yog 'khor sprul ba dpung dang bcas: ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'diragashegs su gsol: sgrub mchog bu la lus dang grib ltar 'grogs: bdag ni ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa sogs lha mchog khyed

rnams thugs dang 'gal ba'i las: ci bgyis gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol zhing bshags: gsang sngags khrom bsgrags gsang ba'i dam nyams shing: gzhung bzhin ma spyad bde dga' rang gar bltas legs ldan nag po'i thugs dang 'gal ba'i las: ci bgyis gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol zhing bshags: lta ba 'phang dmas chos nyid don ma rtogs:sgom pa yun thung rig rtsal ngang ma rdzogs spyod pa nor 'khrul rtag chad mthar ltung ste: shan dmar thugs 'gal las bgyis bzod par gsol: rdo rje khros pas bstan dgra ma bsgral zhing: snying rje chen pos 'gro ba rjes ma bzung: yid dam lha sgom ti 'dzin bsags sbyang ral: drag shul bdag po'i thugs 'gal gyur ba bshags: 'gyur med mnyam nyid ka dag don ma rtogs: dag mnyam 'ub chub rang grol gshis ma gsal: bde rtsol bde ba'i ye shes zhal ma mjal: sngags bdag chen mo'i thugs 'gal dri ma bshags mgar yug nyer brten bong dril brten brdung byas: sha rkyang gsod gcod bya nag phag rdzi bskrad: thab gzhob byi nal mkhon 'dzangs la sogag pas: rang byung

badz+ra rgyal mo'i thugs dang 'gal ba bshags: khyed rnams dga' na gdod ma'i sa la sbyor: khros na srid pa gsum gyi legs nyes ston: de phyir mthun rdzas namamakha'akhams gang bas: sgog bdag sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang zhing bshags: dgyes te ma bu lta bu'i dam tshig gis: gang bsam don 'bras gegs med 'grub par mdzod thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā ces brjod gtor skyems gtsa sar gshegs gnad des phrin las gang bcol 'grub ldog pa'i rkyen las rnam pa ra rgyal the tshom med do sa ma yu ril bskyed dag snang la bum pa spyo las gzhal med khang mdzes khang: ril bu bla ma yab yum mnyam sbyor sku til gong gyur bzhin 'khor 'das mnyam nyid bsre: ma rig mun bsreg rig pa sku gsum zhal snyen ar+yāḥswā ྅ hūṃḥshā ཿtsho gyenya sabo ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca maḥ a yudz+nyā na ma hā purmye tiṣ+ṭa maḥ kun la sbyar na byan rlabs che bar ma sa ra dzas gsu sa so nus lan rdo rjes bris pa maṅka lam/ (ཿ lha mo dkar mdzes bde ster rnams 'gyur can chos kun mnyam pa nyid ston 'char ga'i 'dzum: chags bral ku mud rgyas pa'i lang tsho can dag chen rgyas 'debs in+t+ra mdzes pa'i

zhal thams cad chos skur mnyam sbyor be+eḍūr mdangs snang stong gnyis med glu dbyangs gar chen brgyur: dkyil 'khor gsum mnyes pad+ma mu dra yis: bde ba kun gyi mthar son mchod sprin stobs: rig stong rjen par grol bas dngos grub stsol: gter gzhung gi brda la mi 'dug kyang ḍak+ki de ltar tshogs las mi byed par lug po'i nyams skyes 'o dpa' bo rat+na gling pas tshul deltar bsngags go kho bo nus ldan pas nyam snang ngo

ba:: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dpal chen bla ma drag po yi: hūṃ sgrub thig le'i rgya can las: them med bskang ba dri med shel phreng bzhugs so:gtsa(: na mo gu ru padh+wa ka ra ye snyenacanathos narna1 ma 'ongs las ldan skal bzang pho mo yis gsang chen sgor zhugs bsnyen sgrub lhur len tshe bsags sbya sa spel phyir ga ṇa tsakrar brtson de ya cha lag bskang ba zab mo ni daro sa 'byor yid sprul kun bza mchod sprin spro rnal 'byer lha sngags ting 'dzan mthu bskyed cing rol mo sna tshogs sbir la 'di skad do hū hrī: bde chen pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams nas:rigs kyi bdag po sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas ma chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin zhing: 'khor 'das ro mnyam longs spyod rgyan rdzogs spras: thugs rje mnyam pa'i zhi 'dzum bkrag 'od 'bar: srid zhi 'ub chub skyil krung mnyam bzhag can: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi mdangs 'od zer 'khrigs skye 'chi gnyis spang ye shes rdo rje'i sku: snang ba mtha' yas yab yum thugs dam bskangs: thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: lha rdzas rgyan gyi phyi mchod bdun: nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga: dug gsum rtsad gcod sman

gtor raka: bde stong zung 'jug byang chub sems: nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin: dgyes bskyed a gre ta yi skyems: 'dzin bral sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'dod yon sprin gyi mchodachen pos rdo dze+eslob dpon thugs dam bskangs: rtsa ba'i dam nyams sor chud mdzod: mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs: yan lag dam nyams tshangs par stsol: rtsargyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs: 'byer tshogs yo byad ral ba bshags: yi dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: mngon rtogs spang blangs bgyis pa bshags: ma dang mkha'a'agro'i thugs dam bskangs: khas blangs dam bca' zol ba shags: dam can rgyal mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: gtor tshogs gzhung bzhin ma byas bshags: dngos 'dzin zhenartog bral ba yis: bde chen rol ba'i la rnams kyi: thugs dam bskangs la dbang dang daro sa grub stsol: : hrī mi shig rang snang rnga yab dpal gyi ri: pho brang pad+ma 'od 'bar gzhal yas nas: rje btsun chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dgyes bskyed ḍak+ki'i rje mo mkhar chen bza' chos rgyal tshangs pa lha yi me tog dang: bod khams mun sel mkhas grub

btsan be+e ro rje:grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung ye shes blo:rje 'bangs grogs lnga snying gi bu dgu sogs lo paṇa rig 'dzin tshom bu bsam mi khyab rnam rol ma 'gag pad+ma rgyal po yi:gtso 'khor sprul bar bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs:thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni la rdzas rgyan gyi phyi mchod bdun:nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga:dug gsum rtsad gcod sman gtor raka:bde stong zung 'jug byang chub sems:nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin:dgyes bskyed a dṛ ta yi skyems:'dzin bral sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga:'dod yon sprin gyi mchod chen pos:rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangs:rtsa ba'i dam nyams sor chud mdzod:mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs:yan lag dam nyams tshangs par stsol:rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:'byor tshogs yo byad ral ba bshags yi dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs:mngon rtogs spang blangs bgyas pa bshags:ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs:khas blangs dam bca' zol ba shags:dam can rgyal mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs:gtor tshogs gzhung

bzhin ma byas bshags: dngos 'dzin zhen rtog bral ba yis: bde chen rol ba'i lha rnams kyi: thugs dam bskang la dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ hū hrī: rngams brjed srin po 'tshogs pa'i gling dbus nas ཿ rak+ka pho mo thams cad 'dud pa'i khrod: rab 'jigs thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs dkyil nas: che ba'i dbang phyug bdud 'joms khro bo lod:sku gcig mtshan brgyad 'phrul mtshan nyi shu lnga: gang 'dul rgya mtsho'i rnam rol bye phrag brgya: yon tan ye shes bkod pa bgrangs las 'das: zab gter 'byung gnas bdud bdul bgegs kyi gshed: dbang chen 'chol bor khros pa'i thugs dam bskangs: thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: lha rdzas rgyan gyi phyi mchod bdun: nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga: dug gsum rtsad gcod sman gtor raka bde stong zung 'jug bya chub sems: nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin: dgyes bskyed a mṛ ta yi skyems: 'dzin bral sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: 'dod yon sprin gyi mchod chen pos rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangs: rtsa ba'i dam nyams sor chud mdzod mched dang lcam dral thugs dam

gas/ cha bskangs: yan lag dam nyams tshangs par stsol: rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs: 'byor tshogs yo byad ral ba bshags: yi dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: mngon rtogs spang bla sa bgyis pa bshags: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs khas blangs dam bca' zol ba shags: dam can rgyal mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: gtor tshogs gzhung bzhin ma byas bshags: dngos 'dzin zhen rtog bral ba yis: bde chen rol ba'i lha rnams kyi: thugs dam bskang la dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥhūṃ hrī: sku las 'phros pa'i pho nya ti pa tsa: dbu dgu mig stong bco brgyad rwa rtse 'bar: rgyal gdon 'byung po sgog la hab thob byed: bdud 'dul rang 'dra'i pho nya bye ba 'gyed:gsung las spros pa'i pho nya ga ru ṇa: me yi phu po rlung gi gshog pa can: kring kring king zhing hring hring sgra skad sgrogs: spyan mig nyi zla daru la dug rba rlabs 'phyo: lcags ra nag po dud pa phyu ru rtsa mjug sgro rgyal mo gdung mo'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: klu gnyan 'dul mdzad rang 'dra'i pho nya 'tshubs: thugs las 'gyed pa'i pho nya phe khyi ma: mgo dgu pa la

lcags kyi mche sder bsgrad: sa 'og gnyan gyi mgo 'phang sma phab byed: gdug tshogs drungs 'byen rang 'dra'i pho nya 'gyed: phem gyi nga ros sa gsum g.yo 'gul byed: yon tan sprul pa lcags spyang mgo dgu pa: ya 'gal gnam la ma 'gal las ru brten: glog dmar ljags brkyang lcag kyi mche ba brdar: mjug ma spu gri ngar mas ma ga 'dren gtubs:stong gsum mid par pho gdon grum grum rol: me dud rlung 'tshubs 'byung po 'bogs brgyal byed dam sri 'dul mdzad yang sprul sa ya 'gyed: brin las sprul pa khro chung skar ltar 'khrigs: shā phaṭa sod rgyob nga ro 'brug ltar sgogs ma rung rū dra'i klad pa 'gem par byed: phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs shes rab mtshon chas bsgral dpa' rtags dur brod chas rnams sku la brgyan: che btsan gzhan snang ma lus zil gyis gnon: rab 'jigs he ru ka dpal srin po'i sku las byed pho nya'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangasaX thugs dam bskang ba'idam rdzas ni: la rdzas rgyan gyi byi mchod bdun: nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga: dug gsum rtsad gcod sman gtor raka bde stong zung 'jug byang

badz+ra: chub sems: nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin: dgyes bskyed a mṛ ta yi skyems 'dzin bral sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: 'dod yon sprin gyi mchod chen pos: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangs: rtsa ba'i dam nyams sor chud mdzod: mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs: yan lag dam nyams tshangs par stsol: rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs: 'byor tshogs yo byad ral ba bshags: yi dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: mngon rtogs spang blangs bgyis pa bshags: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: khas blangs dam bca' zol ba shags: dam can rgyal mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: gtor tshogs gzhung bzhin ma byas bshags: dngos 'dzin zhen rtog bral ba yis:bde chen rol ba'i lha rnams kyi: thugs dam bskangs la dbang dang dngos grub stsolaX / hrīḥ za byed chen mo badz+ra wa ra hi: khros pa'i rnam rol bgegs kyi gshed shar ba:stag mo grus ma mgo dgu spyan bco brgyad: mche ba so drug spu gri'i rno ngar ldan: ljags dgu glog dmar ltar 'byug dgra snying 'byin: rgyal bsen dam sri stong gsum mid pa rtsa

'ur 'ur grum rol kun zlum lto bar brub:lcags sder bsgrad pas bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo 'joms:mjug ma brdab pas 'khor ba chos skur sgrol:dmar nag mdog 'changadabang drag phrin las 'gyed dgyes bskyed pho nya chen mo'i thugs dam bskangs:thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni:lha rdzas rgyan gyi phyi mchod bdun:nyon mongs rang grola'adod yon lnga dug gsum rtsad gcod sman gtor raka:bde stong zung 'jug byang chub sems:nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin:dgyes bskyed a dṛ ta yi skyems:'dzin bral shalnga bdud rtsi lnga:'dod yon sprin gyi mchod chen pos:rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangs rtsa ba'i dam nyams sor chud mdzod mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs yan lag dam nyams tshangs par stsol:rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:'byor tshogs yo byad ral ba bshags:yi dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs:mngon rtogs spangablangs bgyis pa bshags ma dang mkha' 'dza'i thugs dam bskangs:khas blangs dam bca' zol ba shags:dam can rgyal mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs gtor tshogs gzhung

badz+ra: bzhin ma byas bshags: dngos 'dzin zhen rtog bral ba yis: bde chen rol ba'i lha rnams kyi: thugs dam bskang la dbang dang dngos grub stsol0 hūṃ hrī:phyogs bzhi pad+ma nyi zla'i bam steng nas bdud 'dul chen po thod phreng sde bzhi ni dkar ser dmar ljang zhi ma khro 'dzum sgeg dur khrod dpal chas rus pa'i rgyan drug spras: me rlung 'ja' 'od 'tshubs ma'i klong dkyil nas: bdud tshogs drung nas 'byan pa'i stobs mnga' ba: kro ta thod phreng rigs bzhi thugs dam bskangs: thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: lha rdzas rgyan gyi phyi mchod bdun: nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga: dug gsum rtsad gcod sman gtor raka: bde stong zung 'jug byang chub sems nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin dgyes bskyed a mṛ ta yi skyems 'dzin bral sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: 'dod yon sprin je mchod chen pos: rdo rje sgob dpon thugs dam bskangs: rtsa ba'i dam nyams sor chud mdzod: mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs: yan lag dam nyams tshangs par stsol: rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs: 'dredar tshogs yo byad ral ba

bshags: yi dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: mngon rtogs spang blangs bgyis pa bshags: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: khas blangs dam bca' zol bshags: dam can rgyal mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: gtor tshogs gzhung bzhin ma byas bshags: dngos 'dzin zhen rtog bral ba yis bde chen rol ba'i lha rnams kyi: thugs dam bskang la dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ ( trī ma chags pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs steng nas: dgyes bskyed mkha' 'gro phag mo sde bzhi ni: las bzhi'i mdog 'chang gri gug thodakhrag bsnams: dar dpyangs rus rgyan pad+ma'i do shal 'phyang: gar gyi khro rgyal bro gar lings se ling: 'ja' 'od gur 1nga snang stong gnyis med skuX 'dzum mdzes sgeg 'chang mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs: thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: lha rdzas rgyan gyi phyi mchod bdun: nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga: dug gsum rtsad gcod sman gtor raka bde stong zung 'jug byang chub sems: nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin: dgyes bskyed a dṛ ta yi skyems 'dzin bral sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: 'dod yon sprin gyi mchod

pa(: chen pos: ga je 31ba de nasags dam bskangs rtsa ba'i dam nyams sor chud mdzod: mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs: yan lag dam nyams 0 ngas par stsol: rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs: 'byor tshogs yo byad ral ba bshags: yi dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: mngon rtogs spang blangs bgyis pa zugags: ma dang mkha' 'a16) thugs dam bskangs: khas blangs dam bca' zol ba shags: dam can rgyal mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: gtor tshogs gzhung bzhin ma byas sags: dngos 'dzin zhen rtog bral ba yis: bde chen rol ba'i lha rnams kyi: thugs dam bskang 'dabang dang dngos grub stsolaX ༅ṭ+wāṃ hā ngad rgyab pad+ma'e zla bzhad steng nas:/ pa' bo sde bzhi zhi ma khro 'dzum sgeg: dar dang rat+na'i rgyan cha mdzes par spras: rang rang rtags 'chang sbyor sgrol thabs la mkhas: gyad kyi 'dor thabs bsgrad cing gzi 'od bar: gar gyi dbang phyug rigs bzhi'i thugs dmabaskangs: thugasadam bskang be+e'adam rdzas ni: lha rdzas rgyan gyi phyi mchod bdun: nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga dug

gsum rtsad gcod sman gtor raka bde stong zung 'jug byang chub sems: nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin: dgyes bskyed a dṛ ta yi skyems 'dzin bral sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'dod yon sprin gyi mchod chen pos: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangs: rtsa ba'i dam nyams sor chud mdzod: mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs: yan lag dmanyams tshangs par stsol: rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs: 'byor tshogs yo byad ral ba bshags: yi dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: mngon rtogs spang blangs bgyis pabashags: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: khas blangs dam bca' zol ba shags dam can rgyal mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: gtor tshogs gzhung bzhin ma byas bshags: dngos 'dzin zhen rtog bral ba yis: bde chen rol ba'i lha rnams kyi: thugs dam bskang la dbang dang dngos grub stsolaX / hrī diyi phyi rim pad+ma zla ba'i steng 'ja' 'od gur slong dpa' mo sde bzhi ni: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi 'dzum chags nyams rgyas: dar dpyangs 'ja' sham rdo rje'i gar bsgyur spro rat+na'i rtse phran pad+ma'i zod

bsgotshu gdengs mdzes:phyag mtshan ma nges ye shes rol ba'i sku:dgyes bskyed dpa' mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs:thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni:lha rdzas rgyan gyi phyi mchod bdun:nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga:dug gsum rtsad gcod sman gtor raka:bde stong zung 'jug byang chub sems:nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin:dgyes bskyed a phra ta yi skyems:'dzin bral sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga:'dod yon sprin gyi mchod chen pos:rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangs:rtsa ba'i dam nyams sor chudamadzod:mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs:yan lag dam nyams tshangs par stsol rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs 'byer tshogs yo byad ral ba bshags yi dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bska sa:mngon rtogs spang blangs bgyis pa bshags ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs:khas blangs dam bca' zol ba shags:dam can rgyal mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs:gtor tshogs gzhung bzhin ma byas bshags:dngos 'dzin zhen rtog bral ba yis:bde chen rol ba'i lha rnams kyi:thugs dam bskang la dbang

dang dngos grub stsolaḥ/ hrī:phyi rim pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng nas:las byed rigs bzhi'i dam tshig gi chen bzhi rus pa'i gzugs can stag gzig seng sbrul sham:rngams pa'i ru dar rdo rje'i dam rtags 'chang:thod rnga dril 'khrol gar bsgyur ya ma zung:rnam 'phrul bsam yas 'gyed pa'i phrin las can :las mdzad ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs:thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni:la rdzas rgyan gyi byi mchod bdun nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga dug gsum rtsad gcod sman gtor raka:bde stong zung 'jug byang chub sems:nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin dgyes bskyed a dṛ ta yi skyems:'dzin bral sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga:'dod yon sprin gyi mchod chen pos rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangs:rtsa ba'i dam nyams sor chud mdzod:mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs:yan lag dam nyams tshangs par stsol:rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:'byor tshogs yo byad ral ba bshags:yi dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs:mngon rtogs spang blangs bgyis pa bshags:ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam

bas/ bskangs: khas blangs dam bca' zol ba shags: dam can rgyal mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: gtor tshogs gzhung bzhin ma byas bshags dngos 'dzin zhen rtog bral ba yis: bde chen rol ba'i lha rnams kyi: thugs dam bskang la dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ hūṃ hrī: dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi srung mdzad pa'i: rgyal chen sde bzhi dkar sngo dmar ser mdog: khrab rmog dar dpyangs sag lhum mdzes pas brgyan: pi waṃ ral gri mchod rten rgyal mtshan 'dzin: zhi rgyas dbang drag brin las rnam bzhi sgrub:dri za gshin rje klu dbang gnod sbyin gyi: 'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum sde las la 'gyed: bdud dang mu stegs dam sri 'dul mdzad pa'i dpa' bo rgyal chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs: thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: lha rdzas rgyan gyi phyi mchod bdun: nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga: dug gsum rtsad gcod sman gtor raka: bde stong zung 'jug byang chub sems: nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra'i sprin: dgyes bskyed a mṛ ta yi skyems: 'dzin bral sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: 'dod yon sprin gyi mchod chen pos: rdo rje slob

dpon thugs dam bskangs: rtsa ba'i dam nyams sor chud mdzod: mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangs: yan lag dam nyams tshangs par stsol: rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs: 'byor tshogs yo byad ral ba bshags: yi dam rgya mtsho' thugs dam bskangs: mngon rtogs spang blangs bgyis pa bshags ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs khas blangs dam bca' zol ba shags: dam can rgyal mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: gtor tshogs gzhung bzhin ma byas bshags: dngos 'dzin zhen rtog bral ba yis:bde chen rol ba'i lha rnams kyi: thugs dam bskang la dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ zhes brjod dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskangs gnad des tshog rdzogs sgrib dag dngo sa grub thob nyams rtogs yon tan yar ro sa zla ltar 'phel don gnyas lhun rgyas grub par ze tshom med sa ma wā e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha pa' ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab rmad byung ba grub pa'i dbang phyug 'aprog ban khyod la sbyan da lta ma spel rin chen brda la zobs mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra sdoms gter bdag bzang phyar klu bdud btsan la gnyer ma 'o sa snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan

gas/ rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa rin chen 'dzan skyo sa spel gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og man zhing la 'god 'gro don bsam ma khyab pa 'i rten 'brel yod sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya them med bskang ba drimedashel phreng rdzogs soḥ gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya yo rgyan gya slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o bdo thim lha ces pa 'di 'ang lung zin 'gyur thed rgya margyasarin chen dang po dbang gi cod paṇa sgrub pa 'i me tog bcas nas 'askul ba da chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho' rin chen spos shel bkra shas la reg 'dzan skyongs spel ba' phrin las bcas bzhed ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus lngan rdo rjes mdo khams bkra shis tsa ri dra' gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dpal chen bla ma drag po yi:hūṃḥsgrub thig le'i rgya can las them med tshogs mchod kun bzang dgyes rol zhes bya ba bzhugs so: badz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma krota sho ye pho ba1437sgro sde shesardo rjes gzung 'dzin dbu mar sgrol lhan skyes ngo bo dpal chen brgyad kyi lha bla ma drag po 'jigs rung srin po' sku gar dgu'i nyams ོgas pad+ma'i ga'ur rol ma 'ongasal ldan skal ba bzang po yis bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs pa' phyar ga ṇa tsakra kun bza dgyes rol nyid dmigs bsam dag pa chen pos 'dzan 'tshal lo sa ma yu ma dwa na dang mo sa zhun phye dang zla rgyas zla khrum dkar gsum mngar gsum rigs 'byu sman a mṛ ta yi skyems bza po sna gsal ci 'byor dri zhim sbyar ba'i spos thams cad bsags nas yid 'ong mdzes par bkram brda dang brda lan che ba bsgrags pa da yon tan brgyad ldan ga ṇa tsakra spro sa ma yā de yang las rim bcu drug dag gi bstan dang po byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa na ā:kun gzhi yangs pa'i bhardze ka pā la:—1nga gsum khyon dang mnyam pa'i snod yangs par snang srid sgyu mar bkra ba'i rtse 'jo kun:bde stong zung 'jug chen po'i snod du gtams:slar yang rang bzhin dag pa'i cho rol

las: sbyangs spel bsgyur la sku gsung thugs kyi sprin: dgyes bskyed 'od yon lha mo'i rol gar bcas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i dbyid du spel: chachosaḥshā: lan gsum gnyis pa lha tshogs dbyings nas spyan 'dren na hūṃ hrī skye 'gag 'gyur med spros bral 'og min nas: brgyud pa drug ldan bla ma tshogs la byon: dbyings rig zung 'jug dpal ldan bkod pa nas: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug tshogs la byon: lhan skyes bde stong kha sbyor mnyam klong nas gnas gsum ma rgyud mkha' 'gro tshogs la byon: snying dbus mi shig dwangs ma'i pho brang nas: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po tshogs la byon: sems rtog zil gnor 'jigs rung srin yul nas: dpal chen rdo rje khro lod tshogs la byon: ye shes gcig la rnam rol mtha'ayas pa: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus tshogs la byon dgyes ldan lha yi tshogs kyang gtsug ma'i dal: 'byor tshogs bsod nams tshogs 'khor rang byung rtsal: dam ldan rnal 'byor pho mo dbyings klong 'phrul: dmigs med ye shes tshogs chen rig pa'i mdangs ngo mtshar bde chen bkod pa lhun gyis grub tshe badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: gsum pa tshogs mchod

btsaji: 'bul ba'i rim pa ni oṃ aḥhūḥ chos dbyings spros bral mnyam brdal bde ba che phyi nang gsang ba'i ga ṇa tsakra kun: ye shes rol ba chen po'i gar bsgyur gyis chos nyid la yang chos nyid thim par 'bul ma ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza khā hi: bzhi pa bshags sbyang bya ba 'di lta ste ho skye med chos sku'i dbyings las gzugs skus dgongs: ma rig gsum dbang gyur bas rmongs tshogs kyi: gnyis snang dri ma gad mchis bzod pa ra gsol: rig pa ye shes ngang du dag tshangs stsol: badz+ra sa ma ya a: lnga pa bsgral las 'gugs bsnyims grub nas slar hūṃ bh+yo ngang nyid rol pa chen po'i dbyings 1ngas nas: sor rtog rang gzugs rdo rje khros pa'i tshogs: phra rags sgyu 'phrul chu zla'i rol gar gyis: log rtog gdon 'dul bdag med chen por bshig: chos nyid e yi slong du byang chub mdzod: sarba du dra mā ra ya phaṭa: drug pa bstab cing 'bul ba' ram pa ni hūṃ hūṃ gzung 'dzin mtshan ma bsgral ba'i phung po khams: ye rdzogs bla ma drag po'i zhal du bstabs 'ub chub mnyam pa nyid du 'dren rol nas: sku dang ye shes mdzad phrin mthar phyin shog dṛ ཿdri sarba rā dra la khā

hi: bdun pa rnal 'byer tshogs la rol ba ni e ma two chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i dam rdzas 'di: gtsang sme gnyis 'dzin dri kun bral ba dra de bzhin nyid du rol zhing bdag phyag 'tshal: tshim pa drug ldan sngags kyi zlos gar bsgyur: a ho ma hā su dza: brgyad pa lhag ma 'bul ba' rim pa na hūṃ bh+yo 'a rgor 'das mnyam nyid stong pa srog gcig pu: sgyu 'phrul drwa bar shar ba'i ma sring king dbyings la gnas kyang ye shes gar bsgyur gyi cho rol sna tshogs brda thabs du ma ston : srid pa'i rtsa ba rak+ta skan sgras 'dren: rkang pa ya cig srid zhi'i sgo'aphar gnon: lus ni rdo rje ba spu'i 'od zer 'phro mtshan mar stong gsum srid pa 'ub kyis sdud: skad gcig brda bsgyur rnal 'byor grogs gcig ma: 'dod yon lnga ldan ro mnyam chen por 'bul: pham phab bzhes nas dpal gyi zhabs la gtugs sgrub po'i tha tshag sa ma ya nyid la: 'da' bar ma byed rdo rje'i bka' gnyer yin: sgo sarba gro ṭāk+ki ni e dam ba lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi: dgu pa thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni hūṃ bh+yoḥ mi mngon dbyings nas bla ma drag po'i sku: che ba'i yon tan gar dgu'i stobs bskyed la: ma rig

badz+ra 'khrul ba'i du dra kun btul nas: sngags sngags rdo rje'i bstan pa dar rgyas mdzod: phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i sri bdud 'joms pa da : legs tshogs yon tanayar zla ltar 'phel mdzod: thugs dam ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma yā: bcu chad mdo dam can brngan pa ni hūṃ bho dang po ka dag mnyam pa nyid kyi dus: ston pa khyab bdag mi g.yo mgon poyis: lhun grub rol pa chen po'i 'khor rnams la: 'khor 'das dag mnyam rtogs pa'i chos bskor tshe: chos can chos nyid rol ba'i dam rgyas btab bar du 'ub chub gdulabya'i dngas mtsho dza dpal ldan sgyu 'phrul rol pa chu zla'i gar: ston dang bstan pa zung du 'jug pa'i tshe: rten 'brel mi 'gag srid pa stong rgyas btab: tha ma sku gsum lhunardzogs 'og min du: rang rig ston pa pad+ma saṃ bha was: rtsal sna bu la klong rgya bkrol ba'i tshe: brda don rtags rdzogs gnyug mar rgya yi btab: da lca gsang chen rol ba'i dkyila'akhor 'dir: rang snang ston pa nus ldan rdo rje yis: dgo sa pa'i dpal rnyed bu la 'doms ba'i tshe: 'khrul 'khor gzhi ru sad pa'i rten 'brerlo bzhag: deng dus sgyu 'phrul

bkod pa'i gzhal yas 'dir: phun tshogs rnal 'byor dam ldan pho mo yis: thabs shes zung 'jug wa snang bkod pa'i tshe: 'dod yon rnam dag gtor ma'i brngan chen po: rtogabral bde chen srung ma rgya mtshos rol: lhan skyes gnyug ma'i brda don gsal bor ston 'khrul ba gzhi la sangs ba'i bcol las dang: sgrub mchog 'od skur grol ba'i phrin lasamadzod: bcu gcig ma sri bstan ma brngan pa ni hūṃ bh+yo kun rdzob rten 'grel lugs 'byung 'khor ba'i chos: lugs ldog srid pa'i rtse ru dub pa yi: 'khrul 'khor dbu mar rgyas 'debasabastan ma skyong: bde stong zag med rol ba'i snang cha la: rol nas khams gsum 'khor ba chos sku phu brdal ba'i phrin las dus la da bab po: bcu gnyas rta bro brdung ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ hūṃ rang bzhin rnam dag 'khrul bral e yi mkhar: log 'khrul ma tram̐ ྅ dra brub pa las chos nyid rol pa'i brda glu ha he bzhad: don dam ra zhal mjal ba'i gar zhig bsgyur thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i rta bro brdung glu gar bro yis mtshan ma'i 'khrul rtog bcom: ye shes zang thal ngang du 'ub chub rgya: tsana.āḥ&swā hwa sto bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan

bsgoji: nan: bcu gsum bzod gsol gad ba pa 'i rim pa ni hoḥ 'khor 'das yin min bral ba rdzogs pa che'i: gnas lugs rabhe ngo ma shes 'khrul ba'i nongs: lta ba'i rgyal po gdod ma chos skur bshags: sgoms pa'i 'od gsal sgrib med tshangs par stsol: spyod pa rnam rgyal gegs med 'grub gyur cig: 'bras bu klong yangs rtogs na bshags pa'i rgyal: a ā: bcu bzha bsngo ba smon lam gdab pa ni ho gzung dang 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba rang sar dag: tha snyad mtshan ma bral ba don dam pa: so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul dge:'khor gsum yo sa dag rdzogs pa chen por bsngo: lhun grub bde chen pad+ma rgyal po'i srid: thog mtha' bral bar mngon par mnga' brtes shog: lan gsum bco lnga bsdu lda nga bya ba'i rimapa ni āḥ dmigs med dbyings las gzhir bzhengs gyad kyi lha: thig le nyag gcig kun bzangaklong du ā: slar yang thugs rje'i rol rtsal ye shes mdangs: bde chen rdo rje lta bu'i phyag rgyar spyod: a phaṭa: bcu drug bkra shis glu dbyangs bya ba ni na mo: ka dag mkha' la lhun grub 'ja' 'od 'khyug: thugs rje nyi ma'i zer mdangs rab rgyas pas: gdul bya'i blo

yi ma rig mun pa sel: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: stong zhing bdag med chos sku'i bkra shis shog: gsal la 'gag med longs sku'i bkra shis shog: mnyamabardal ye shes sprul sku'i bkra shis regag: nub med sgrub por 'char ba'i bde legs (6pa: zhes sogs bsngo ba smon lam rgya yas gdab gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrab dag nyams chags bska sa nyamasartogs yon tan mkha' la nyi bzhan gsal don gnyis lhun gyis grub par the tshom med ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma saṃ bha wa' ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying da 'dra ba'i ya zab gdams ba'i skor grub pa'idabang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstems mdo khams bkra shis rdzong du dgongs bra thob ma ngas snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul thugs kyi sras da 'phrad par 'gyur 'gro don bsamayas gdul bya 'bum phrag 'dren chos bdag rnams kyis bstan pa 'i ba dan bsgri sa bkra shis dge mtshan shar nub byang la 'char the tshom mi mnga' rdo rje rgyal po' bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya them med tshogs mchod kun bzangadagyes rol rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya yo rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pango brda thim snyi chos bdag dharma ku mud 'gyur med rgya

gtsaX mtsho sogs kya thugs 'dun bskang phyir bdag 'dra dpa' bosasaldan rdo samado khams bkra shis rdzong mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda lag chad med pa ra gto la pha ba pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo lam/

bsnye: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dpal chen bla ma drag po yi: hū sgrub thig le'i rgya can las: gnam phud bskang ba phrin las rgya mtsho bzhugs so:gtsa( na mo gu ru kro dha rwa dza ye rwa 342) la ldan tshogasaganyas rdzogs pa'i phyir ga ṇa tsakra' thabs brtson tshe gnam phud bskang ba 'di nyid bskyar rol mo snyan pa'i dbya sa bcas te hūṃ bh+yo 'og min gnas dang mkha' spyod zhing tsa ri pad ri pad+ma 'od: bkra shis rdzong chen gnas mchog dang: ljongs lnga gling drug gangs nyi shu ༷ mnga' ri skor gsum srung ba'i la dbu gtsang ru bzhi mdo sgang drug: sbas yul sgrub gnas zhing gtsug lag: skyong ba'i rdo rje'i pho nya ba: las mdzad dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcasaḥ rgyan cha mang po pu ru ru bshug glu brda skad sangs se sang: dril bu zhub chen si li li: bro gar sna tshogs khrigs se khrig: ru dar dam rtags 'od de 'od: gsang sngags bstan la dung nge sems: 'du ba tshogs la sgran 'dren gshegs: dpa' bo sngabs gyi gar la rol: 'dod yon tshogs mchod dgyes par bzhes sma gsung thags yon phrin las basmangs: nyams chags 'gal

'khrul nongs pa bshags: bzod gsol tshangs par bzhes nas kyang: phrin las rab 'byams gegs med sgrubs: dngos grub pha phog zab mo stsol: thugs dam ma g.yel sa mayā: snyed ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza khā hi: ces brjod gtor skyems gca sar gshegs phrin las gang bcol gegs med 'grub sa ma mā e ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud skor 'brog ban khye'u chung lo tsār gtad bstan 'gro'i dpal du brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzo la sbas bstan pa 'i rgud ba gso ba'i phyir nus ldan rdo rjes bgo skal rnyed gzhan phan phran las 'byung ba'i phyir rnam dkar dri ma med par brtsams sa ma mā rgyargya rgya gnam phud bskang ba phrin las rgya mtsho rdzogs gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa 'o brda zim ces pa 'da'ang lung zin 'gyur med rgya mtsho dpa chos kya bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel gnyis kyis rin chen da po yad 'ong spos shel bkra shis la reg bcas te yang yang bzhed ngor bdag 'dradapa' bo nu ldan rdo rje dpa la ldan brag lha mgon po 'a gnasamadun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag — ra phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni pad+ma smon lam pa sa/ sarba masgo lam/

pa( zab gsang rdo rje'i snying po las: che mchog rdo rje khro lod kyi bka' srung shan dmar la brten pa'i gsol mchod pha rol dpung 'joms bzhugs so:bas/: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye zadakhurgyus/ skyems dang phud gtsang sha khrag rigs bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs byed spu sa 'byu gsum nus pa sa sbyang spel brgyur nam mkha' mjod kyi 'khor lo' sprin rang nyed yi dam rgyal gyis rol mo sna tshogs sgra sbir la k+ta: sngon gyi bka' dang tha tshig la gnas pa'i gnod sbyin dbang drag shan pa dme ru rtse yab yum sprul 'khor ma lus spyan 'dren gshegs: rten rdzas bla rdo sgog gi 'khor lor bzhugs: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byer phrin las sgrub par mnga' gsol lo: mthun pa'i dam rdzas phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul: snyan pa'i dbyings dang rol mo'i sgra yis bstod: nyin mtshan dbyer med bdag cag srung skyob mdzod: rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa phyogs bcur spel: phrin las rab 'byams 'bad med 'grub pa dang: gnod byed dgra bgegs ming tsam med par mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor skyems

gtsang sar gshegs gnad des phrin las rab 'byams 'grub tshe bsod yon tan gong 'phel rgyas the tshom med do sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces kya chos kya bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel gyas bskul ngor bdag 'dra nusaldan rdo rjes bris pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/ dza yan tu/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dpal chen rdo rje khro lod kyi: / sgrub thig le'i rgya can las: bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum gyi gsol mchod bstan dgra'i 11ga len bzhugs 〈sna: btsa/: na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye 'a grananas5nams ma 'ongasalas ldan pho mo yas bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa 'i tshe bar chad g.yul las rgyal ba'i phyir bstan srungasgrub pa 'i las rim bstan sa ma mā de yang gzhu bzhin bskyed bzlas mthar gsol mchod bya ba'i rim pa ni mthun rdzas yo byad kun bsags te bsangs sbyangs byan gyis brlabs nas slar rang nyid lha yi rgyal gyis hūṃ bh+yo: pho brang mkha' spyod tsa ri nas bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong pa can: yum mchog si na ra ma dang: las mdzad stobs ldan baṃ ro zung: bka' nyan dregs pa sde brgyad bcas ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs: bla rdo srog 'khor rten la bzhugs: rgyal bstan bsrung phyir gus phyag 'tshal: bstan pa bsrung bar mnga' gsol ma : gdung dbyangs rol mo'i sgra yis bstod dgyes bskyed mchod sprin 'bul ba ni: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: mi nag rta nag lug nag dang: g.yag nag zhing chen bkal ba
