dang: khyi nag snying dkar mche sder rngams: nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga: sman gtor rak+ta byang chub sems: dkor nor bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs: 'dod yon namamakha'i khams bkang bas: bdud mgon nag po zhing mchod: si na ra ma gsol zhing mchod: bam ro pho mo gsol zhing mchod: 'khor tshogs sprul ba gsol zhing mchod: yangagayog bsam yas gsol gsol zhing mchod: gsol mchod bstod pa'i byin rlabs gyis: 'jig rten mi bde'i rgud pa sol: nad dang yam gyis rgol ba bzlog: dmag 'khrugamatshon cha'i mtsho mo skems: rgyal bstan bsnubs pa'i bstan dgra sgrol smon log dam sri ming med mdzod: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: tshe dpal yar ngos zla ltarabaskyed: gdul bya mdzad phrin 'phel rgyal mdzod: nyams rtogs yon tan nang nas sbor: srid pa'i lus rgya grol ma thag: rnga yab dpa' ri'i zhing khams su: rnam par skyel ba'i21 nya mchosad: thugs dam ma g.ye'/ sa ma yu: ces pa ci 'grub gra sa bsogs na brin las gegs med yid bzhin 'grub bar chad g.yul las rnam pa ra rgyal the tshom med do sa ma mā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma

bsgo/: ngas ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis snying dang 'dra ba'i ya zab skor 'aprog mi lo cwa khyod la gtad da du ma spel brna la thobs rdo rje'i rdzong du sbas rgya sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus skabs su sprul las can gcag gas rted bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad par 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' bka' gsang srungs shig srog bdag lnga dam log lag tu ma shor zhig thugs kyi sras da 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya bdud mgon seng gdong pab yum kyi gsol mchod bstan dgra'i srog len rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma sa bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda tham lha ces pa 'di 'a chos kya bdag po 'gyur med rgya mtsho dang pad+ma chos 'a thel rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes dpal ldan brag la mgon po' gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pa 'i ya ge pa nipad+ma smon sems so dge'o/ legs so/ sarba masgo lam/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rjesnying po las: dpal chen rdo rje khro lod kyi / sgrub zug le'i rgya can las: gnod snyin shan dmar gyi gsol mchod bstan dgra'i snying 'byin zhes bya ba bzhugs so: pa(: na mo gu ru parnya ka ra yi 'gatheg〉( ma 'ongasal ldan pho mo yis bsnyen bsgrub lhur len byed pa 'i tshe smon log dgra 'dres 'tshe srid pas de 'joms srung ma gsol sgrub brtson sa ma yā las bzhus tshad ldan btang ba'i rjes dbang drag shan pa gsol mchod tshe thugs mthun yo byad kun bsags nas bsangs sbyangs spel gsum grub byas la stenak+ta: stegachen rda na'i dur khrod dang: rnga yab gling dang sham bha la: rang bzhin gar bzhugs pho brang nas:shan pa dmar nag da tshur byon: yum dang sde brgyad las mkhan tshogs: dad dang dam tshig gnyan gyis 'bod: ma thogs myur du gshegs su gsol: bla rdo srog 'khor rten la bzhugs: phrin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal: a ti'i srung mar mnga' gsol lo: gdung dbyangs rol mo'i sgra yis bstod khyed rnams dgyes pa'i dam rdzas ni: khyung chen rma bya de pho dang: seng ge glang chen rnga mong rta sha rgo rna ba la sogs dang: g.yag dmar ra dmar lug

dmar khyi 'om mda' rgyan ldan sgog 'khor dang :brten sgrub rgyun gtor nar ma dang:dgra bo'i sha khrag rus pa snying:phyi nang gsang mchod ga ṇa tshogs:bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun:thugs mthun 'dod yon rgya chen po:nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa yis:shan pa dmar nag gsol lo mchod:gsod byed dmar mo gsol mchod bskangs:las mkhan mched brgyad gsol lo mchod dregs pa sde brgyad gsol lo mchod:'khor tshogs sprul ba gsol mchod bskangs:sku gsung thugs yon rab mnyes te sgrub pa po rnams brtse bas skyongs:dgra bdud bgegs rnams thal bar rlog bya btang dben ri snyogs pa la:mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i yon bdag kyis: blo phug gtan bde'i sa pa pa'i gegs dang gol sa nyer 'tshe bzlog:a ti nyams su len pa la:lta sgom spyod pa'i rang zhal sprod:gol re ra 'phrang bsal sems rig gi:la shan 'byed mdzad dam tshig can:tshe sgrub byed pa'i rnal 'byor rnams:yul da yul can rang sar grol:rdul phran chos nyid 'khor lor dengs sa la thod pa rgal ba'i rigs bum sku 'pho chen 'od lus

ba:tshu sogs: kun bzang thugs kyi bstan pa yi: myur la rtags mtshan ma g.yel zhig: theg pa'i yang rtse 'bras bu yi: ston bstan 'khor 'bangs rtag tu skyongs:bde legs dpal 'bar snang ba spel: kun nas dge ba'i brin las mdzod: tha tshig ma g.yel sa ma ya: zhes brjod phud gtor gtsa sar gshegs gang bcol las kya 'bras bu te chud ma za bar 2phel re sa pa tho nya nyid kyis zhal bzhes so sa ma wā yi ma rgyal kun gsang 'dzin sa bha was bstan 'gro'i rgud — bsal ba da ya snyi bstan pa dar rgyas phyar zab rdor snyi chos sde'i skor 'aprog ban khye'u chung lo tsār gtad brda la btab pa'i zhal byang son dus kyi 'byor rgud skyobs pa 'i phyir mdo khams tsa ri dra la bstims zhes gsu sa bzhin du sgrub sde mo 'brog ban zu gis gter rgyas btab dus kyi snyigs mar gyur ba na bdud 'dul khyung dragado rje yis 'ad rded bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel de bar zab pa'i gnyer bya ni klu bdud btsan la them pa 'o sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya gnod sbyin shan dmar gsol mtshad bstan dgra'i snying 'byin rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya yo rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pabo brda thim snyi ces pa 'di 'a rtsa ba'i chos bdag dad pa dam tshig gca zhi sgrub brtson gyi
rnal 'byor dam pa pad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho'i yang yang bzhed pa don da ldan phyar bdag 'dra rdzog pa chen po'i rnal 'byer pa nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab pa sarba masgo lam/

bsnye: zab gsang rdo rje'i snying po las : che mchog rdo rje khro lod kyi bka' srung e ka tsa ti la gsol mchod bya thabs phan bde'i dpal ster bzhugs so:gas/: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye can2151 sngagasakyi srung ma mchod pa la sha khrag phya nang gas mchod bshams sbyang spel bsgyur la lhar gsal nga mchod ci bstod te gsol ba na hū bh+yo rmad byung a ti rdzogs pa'i bcud 'dzin pa 'bum phrag rgyud kyi srung ma e ka tsa tha tshig ma g.yel sngon gyi dam dgongs la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul gyis bzhes thugs dam bskangs la brin las bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas bstan skyongs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod: rdo rje snying po phyogs bcur dar rgyas mdzod: bdag cag lus dang grib bzhin dbyer med skyongs: ma g.yel ma 'khyang badz+ra sa ma yā: ces brjod phrin las rab 'byams 'grub the tshom med do sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces kyang pad+ma chos 'aze la gyis dar bcas bskulangor nus ldan 'dus ba rtsal rgyas mkha' 'gro'i brda' ris las dag pa ra pha ba pa dge'o dge'o dge'o sarba maṅga lam/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dpal chen rdo rje khro lod kyi: snosgrub thig le'i rgya can las: srung ma dam can sde lnga'i 'bod rbad bsad ba'i las spu gri reg gcod zhes bya bzhugs dre : bsgo/: namogu ru parnya ka ra ye gagaste/can11/ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnasangs ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bgo skal dam pa zab pa' chos bstan srung sgrub pa 'i las rim bstan sa ma mā de pang dben gnasadam pa na phyin la da la gzhung ltar bkram khyad par drag sbyor byed pa 'i dus bkol du rung ba'i khams pa yi gzhi ste mu khyud rim gsum bskor na du gru gsum gsum ram la e khang rtsang gi drwa ba can de na li ka dbang tshang 'god mu khyud dang po 'khor rtsibs bzhar dregs pa sde bzhi'i gtor ma bkod mu khyud gnyis par 'khor rtsibs brgyad dregs pa sde brgyad gtor ma bzhag phya ram rtsibs khyud bdun cu la dpa la mgon bdun cu'i gtor chu re mtha' skor rtsa mtshe dug nyung gas ra ba drwa mig tshul du dgod e khaṃ steng du lde khri khar legs ldan nag po'i gtor ma ni zhal shes bzhin du 'god par bya zhi sgrub sngon song rnal 'byor bas drag po' 'bod rbad bsad gsum las dang po 'bod bskul rim pa ni skyems gtor bshams la 'gugs bstem dang bsangs sbyangs spel bsgyur nan du bya rol mo rngams pa'i sgra bcas te hūṃ je( rngams

brjed liṅga pu ru'i grong khyer nas: rgyal bstan srung ba'i pho nya dam tshig can: legs ldan nag po 'bod do da tshur byon: dgyes bskyed kro ti shwa ri da tshur byon bka' nyan las byed mched brgyad da tshur byon: sprul ba dpal mgon bdun cu da tshur byon: yang g.yog bsam mi khyab pa da tshur byon: sprul 'khor dpung dang bcas pa da tshur byon: khyed rnams dam tshig can gyi srung ma ste: sngon gyi tha tshig gnyan po ma g.yel bar: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag gis 'bod lags na: byon cig dgyes pa'i rdzas rnams lhun re sdug byon cig bskang ba'i rdzas rnams rgya re che: phyon cig sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams rgya re che: byon cig sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams bcud re che: byon cig rnal 'byor bdag cag dam re gtsang:byon cig lha sngags ting dzin rnam par dag: byon cig smon log dam sri'i 'tshubs ma sdang: dgyes bskyed mthun pa'i dam rdzas rab bzhes la: sgrub pa po la rtags mtshan bzang po ston: zhing bcu'i dgra la bka' yi chad pa chod rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i 'bras bu chud ma gsan: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: bdag nyid dpal chen po gsal

btsa/ ba'i mdun du srung ma che ge mo sgrub thabs bskyed chog bzhin du gsal ba'i thugs gar sgog sngags rab tu 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros 'jig rten khams kyi dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi mthu stobs nus rtsal bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad bsdus te bstim: yang bdag nyid dpal chen po' thugs ga'i sgog sngags las 'od zer 'phros: dam can sru ma che ge mo'i sgog sngags dang 'dres dam tshig gnyan po'i srog bdag sgrub pa po'i bka' nyan zhing gsung sdod par bsam la: slo bhur khur tsaspyo ma hā kwa wā 11 ti shā ri sarba dharma pā la k+ṣe dra pā la sarba sa ma ya po dza: smra bcad mi dang mi 'phrad par 'bod sngags chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du bzlas la rtag mtshan thon par bya gnad des srung ma 'bral med 'grogs sa ma pā dmigs bsal rim pa 'ad ltar ro hūṃ bh+yo rdzogs chen bstan pa'i so srung dam tshig can: dbang drag dus kyi pho nya mthu rtsal can: dur khrod he chen brdal ba'i gnas mchog nas: shan pa dmar nag 'bod do da tshur byon: gsod byed dmar mo 'bod do da tshur byon: las mkhan mched brgyad 'bod do da tshur byon: dregs pa sde brgyad 'bod do

da tshur byon 'khor tshogs bsam yas 'bod do da tshur pyon narma11mas e he me ru rtse gu ṇa hrī da shra ma ma 'gram bh+yo sarba dharma pā la narma11sog hū bh+yo: pho brang mkha' spyod tsa ri'i gzhal yas nas: rgyal bstan srung ba'i pho nya tha tshig can drag shul bdag po 'bod do da tshur byon su na ra la 'bod do da tshur byon: bam ro pho mo 'bod do da tshur byon las mkhan mched brgyad 'bod do da tshur byon: sprul ba bsam yas 'bod do da tshur byon: narma11chos oṃ dhu tri ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri shrī dharma pa la: narma11mas hūṃ bh+yo dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa chos kyi dbyings: lhun grub bde ba chen po' pho brang nas: rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum chen dam tshag can: e ka dza ḍi 'bod do da tshur byon tsa ti ma lnga 'bod do da tshur byon: spyang zhon mched gsum 'bod do da chur byon: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro 'bod do da tshur byon g.yog mo lnga bcu 'bod do da tshur byon: yang g.yog 'bum khri 'bum stong da tshur byon: natha11sog hūṃ ma ma e ka dza ḍi roka de wa khyi kha le ma mo sarba sarba ḍak+ki dharma pā la: narma11sos hā bh+yo: kun

btsasdo khyab brdal ba'i gnas mchog dam pa dang: mu le mthing mtshor 'phrul gyi gting shed nas: 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug dpal lha mo: re ti chen mo 'bod do da tshur byon: sku gsung thugs kyi ma lnga da tshur byon skem ma chen mo 'bod do da tshur pyon ma lnga la sogs 'bod do da tshur pyon: dbang phyug nyer brgyad 'bod do da tshur pyon:sprul ba bsam yas 'bod do da tshur byon: natha11sog sa ma ma re mati ro ri phu ri rasmo ka li sarba badz+ra ḍak+ki ni dharma pā la 'bod pa rtags mtshan ma byung bar dmigs pa' gnad kyis gcun zhi bzla skabs skabs gsol mchod thabs la brtson sbyor ba lags len gnad brtson jo sa ma mā

tho btsa/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las hūṃ sgrub thig le'i rgya can gyi:don dbang bsdus pa spros med rgyun gyi nyams len bzhugs so/07) na mo gu ru kro ta ra dza ske ga2170 ma 'ongs skal ldan don ched du gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen phyir smin grol dab gi 'jug sgo bstan de ya sbyor dngos rjes gsum mo sa ma yu dang po sbyor ba'i rim pa la maṇ+ḍal yad 'o bkod ma dzas steng bum pa sku da bhan+ta gsung rig ma thugs dang 'ja' shel tshag thig le sto sgron rig rtsal dbang mtha' rten rgyas 'debs gtor dab ngo nyer spyod 'dod yon mchod pa bkram bdag mdun bum gsum bskyed bzlas bstims mchod ci bstod la rag me dor sngon du 'jug pa'i ram pa'o sa ma yu gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa la slob ma' rtog sgrib khrus kyas sbyangs thar lam bgegs tshogs dbyings su bskrad:ye shes rim bdun bsru gur phub gsang sngags bden pa'i gnad don bshad dkyil 'khor la la maṇ+ḍal phul de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni kyi dus gadza/ma rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mchog:'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig pu smin grol dbang gi gter mdzod bdag rdo rje bla ma dgongs su gsol:bdag la gsang sngags bla med kyi:dbang mchog dam pa

brtsal tu gsol: lan gsum de nas bla ma'i lan gnang ba ni kye ho: gsang sngagabashazeg chen sgor zhugs na: spyi dang khyad par bye brag gi: dam tshig ma lus bsrung nus sam: mi nus pa rnams phyir dengs shig: skabs 'dir skyabs sems yan lag bdun phyi na gsang ba'i stom 'bog de nas mna' chu sbyin pa ni hoḥrdo rje khro bo gnod sbyin gyi: rnam pas dam tshig bdud rtsi 'di: slob ma khyod kyi lce la bzhag: dam tshig bsrung na sangs rgyas thob: nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar lhung: de bas khyod kyis ma brjed zungs: badz+ra sa ma yān ra gaṇa: skabasa'adir slob ma lhar gsal gdab ye shesaspyan dra sadabab bstim bya de nasadaro sagazhir maṇ+ḍal phul gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa ni kye kye: 'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma dang : dkyil 'khor bdag po dbyer med dgongs sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog rnams: ma lus bdag la rtsal tu gsol: zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab po de nas sku bum pa'i dbang ni /sa bum pa chos dbyings thig le zlum po'i sbub:rgyal kun gsang gsum bcud 'dus bdud rtsi bskyil: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: chos rnams stong nyid rtogs pa'i dbang thob re ga rtsa sngagasamathar ka ya a bhi

gtsa/ ṣiñca tshe: skabs 'dir them med sku yi dbang bskur 'dod na sbyar ba rung de nasagasu gas ba'i dbang ni sa: mtshan ldan bhan+ta dum gcig ka pā lar zag med bde stong bdud rtsi'ibacud kyis gtam deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lhun grub gsang ba gsung gi dbang thob regag: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a snye shing ā: de nas thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbangani sno dga' ba'i lang tsho'i mdzes pa'i bcu drug ma: bde chen gnyug ma'i dga' bskyed mdza' na mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bcu drug mthar phyin thig le'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas ka dag tshig ga dbang ni (: ka dag sprosamatha' bral ba dbyings kyi nga : ra byung rang 'od gsal ba 'ja' shel 'di: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mtshan med don dam sgom pa'i dbab thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a sti ṣiñca hrī: de nas rig pa 'a rtsal dbang ni sno ma bcos blo bral chen po'irang gdangs cha: 'gag med lcan grub thig le stong pa'i sgon: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bsar bas: rig pa gcer mthong chen po'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar a ā

ā phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: de nasargyasa'adebs mtha' brten gyi dbang ni o āX nyu skye med rang byung dbyings kyi gtor sgod du: 'gag med lhun grub snang ba'i gtor chen bshams: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal bha lirnyi a bhi nyiñca dre: gzhan yang bkra shis rdzas rtag da rgyal srid sna bdun dag kyang sbyin dam tshig khasablangasamaṇ+ḍal phul bkra shisadage bsngo mtha' rgyas bya desani dbang dang byin rlabasadang dngos grub ma lus 'thob par 'gyur sa ma pā gsum pa rjesakyi rim pa la dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor bka' srung chosaskyong gtor masabarngan sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin byang chub sems bskyed theg gsum bshad sku gsung thugasadang 'bral mi bya sngags kyi phyag rgya rgyun mi gcod yang dag lam zhugs skyes bur byams 'di ni sngags kyidam tshig go sam mā bga' 'di ralabakheg ma mor gnyer thub par srung shig sam yu skal dman rnamasal brda thim rgya las can bu dang 'phrad par shog rgya rgya rgya gu rgya lha ces pa 'di yang lasacan snying nor dam pa 'gyur medargya mtsho dang shesarab rgya mtsho gnyisakyi yang yang bskul ngor sngagasakyi ban rde dga' ba'i ro zan gyithabarda shog las zhal bsas te dag pa ra phab pa' yi ge pa ni ye shes rgya mtsho'i bris pa dge'o dge'o/ dge'o/ legasaso/ sarba maṅga le/

gas/: gsol 'debs mthong ba don ldan la mos gus gdung ba drag po yis thal sbyar snyan pa'i dbyang sa dang bcas dus drug brjod pa ra bya ba'o sa ma yā ro/shā rwa/ e ma hoXrgyal ba kun dngos chos sku pad+ma'i gdung:mi 'jed khams 'dul pad+ma zod phreng rtsal:sku gcig mdzad tshul bye ba phrag sa ya:rmad byung thug rje'i gter la gsol ba 'debs:phyi ltar gu ru bye ba phrag brgya dang:nang ltar o rgyan mchan mchog brgyad brgyad grags:gsang ba 'gro mgon rdo rje khro lod rtsal:bdud 'dul rdo rje'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs:rgyal bstan rgud pa gso la thabs mang bsgyur:nad mug mtshon 'khrugs gzing ba sna tshogs 'joms:mkhyen brtse mdzad pa rgya mtsho'i gzi byin can:bka' drin mtshungs med rje la gsol ba 'debs:khyed sku mthong bas tha mal snang zhen 'gags gang gsung thos pas ma rigs rmoja sa tshogs bcom:dran pa yis kyang srid pa'i 'jigs tshogs zhi:mtshungs med bla ma de la gsol ba 'debs:mdzad pa'i yon tan thos pas the tshom 'gag:yid la dran pas dgongs rgyud byin rlabs 'pho reg pa tsam gyis dngos grub gegs med rtsol:pad+ma

thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs: de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis: a 'thas 'khrul ba'i 'phyang thags kun zad nas: gzhi rgyud ma bcos bde chen rdo rje'i glong: lam rgyud rig stong thig le nyag gcig klong: 'bras rgyud sku dang ye shes rtsal rdzogs te kun tu bzang po'i dgongs klong byang chub shog gnad kyis dngos grub gegs med wāng nyams rtogasayon tan 'phel rgyas 'gyur sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di 'ang lu zin dormā ku mud kyis bskul ngor gter ming nus ldan rdo rjes bris pa sarba maṅga lam̐/pa(: tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa ni ma.āX snyi sku gsum kun dngosardo rje khro lod la: zhing rdul grangs mnyam lus sprul gus phyag 'tshal: 'khor 'das ro mnyam lta ba'i mchod pa 'bul: gnyis snang rmongs pa'i dri tshogs mthol lo bshags gang 'dul mdzad pa rgya mtshor rjes yi rang: gsang chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol: 'pho sted rdo rje lta bur bzhugs gsol 'debs dus gsum dge spyad 'khor gsum dag par bsngo pad+ma 'od der rig 'dzin mchog thob shog: gra sa ldan bsags pas tshogs chen rdzogs
gtsasdo sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya ces kyang lung zin rdarmā ku mud pa sa bskul ngo ra nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba dge legs 'phel sarba masgo le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las / sgrub thig le'i rgya can gyi: dbang gi lhan thabs zab mo bzhugs so:btsa/: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yi za 6/21 ma 'ongs sa'ajug gdul bya rnams yang dag lam la 'jug 'dod tshe smin grol dbang ga sgo 'di zab de yas cha rkyen lhan thabs bkod sa ma yu dang po khrus kyis sbyang ba ni (ཿ bde ga gas rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i chu skal ldan slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la: gnas pa'i nyes tshogs dri ma ci mochis kun: bkru bar bgyi'o byang zhing dag gyur cig: yig brgya bzla'o de nas rang nyid skad cig gis chos nyid don gyi rig sku bgegs 'dul khro bo'i tshogs mkha' khyab kyi phyag rgyar sad par gyur: badz+ra spra ra ṇa sa: trīḥ phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi steng 'og thams cad dang: sa 'og sa steng sa blar rgyu ba yi bgegs dang log 'dren lan chags 'byung po'i tshogs: dgegs 'dul khro rgyal 'bar ba'i bka' byung gis: skad cig yid tsam gcig gas 'dir 'dus shig: bdag gis bsgo ba'i bka' rnams nyan par bshos: sko badz+ra ṭak+ki ra dza hūṃ dza: dza hūṃ baṃ ho badz+ra

e gu sha dza: bgegs dang lan chags 'byung po thams da 'dus par bsam: skye swā bha ba sogasashukhyo nya: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las lan chags glud kyi gtor ma khadog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur: 61 ārdos lan gsum yin sarba bu ta a gar sha ya dza: lan gsum tshu rte ra'i sngags lan gsum dang a ka ra'i sngagasabaskyal bzlas bya'o (ཿ nga ni chosanyid don gyi he ru ga: khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po khro bo lod: snang cha 'gag med mtshon thun char ltar 'beb bgegs tshogs gang yang mganas phyir deng shig: ( hūṃ phaṭa bden brjod drag sngags sgra yis bskrad hūṃ hā rang byung 'gyur med ye shes chen po' rtsal: rang gdangs ma 'gags bsrung ba'i 'khor lo che: rang rigagasal stong rol ba dwangs ma'i sbubs: rang gsal rtag brtan 'gyur med chen por gyur: ma badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ta hūṃ: de nas bden don bshad par bya slar ya me tog sbyin pa ni 67 a kho wi ra hūṃ mig dar ni oṃ tsaka kya byusmo wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hwa: slar ya slob ma lhar bskyed ri ma swā byu wa sogs nya: gzung 'dzin gnyis bsnas kyi chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur

btsa/: stong pa'i ngang las: spyan 'dren las byang grub nas ye shes dbab pa'ilha tshogs rnams tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas me tog dor ba na hūṃ ye nas rang byungasku gsum lhar: 'brel ba'i yi dam lhag pa'i lar: rig pa'i me tog bab pa rtsa mchog gsum bden pa'i byin gyis rlobs: badz+ra pukhye pu ts+tsha ho: de nas mig dar bsal ba na hoḥ bde bshegs snying po chos sku'i zhal: lkog gyur ma rig mun pa'i smag: bsal nas sku gsum zhing mthong shog rang byung lha sku ngo mtshar che: ma dz+nya na tsaka kyum we sha ya phaṭa: de nas mtho ba bstan pa ni hoḥmatshan ma thabs kyidakyil 'khor 'di la mtshan med rang byung gi ye shes kyi don thams cad ma 'gags rang byung brda don rtags gsum gyi tshul du shar ba'o: de yang nang ga ga ma'i ye shes mngon sum du mjal ba 'di kho na'o: 'di kho na'o 'di kho na'o: de nas gtor dbang bskur ba ni 'o skal ldan dad dam ldan parnams nyon cig: gtor snod bhan+ta bde skyong rang byung gi nang du dpal gyi gtor ma khrag 'thung yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po: phyi ltar na he ru g.yab yum 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor: nang

ltar na rang byung 'ad lnga'i dal lhun grub kyi dbang dang dngos grub kyi sang mdzod chen po:gsang ba ltar na rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsang gsum rdzogs pa'i dbyings spros pa dngabral ba'i rang bzhin du bsgom mo: de las 'od zer dkar dmar byang chub sems kyi rgyun can dpag tu med pa byung nas khyod rang gi gnas gsum du zim pas sgo gsum gyisdig sgrib dag dbang bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la 'pho: he ru ga'i skal ba dang mnyam: 'khor ba yongs sgol gyi mthu thob: rgyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las la dbang 'byer b.rabasam la: gtor dab bskur de nas mtha' rten galtar pa na che ram̐g rtsal 'gags med ye shes kyi cho rol las byung bas bkra shis rtag brgyad dang 'phags pa'i nor rnams 'dzom pa'irgyal srid sna bdun po rigs kyi bu rnams la sbyin cing gtad pas rgyal bu rgyal sar bton nas rgyal srid la mnga' dbang 'byor ba ltar rang don chos sku'i gtan srid la mnga'adabang 'byor nas gzhan don gzugs sku'i 'khor ba dong sprugs nus pa'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig:aṣ+ṭa maṅga lo a bhi ṣiñca ma: bkra shis bsngo smon mthar rgyas bya dga'

btsasdo: ston tshogs kyis 'khor lo bskor gnad des bde legs pha na bde 'byung dbang dang daro sa grub mdzod du 'gyur bka' sru rgya mtshos thub par srungs the tshom med do sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gter rgya sbas rgya gab rgya snyi rgya ces pa 'di ya chos kyi bdag ro pa d+ma chos ze la rgya ma/tshos dar dang zhal gsungs bcas te ya ya bskul ba da sngar nas rang slob 'gyur rgyam dang sher rgyam gnyis kyi bzhed ngor bdag 'dra dpa' po nusaldan rdo rjes sa pa dge legs 'phe la/sarba ma ṅga la/

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje'i snying po las: hūṃ sgrub thig le'i rgya can gyi bsreg blugs las bzhi lhun grub bzhugs so:bsgo/ cha na mo gu ru dha rwa dza ye 211bye/ ma 'ongasalas ldan don ched du zab po' bsnyen sgrub sngon song nas kha skong las bzhi lhun grub pa'i bsreg blugs zab pa'i mthar thug bstan sa ma yā de yang zhi shangab lu dang rgyas pa stag shi dbang la ni can+dan 'am ni shug dmar byed drag po tsher nag las brtsam hom zlum po gru bzhi zla gam pa gru gsum sor brgyad mtho ga bcag gru da rtse dgu byang bya thig kya chen po ltar rnam par byas la til nag yam shang dang mar khu lir+sha sha yis brgyan tsher shing sngags kyi byang bu da 'byu sna spung la las gzhung bsrangs mchod bstod gsol kha rdzogs nas slar ces asne sarba dz+wa la ram̐: zhes brjod dpal 'bar shar lha'i sbar oṃ garma ḍak+ki nitaiḥbadz+ra ra ti yi yo ye : zhes brjod rlu g.yab nub byang rdeb oṃ swā bha was stong pa ra sbyang dmigs med chos sku'i rol ba las: lhun grub ye shes snying rje'i mdangs: rgyu yi 〉ཿdmar 'phro 'du las: me dpung dmar nag 'byil ba'i klong: pad zla dam sri bsnol ba'i steng: rab 'jigs stag mo rngams pa'i khrir: dpal chen rdo rje

che nge mnad spug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan gsum rab bsgrad khro gnyer sdud: am gtsegs bsdam la mche ba gtsegs: smar smin me yi tsha tsha 'phro: za ber mthingasham 'dung ma mdzes: phyag g.yas rig stong rdo rje phyar: g.yon pas lcags nag phur pa gzir: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs bsgrad me 'od 'ja' thig 'khrigs pa'iklong: spyi bor rakru thod phreng rdzogs phyogs bzhir dpa' bo sde bzhi mdzes: mtshams su mkha' 'gro ging chen 'khrab: sgo bsrung dam can sde bzhi sogs: dkyil 'khor raba'abyams 'khor lo kun: ma 'dres 'od sku'i rol bar bskyed: gnas gsum las ni 'od 'phros pas: dbyi sa bzhugs rgyal ba sras dang bcas: ma lus spyan drangs sa ma dza me dar thog la rol mo labrol spyan drangs dbyer med chen por bsnyim /ཿ zang thal yeshes pho brang mchog: rnga yab srin po'i grong khyer dbus zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas kyi dal: thodapa'i sku mkhar gzhal yas nas: o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rdo rje khro lod rnam pa rtsa spyan drangs dbyer med ro gcig gyur: bla gu ru badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa ma ya dza dza: de nas bzhugs

btsarnya su gsol ba ni lha hrī mi shig bden chen da la rtsa rang byung gsang ba'i pho brang la: dbyings nas drangs ba'i ye shes lha: gnyis med bde ba chen por bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan de nas phyag 'tshal rim pa ni na mo: ye chenags rig pa byang chub sems: pad+ma thod phreng lha tshogs la: rnam gsum dag pa chen po yis zung 'jug chen por gus phyag 'tshal : na mo pu ru sha ya ho: de nas byon skyems 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i rdzas: bdud rtsi rmad byung a dṛ ta: 'bru bcud rtsi yi mar khu yis: rdo rje 〈sna ma da dgyes phyir 'bul rtsa sngags mthar dz+nyā na pañca a bṛ ta la khā nyi: bdun sum nyer gcig dag gis phul skabs su gzhung ga mchod pa bya de nas zhi rdzas 'bul ba ni skyid ā hūḥ che nga gsal bde ba chen po las: lhan skyes ye shes gsang ba'i rdzas: sgrib tshogs dag par byed pa'i rgyu: 'bru mchog til gyi mchod pa 'di lag pa'i lha tshogs dgyes par 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangs: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i brin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar ces sarba pa pe da ha na badz+ra ye swā hwa: brgya stong la sogs ci rigs bskyal de yis zhi ba' phrin

las lasab skabs su 'dod gsol bya ba ni 'o lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje khro lod kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs kun tu sgrib pa dang nyams chags sbyang ba la bar du gcod pa'i gri gshed 'dre srin 'gab 'dre bse rag dur sri sarba sha hūṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru hūṃ phaṭa swā hā: de nas rgyas pa' rdzas 'bul ba 31 ā hū dbyings rig gnyis su med pa las: zung 'jug byang chub sems kyi sprin : ye shes yon tan rgyas pa'i rdzas: rtsi bcud 'bru bcud mchod pa 'bul: lha tshogs ma lus dgyes pa bskangs: dpal 'byer rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar sarba pañca a pra ta la khā hi brgya stong la sogs ci 'grub bskyal de yis rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub skabs su 'dod gsol bya ba ni 'oḥ lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje khro lod kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan dbang thang rlung rta snyan grags thams cad gong nas gong 'phel

badz+ra 'a du rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa'i gri gshed 'dre srin 'gab 'dre bse rag dur sri 'byung po sarba sha hūṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru hūṃ phaṭa swā hā: de nas dab gi rdzas 'bul ba oṃ āXḥhūṃḥ rig stong gnyis su med pa las: lhan skyes byang chub sems kyi rdzas: gnyis med ye shes bkod pa mchog: rang byung yams shing mchod pa 'bul: lha tshogs ma lus dgyes pa bska sa: khams gsum dbang sdud phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar sa bho dhi dh+ri k+ta ye swā hā: brgya sto la sogs ci rigs bskyal de yis dbang gi phrin las lasab skabs su 'dod gsol bya ba ni 'o: lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje khro lod kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs kun tu khams gsum srid gsum 'dod dgu'i longs spyod dbang du sdud pa la bar du gcod pa'i gri gshed 'dre srin 'gab 'dre bse rag dur sri 'byung po sarba sha hūṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru hūṃ phaṭa swā hā: de nas drag po' rdzas 'bul ba o āX ཿhūṃ chos dbyings khyab brdal rol ba las:

zung 'jug byang chub sems kyi rdzas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mchod sprin gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes par 'bul: bdud 'dul drag po'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar :dri sarba sha tsu ma ra ya phaṭa kha ram̐ khā nyi: brgya stong la sogs ci rags bskyal de yas drag po' phran las 'grub skabs su 'dod gsol bya ba ni 'oḥ lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje khro 31da kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs kun tu dug lnga dug gsum las byung ba'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs bcom pa la bar du gcod pa'i gri gshed 'dre srin 'gab 'dre bse rag dur sri sarba sha hūṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra spra ra ku ru ku ru hūṃ phaṭa swā hā skabs 'dar gzhung gi bstod pa gto de nas tshogs da bskang ba bya so rtsi gos zung 'bul ba'i rjes slar yang gshegs skyems pu tsa yi rjes su phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul de nas bstod pa'i rim pa ni hūṃ hrī: bde chen gdod nasarnam par dag: rang byung sku dang ye shes dbyings smra bsam brjod pa kun bral ba'i: lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas dngos grub len pa ni oṃ yang hā lha

badz+ra: tshogs dgyes las byung ba yi : sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mchog: rdo rje gsum gyi dbang dngos grub: sgo gsum bum pa'i sgod du bskyil: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sidhi pha la (ཿ de nas gzhung gi bshags pa da bzod gsol yig brgyas nongs pa bshags rgyas gdab bsngo ba smon lam brjod de nas gshegs gsol ba na cesaḥ ye regs khyab brdal gsang ba'i lha: chos nyid bde ba chen por rlu: slar yang 'dod pa bskang ba'i phyir: ye shes lha skur bzhengs su gsol: rtsa sngags mthar a a: de nas bkra shis dga' ston bya gnad des tshogs gnyis rjo gas pa da dbang da dngos grub 'aze la rgyas phyar thabs mang dka' ba med ra bstan las can bu yis nyams su longs sgod med rnams la a tham rgya bka' srung shan dmar rgyal por gnyer thub pa ra gyis shig sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya ñcā ces pa 'di 'a rnal 'byer ba 'gyur med rgya mchos bskul ngor sngagasa'achang nus ldan rdo rjes bris pa dge legs 'phel dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ sarba maṅga lam/ shu snye/

gas/ bum sgrub ni o swā wa sogs ko3nya: bum pa midamigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: mtshan nyid phun tshogs gzhal yas khang chen nang rdo rje khro lod lha tshogs kun gsal ba'i: thugs ga'i srog las 'od 'phros ye shes dbab: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo na ma ho: badz+ra pur+sha dhāpe sogs shabha rū pa shabha gharnye ra sa spasne dharma ma hā pañca rak+ta bā lirte sta na ga ṇa pu dza ho: de nas bstod pa ni hūṃ trī snang srid zil gnon pad+ma rgyal po'i gar: gnyis med 'khor 'des 'ub chub khro bo lod: rtog tshogs gnas dag rang byung 'khor du 'gyed: che ba'i yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la: 'khril te mdun bskyed bum lha'i thugs rgyud bskul: thams cad sku las byang chub sems kyi rgyun: bab pas bum chur dbyer med ro gcig gyur: rtsa sngags ca mang mthar mchod bstod mthar snyen āḥshāḥ bum pa'i lha chogs rten dang brten par bcas pa 'od bu tha nas bum pa'i rtsa dang ro gcig 'dres par gyar: las byed bum pa ni las kyi bum pa mi dmigs pa sngong pa nyid du grur: stong pa'i ngang las pad zwa'i gdan la khro

chen rta mgrin dmar po dbyug do dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i skur bskyed la: khyed badz+ra kro dha ha ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: brgya stong ci nus su bzla bar bya'o mthar mchod cing bstod la bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu la thim pas dag byed kyi chu nus pa dang ldan par dmigs sa ma yā nyer mkha'i ched du nus lan rdo rjes bris pa dge'o/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las (ཿsgrub thig le'i rgya can gyi srog 'khor zab palirgya can bzhugs so:pa(: na mo gu ru pad+ma kwa ra ye cas 1sgo mabazla// bdag 'dra rgyal b.lidabang po pad+ma ngas las ldan gdul bya smin grol lam 'god phyir zab pa'i lam mchog rdo rje snying po'i chos phyi nang gsang ba'isgrub skor bcu gsum dang lag len kha bskang man ngag mdo rtsa bcas ran chen brda la bcugs te gter du sbas ma 'ongs0〈 chung lo tsās rted par 'gyur las ldan chos kya bdag por gnyer kha gtad zab pa'i nyams len bsnyen sgrub tshad 'byol na rtags dang rten 'brel mtshan ma bzang po 'byung sa ma yu de mang dpal chen rdo rje khro lod kyi nang sgrub don bsdus nyams len byed 'dod na mkho ba'i yan lag snying las gces pa'i rdzas bla rdo srog 'khoragand du bzung bar gces de yang sman shog dri ma bral ba'i ro ra bzang drug bsres pa' rgya mtshal cog la yis dbang gi dus su lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i mu khyud rim pa bcu gsum bskor dbus su lha mtshog nyid kyi sku gzugs dang snying po srog gzhug yid du 'ong bar bya phyi ram pad+ma 'dab bzhi lte ba la rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram ster mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i sa bon gsal bar bkod mtshams su brten par bzhugs pa'i snang po bri de rgyab 'khor lo

rtsibasabazha'i lte ba la dpa' bo sde bzhi' sa bon brten bzhugs bkod mtshams su ging bzhi'i snying po gsal bar bri de rgyab 'khor lo rtsabs lnga'i lte ba la bka' gter sde lnga'i sngags dang tiṣ+ṭha lan mtshams su rgyal chen zhing skyong yab yum sngags de rgyab dbu can tshag med 'di ltar bkod oṃ stsabadz+ra gu 〈 khro bo lod lo ka sarba sirnyi /ཿ dpal chen rdo rje khro bo lod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bla chags par gyur cig srog gnas par gyur cag gza byin 'bar bar gyur cig mchog thun dngos grub rtsol cig dhe wa sirnyi hrī oṃ badz+ra ḍak+ki ni (ཿ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku gsu thugs gnas par gyur cag oṃ rat+na ḍasnyi ni hūṃ rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs gnas par gyur cig oṃ pad+ma ḍasgri ni (ཿ pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs gnas par gyur cig oṃ garma ḍasgri ni /ཿ las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs gnas par gyur rig dam tshig nyam sa chags 'gal 'khrul sor chud par gyuracig de rgyab ma badz+ra dha ka ni4 rdo rje dpa' bo'i sku gsung thugs brtan par gyur cag oṃ ratā dha ke ni /ཿ rat+na dpa' bo' sku gsung thugs brtan pa ra gyur cig oṃ pa d+ma dha ki ni hūṃ pad+ma dpa 'a bo'i sku gsung thugs brtan nga ra gyur cig oṃ na dha ki ni (ཿ ga dpa' bo' sku gsung thugs brtan par gyur cig: sarba rat+na bā su kha dhe na na sarnyi pha la hūṃ oṃ badz+ra king ka ra hūṃ rdo rje rigs kyi ki ka ra'i sku gsung thugs chags par gyur cig oṃ ratā king ka ri hūṃ rin chen rags kyi king ka ra'i sku

gtsa(: gsung thugs chags par gyur cig oṃ pad+ma king ka ra hūṃ pa d+ma rigs kyi ga ka ra'i sku gsung thugs chags par gyur cig oṃ na ki ka ra hūṃ las kyi rig kyi king ka ra'i sku gsu thugs chags paragyuracig nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'aze la zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ dhi ta rasta ye hūṃ rgyal po yul 'khor bsrung brtan par gyur cig oṃ ste ru dha ka hūṃ rgyal po 'pha gas skyes po brtan pa ra gyur cig o bhe rgyu bhastoye sno rgyal po spyan ma bzang brtan pa ra gyur cig oṃ be+e sha ra ma ṇa ye hūṃ rgyal po rnam thos sras brtan pa ra gyur cig 'jigs pa 'i tshogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cag oṃ ma hā ka la hūṃ legs ldan nag mo 'i srog chags par gyur cig oṃ ma ha dhe wa hūṃ dbang phyug chen po 'i srog chags pa ra gyur cig e he rme ru rtse hūṃ shan pa dmar po'i srog chags par gyur cig oṃ e ka dza ṭi hūṃ sngags kyi bdag mo' srog chags par gyur cig oṃ re tu re ma ti hūṃ ma modapa la ldan lha mo' srog chags par gyur cig bstan dgra drungs nas 'byin pa ra gyur cig de rgyab 'chang ba po' lus ngag yid srungs shig rasnya rakru hūṃ yi dam khro bo lod ḍak+ki phag mo bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dpa la bskyed dhaki rigs bzhi las mdzad ging chen sde bzhi bstan skyong srog bdag mched lnga bka' nyan rgyal chen sde bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa rnams kyis sgrub pa po mchog da thun mongs ga daro sa grub rgya chen po stsol cig

sarba ma hā gu ru dhe wa ḍasnyi ni sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā de rgyab oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dus ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ bstan pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i mtha' mi kla klo du ru rdzas sbyor na pa dus 'khrug nad yam sogs mi 'dod pa 'i phyogs ngan pa thamasacad zhi bar gyur cig legs tshogs tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad yar ngos zla ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhang rgyas par gyur cig khams gsum srid gsum 'dod rgu'i phya g.yangadabang du 'du bar gyur cig bstan dgra dam nyams bdud sge 'byung po thamasacad tshar gcod par gyur cig de rgyab rtsa sngags yongs rdzogs mjug phyi 'byung ba lnga ru ma 'chams rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi shad stong paragyur cig mi sdu ru sdu ru dza ma ma khe swā snya nang kung po lnga la mi 'tshams nad yam rgud pa'i rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing sto ra gyur cig oṃ sdu ru sdu ru dza gas ba rlung sems ting 'dzan dbyer ba 'phro rgod phyi nangarlung 'thor ba sogs rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing stong par gyur cig oṃ sdu ru yang gsang zab mo de bzhin nyid sgom pa 'i thegs su gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa nyams kyi bye brag su gyur ba'i rten 'brel nyes pa' phyogasathams cad zhi zhing sto par gyur cag oṃ sdu ru de rgyab dbyangs da gsal byed las bzha' sham de rgyab rdo rje'i ra ba'i dra gur gtams de rgyab me ru 'bar ba'i yongs su bskor de rgyab rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun bskor de

gtsa( rgyab 'byu— bzhi lcags zhags sgrog dril bri dzos ni nag po gsum dang ser po bdun dmar po gnyis dang snying rdo dang phur bu tsan dan seng ldeng dag gas brtsams gangs seng dkar po 'i 'o ma'i brlan te byug ye shes lnga ya ching kyis rgyas gdab bci dkyil 'khor dbus gzhug dal dmar gur phub la phyi nang mchod pa rgya chen dag gis bskor bsnyen sgrub gzhung bzhin tang 'dzin rgya yis bsgrub de nas mgul gdags phya na bar chad sel nyams rtogs dang la 'bar lha tshogs las grib bzhin 'grogs nas phran las rab 'byams thogs med 'grub the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po' bka' sa ma yā sa ma rgyal bamidabang po pad+ma so bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis gdams pa ya zab snying gi nor bu bstan ma nor lag len chud ma za bar mdzod byin rlabs rno so rtags mtshan khyad pa ra 'pha gas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes byas dam nyams snod min lag tu ma shor cig skal bzang snying ga bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya ces pa 'di ya 'gyur med rgya mchosabaskul ngor nu ldan rdo rjesasmras te sngags mang pas yi ge phab pa'o sarba ma lam/ gla nag rtsigu gul nag po/ pong nga nag po gsum mo/ gla rtsi gu gul bong ser yu sa dkar/ ba bla gi wa sirgyu ra dang bdun no/ rak+ta dang mtshalaganyis so// bden don dzi de nas bden don bshad pa ni 'oḥ mkha' khyab kyi 'a11 ba sems can rnams

gdod ma'i sa la 'god par bya'o: de yis ched du smin byed dbang gi rim pa gsan 'tshal: de yang lo rgyus zur tsam ma zhus na cho ga'i yan lag mi tshang bas: des na lha 'di'i ngo bo ni chos sku snang ba mtha' yasaso: khro bo ltar na dbang chen rta mgrin no gsung ltar na 'phags ma rigs byed dbang mo'o: thugs rje kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas so chags med pad+ma'i sbubs las bltams pa'i mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes grags so: khams gsum dbang sdud kyi mtshan ba dan dkar po phyogs bcur khyab pa'i pad+ma rgyal po'o dus khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i nyi ma 'od zer ro slob dpon pra bha ha sti la bsten nas rnal 'byor rgyud sogs kyi dgongs don la mkhas dbang 'byer ba'i blo ldan mchog srid do a su ra yi brag phug chen po ru dge slong kun dga' bo la bsten nas rab tu byung bas shākya seng ge zhes grags: theg gsum gyi dgongs don mngon du brtes shing sna tshogs 'gro la phan bde'i char chen 'bebs pas gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha wa 'o gdug pa mu stegs dang dam sri bstan

'amatshu dgra thams cad drungs nas 'byin mdzadaseng gesgra sgrogs so bal yul gyi gdul bya rdzogs par byas nas la srin gdug pa can tshar gcod par mdzad pa'igu ru gtum drag rgyal po'o bod yul mun pa'i gling 'dre ma sang gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba dang: gnas chen gangs brag rnams la gter chen sbas shing las can smin grol gyis la 'god pasadapal chen rdo dze+ekhro bo lod du bzhengs pa'o: ngo bo skye ba med cing byin rlabs thun rje'i sprin dpung 'khrigs pa'ibla ma khro bo lod dang mchog dang thugs mong gi dngos grub 'dzad med yid bzhin du rtsol ba'i dam rdo dze+egro dha ra dzar shar ba'o: rlung sems kyi zag pa zad cing bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed pa'imakha' 'gro rdo (khro bo lod do sgrub pa po'i phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du bsgrub pa dang bdud dang dam sri tshar gcod pa'i chos skyong rdo dzikhro bo lod kyirang bzhin yin no 'di nyid rnal 'byor ba'i yi dam du byas na bdud kyi mi tshug: dam sri'i glags mi rnyed mo 'dre 'byung po' snying 'dar: sabha 'byung po'i g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ro: sku ltar du sgrub pa'i

lus rdo rje'i sku ru smin pa dang: bum dbang gi nus pa theb pas sprul skur grol te bag chags ngan pa'i skye rgyun chod par 'gyur ro gsung ltar du sgrub pa'i ngag rdo rje'i gsung dusmin pa dang: gsang dbang gi nus pa theb pas longs skur grol te bar do'i 'khrul rtog gi rgyun chad par 'gyur ro: thugs ltar du sgrub pa'i yid rdo rje'i thugs su smin pa dang tshig dbang gi nus pa theb pas chos skur grol te 'chi srid chos nyid kyi dbyings su zad par 'gyur ro: de ltar sgrub dang dkyir 'khor 'dus pa'i bla ma dpal chen po yid du bya bal thog mar sgo gsum smin cing grol bar bya ba zab lam dbang gi dal du 'jug par byed pa gal che ba'o: gang phyir bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad pa'i drung du maṇ+ḍal phul zhing sgogasum 57sa gus tshad med dang ldan pa'i bye nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes cho sa mdzod: lan gsum gdab la sdom bzung sogs gzhung ltar grub pa'i byin rlabs 'pho dab gi cha lag gab pa 'a don dharmās bskul ngor surwa yas bris dge'o dge'o dge'o/ sarbamasgo lam/

bsnye: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dpal chen rdo rje khro lod kyi: hū: sgrub thig le'i rgya can las mgon po legs ldan nag po'i gsol mchod bstan dgra tshar gcod zhes bya ba bzhugs so: ba rte na mo gu ru parnya ka ra ye 'disgo maca'ishāste ma 'ong las ldan pho mo yis zab gsang bsnyen sgrub lhur len tshe bar tshad dgra yas rgol gyur na bstan srung 'di nyad srog gtar zungs sa ma yā de yang las gzhu bsra ba'i rjes gsol mchod bya ba'i rim pa ni sha khrag mchod rdzas yo byad bkram bsangs sbyangs byan gyis brlabs byas te ra nyad lha yi nga rgyal gyas hūṃ bh+yo ling ga'i yul gyi dur khrod nas: dbus kyi ri bo ma la ya: ko kha thang dmar rgya mcho' dor: drag shul yod pa'i rtse mo rtsa bdud kyi sde tshogs pham mdzad pa'i ma hā kwa la mthu bo che: yum chen kro ti shwa ri ma: bka' nyan dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas: ma thogs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: bla rdo srog 'khor rten la bzhugs : phrin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal: rgyal bstan srung ba'i dbu 'phang bstod: dgyes bskyed dam rdzas rmad byung ba: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: nyer sprod bdun dang

'dod yon lnga:sman gtor rak+ta bkra shis rtags:rgyal srid sna bdun bkod pa dang:ri dwags g.yung dgas chu gnas bya:gcan gzan bya rigs sna tshogs dang:'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod chen pos:ma hā kā lā gsol zhing mchod:legs ldan nag po gsol zhing mchod: kro ti shwa ri gsol zhing mchod:las mdzad pho nya gsol zhing mchod:'khor tshogs sprul pa gsol zhing mchod: khyed rnams mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis:dmag 'khrug dus kyi rgud pa sol 'jig rten bde skyid ldan par mdzod :khyod ni pad+ma'i bstan srung ba:bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung:dam tshag gsang srog gcig yin pas:lus dang grib bzhin 'bral med 'grogs:byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen sol:mthun rkyen spel ba'i yon bdag kyis:'khor sgob 'dus sde rgyas par mdzod:phyogs bcur chos kyi sgon me sbor khyad par rdo rje snying po yi bstan pa yar ngos zla ltar spel:der 'dzin thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhing:tshom bu gcig tu sa sa rgyas re ga:tha tshig sgrub mdzod dam tshig can:ma g.yel ma 'gyangs sa ma yā ces pa ci 'grub grangs bsogs nas

gas(rnya dmigs bsal phrin las gang bcol ba thogs med yad bzhin 'grub par 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma yu ye ma rgyalaba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas ma 'o sa 'gro la brtse sems kyis snying da 'dra ba'i yang zab skor 'brog ma lo tsā khyod la gtad da dung ma spel brda la thobs rdo rje'i rdzongs la dgong sa pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyags ma'i dus skabs su sprul las can gcig gas rted bstan 'gro'i don chen 'byung bar 'gyur de bar sru sa shig srog bdag lnga skal med lag tu ma shor cig thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mgon po leg ldan nag po 'i gsol mchod bstan dgra tshar gcod rjo gas so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya mo rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyiḥ dran gyi mang ba pad chos dang dran sgo mang ba 'gyur rgyam gyis/ dran dran thol byu tshul bskul ngor/ dran rig klong yangs nus ldan pas/ dran tshad smras te smon sems bris/ sarba maṅga lam/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dpal chen rdo rje khro lod kyi ྅ sgrub thig le'i rgya can las bla ma drag po'i bstan srung sgog bdag sde lnga'i zab sgrub dug khrag khol ma bzhugs soḥ ba rte na mo gu ru parnya ra ka ye ca/dza/tsa)rgya/yi rab 'byamasargyal ba thasabacasam phrin las gcag bsdus 'gro ba'i mgon gdug pa 'dul mdzad khro bolod mthon mthing ral bas btud de 'dud bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kya ma 'ongs las ldan don phyir du zab gsang bstan pa 'i so kha ba srung ma sgrub palilas rim bstan sa ma yu depang snyasto dum bzha'i dbus drag po sdelnga'i brten gtor na zhal las shes pa ji bzhin du bkod cing phyi na nyer spyod bkram bas sa dang sgrub rdzas khrus gsol bya rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis mdun du srung ma gsal ba ni snyen swā bha wa sogs rang mdun me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i dbus: bam dang bdud tshogs bsgol ba'i khri yi khar: / bab 'phro 'dus 'khor 'das dang bcud bstem yongs gyur legs ldan ma hā ka la ni sku mdog mthing nag char sprin lhun po 'dra: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gcigs: smar smin me 'bar khro gnyer rab tu 'khrigs: mthing nag ral ba gyen brdzes

thod skam brgyan: gzugs thung gzi brjid che ba srin po'i sku phyag g.yas lcags kyu nam mkha'i dbyings su phyar: g.yon pas dgos 'dod kun 'byung gter bum 'dzin: dar ljang ber klubs mgo phreng sor phreng spras stag gi sham thabs zhabs gnyis sag lte bcas: 'gying thabs tshul gyis bdud dang dam sri gnon: g.yon du yum mchog kro ti shā ri ma ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum sgeg: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsgyur thabs 'dzin: mkha' 'gro'i chas rdzogs sprin dkar 'khrigs slong bskyed de yi phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i shar du gnod sbyin shan pa dme ru rtse: sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: ral gri snying zhags gdengs shing khyung dmar bcibs:dgyes bskyed gsod byed dmar mo 'khril sbyor rol 'od 'bar me klong 'khor tshogs dang bcas bskyed: lto yi rtsibs steng 'dudabadul seng ge'i gdong mthing nag ru mtshon dgra bo'i snying zhags bsnams: bdud rta nag po kā zhur rlung gshog bcibs: dar nag ber bog stag ral gzigs shub 'khyug: g.yon du dgyes bskyed su na ra ma dmar:

she(: seng zhal rngams shing gri shul snying zhag bsnams:ber dmar gsol zhing btsan rta myur mgyogs bcibs:mdun du las byed bam ro pho mo ni phongs 5)da sbre'u'i gzugs 'dzin ha ha rgod:lag gnyis spyi gtsug sar btsugs ro lang 'gros:rkang pas dam nyams dgra la gtor zor 'phen:'jigs byed las mdzad me yi /nga du bskyed: nubagasgogs di bas ༄'aribum phrag gnyer 'dzin ma:kun du bzang mo smug nag 'od 'phro'i sku:zhal gcig phyag gnyis srin mo khros pa'i nyams:mig gcig ma gcig nu gcig rkang gcig ma:mi lpags g.yang gzhi sprin dkar thul ba klubs:phyag g.yas dgra bo'i tsit+ta dmar chen bstabs:g.yon pas sdigs mdzub rtse las gcan /nga 'gyed:ldog med a ti'i bstan pa mchog la gnas:srid pa'i ma chen 'khor 'das dbang mor bskyed: byang rin 3bas hob da nyi bam gyi khar:bstan pa'i dgra sgrol rang ༷nga rgyal mo ni:sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma:g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas bhan dmar bsnams:ral ba'i gseb tu rma bya'i sgro mdangs bkra:dpral bar

zla ba lte rgyan nyi ma mdzes: thod skam dbu rgyan dar sna'i cod pan 'phur gser 'khor gdug pa sbrul gyis snyan cha byas zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan gsum 'bar 'khrigs rngams: mi lpags g.yang gzhi dar dpyangs mgo phreng spras: stag gi sham thabs rus pa'i rgyan drug bkra: 'gying thabs srin mo khros pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis: srin thod sga gong dril dmar chibs su bcibs: khams gsum yid gyis bskor ba'i stobs dang ldan: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i pho nyar bskyed: gzhan yang bar mtshams ye shes las grub pa'i:pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kun: ma 'dres til gong phyur bzhin lam mer gsal: kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rang bzhin gar bzhugs pho brang nas: spyan drangs dam ye gnyis su med par bstim: sbos bsreg rol mo'i sgra bcas 'di skad do hū hrīḥ ying ga'i yul gyi dur khrod chen po nas dpal ldan ma hā kā wā gshegs su gsol: rngams brjid he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod nas: dbang drag shan dmar yab yum gshegs su gsol pho brang mkha' spyod tsa ri'i gzhal yas nas bdud 'dul seng

ba:tshu gdong yab yum gshegs su gsol: 'og min mkha' spyod rol ba'i dur khrod nas: dbyings yum smug nag 'od 'phro gshegs su gsol: kun khyab brdalaba'i gnas mchog dam pa nas: dpal ldan rang byung rgyal mo gshegs su gsol: bka' gsang bstan pa srung ba'i pho brang nas: las mdzad dam can rgya mtsho gshegs sugasol: o tsasgom hwa kā wā kro ti shwa ri e he dme ru rtse gu ṇa hri da dhi dri ya ma ra tsa du dri phu dri e ka dza ṭī ma mo re ma ti sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: de nas b.las su gsol bani hūṃ (ཿ dam rdzas rmad byung dpal gyi gtor chen dang bla rdo srog 'khor gsang thod 'bar ba dang: sgrub pa'i dam rdzas dgyes bskyed yo byad la bstan srung dam can rgya mtshobazhugs su gsol: tshe badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal bya ba ni na ma dam tshog gsams par srung ba'i lha chen po : rgyal bstan so kha 'dzin pa'i tha tshig can: dregs pa sdelnga dam can rgya mtsho la: lha phyag 'tshal lo brtse ba chen pos skyongs: na mo a ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho: de nas mar pa lathul ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ rgyal bstan srung ba'ipho nya dam tshig can: srog

bdag sde lnga dgyes pa'i dam rdzas ni: rnam lnga sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol skyems:sha khrag dar zab 'dod pa'i yo byad dang: ri dwags g.yung dwags chu gnas bya yi rigs gcanagazan sna tshogs rten dang rgyun gyi gtor: mkho rgu'i longs spyod dgra bgegs sha khrag rus: nam mkha' gang ba'i mchod sprin mtha' yas pas: bstan srung dam can rgya mtshomanyes gyur cig: tshe ma hā pañca puts+tsha ho: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni hū bye be+eng ga'i yul la dbang mdzad rdzu 'phrul can: lha min pham zhing bdud sde tshar gcod byed dam chos dbubastod dge 'dun 'dus sde spel: legs ldan nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:he chen brdal ba'i zhing skyong dme ru rtse: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gar la mnga' dbang bsgyur ldog med a ti'i bstan pa 'dzin srung spel: dbang drag shan pa dmar nag sku la bstod zhing dang nye shing dur khrod skyong mdzad cing: zab gsang bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin mthustobs can: bdud 'dul las byed rngams pa seng ge'i gdung:drag shul 'gran zla bral la phyag 'tshal bstod:dbyings la gnas kyang ye shes thabs tshul mkhas: 'bum phrag

gtsa/ rgyud kyi gnyer 'dzin bcud srung ma: spyan gcig khrag khol bstan dgra'i gshed po che: e ka dza ṭī'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mu le mthing mtshor dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul can: sgrub pa po la brtse ba chen pos skyong: zhing bcu'i dgra la zhe gnag rngams zas byed: rang byung rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: gangs can mig gcig pad+ma'i spyan snga ru khas blangs mna' bor dam tshig srung mdzad pa'i: pho nya yang g.yog sprul 'khor dpung bcas la: rtse gcig 'dud cing gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod:bdag dang bdag gi nye 'khor longs spyod dkor bstan dang chab srid g.yel ba med par srungs: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbu 'phang bstod mi mthun phyogs 'dul dgra bgegs ming med mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: ces brjod 'bod rbad bsad pa 'i bzlas dmi gas dang mchod gsol rnam lnga ca 'grub gang 'os gtong gnad des phrin las rnam bzhi gegs med 'grub the tshom med do rdo rje ba d+ma'i bka' sa ma yā ma ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snyi dang 'dra ba' yang zab skor 'brog mi lo tsā khyod la gtad da du spel ba'i dus ma yin brda la thob cig sa ra bye mdo khams

phyog su dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigasam lnga yi dus sprul ba las can gcag gis rted bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel de bar srungs shig srog bdag lnga thub par gyis shig sa ma yā skal med lag tu ma shor cig thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya sgog bdag sde lnga'i zab byub dug khrag khol ma rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'ad 'ang snyigs dus kyi bstan 'dzan la thugasakyi dpa' rngams bslang ste bstan dgra'i sha la za khrag la gzhib rus pa la 'dur nus pa'i bstan srung ga sgrub pa blog zhags las dbang myur ba zhig phob dang khong rnam gnyis kyas bstan dgra ming med mi byed re brag btsan dpang zer ba'i mod la nusaldan rdo ri brag lha mgon po' gnasamadun nas dag par phab pa'i ya ge pa na pad+ma smon sems so dge'o/legs so/ sarba maṅga lam/them medasnyi
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dpal chen bla ma drag po yi:shāḥsgrub thig le'irgya can las:rtsa sgrub gnyug ma'i gsang mdzod bzhugs so:

btsaX na mo kro rda rā dza yi sku dang yi shesagasang ba'i mdzod bde gshegs snying po sems kyi gsang gnyug ma'i ye shes kho na nyid lhan skyes rang zhal 'jal bas 'dud ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo rnams gsang chen rdo rje'i sgor zhugs na sgrub pa 'di ni med thabs med srog las gces pa ra bzung 'tshal lo sa ma yu dusangan snyigasama'i smar sham du du ru' rigs byed bco brgyad dar ro sa mi zin pa'i gdon nad 'bebs gso rum btub sna tshogs 'byung gson po'i mi rnams srin po 'dra shi tshad dam sri ngos su gyur rgya 'dre me rlu zhon pas khyab btsa' sad ser gsum 'bu srin sdang sa g.yo ri nil 'byung ba 'khrugs char chu mi snyoms bra byas gcen gsod gcod rkun jag yar la g.yeng khrims med mgo spu breg pa cam 'dul ba yan pa 'i kha tshad 'doms bu phrug gso zhing ral pa brten chol rtogs mkhan rnams sngags par grags rgyal bstan nyams dma' bdud kha drag dge 'dun mkhon 'dza sa phra mar gnas bshad dang sgrub pa rgyab tu bor sku skyes chos brgyad gol sar g.ye bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzan than la brtsa chos min dug lnga' bslu chos mang dmar po g.yu yi lding gur can rgya stag zhen nasargyal bar 'dzin ser ngo zla yi grogs po de mdangs ldan sha ba'i gnya' non dang mi drag bya ya sder mo can rigs sngags 'cha ba brgyad kya gshed stod smad bar gnas bya las ma chos min chos 'dra'i se 'ug rgan dpal

gtsaX 'dabs yi bsil grib tu se man se 'gran 'khrug la gdung sa bya lcags khyi'i grogs po can rgya mtsho dug gi gzhi ma na ha la ro bcud kho du sba mig tshor dpa la rgyal srog la rgyas rma bya'igadugs 'dzin mgo bo'i tog bstan la rgol ba'i sbyor ba brtsam de tshe gnyen po dpal khrom rdzong bdud 'dul las kyi thog mde'u lcags ra me ya tsha tsha can dpa' btsan 'chol bor khros pa nyid dam ldan srog gi ga'urabastems gso smin spel gsal thabs su 'chang 'gag med shugs 'byung rdzogs don rtsal sa ma yā seng lding phur pa mtho gang ba zhal dang rgya mdud 'chang zu dbal grub pa 'i zung 'jug rdo rje'i khrab mazing la rin chen gserargyas bra snyang por gzhugs la dar dmar dril dkyil 'khor dbus gzhug sgrub rten bya ha la dmar nag ser dang gsum gser me rgya bod sum cu tig spru nag bong dkar ka nur pha ga thun gsum a ru rgyal po sgyu ru blon bzang po drug ni 'bangs su shes gnyen po las kya 'byu dgu gong gi bsre zil gnon grogs lnga gi waṃ gla rtsi gza' sdum gser sdigs lcags sprul zhal 'debs bya ril bu spug nag sran 'bru tsam dus kyi gdon nad kun la mchog sgrubapa'i ngar 'dogs gces par zungs sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya de nas las la 'jug pa la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum dang po rnam grangs bcu gsum las skyabs su 'gro ba'i ram pa na na 31 gahuXmed ka dag 31sa

sku snang mtha' yas: lhun grub rang gsal longs sku nam mkha' rgyal: rtsol bral ro mnyam sprul sku pad+ma 'byung: 'ub chub rang ngo shes pas skyabs su mchi gnyas pa byang chub sems bskyed ni hoḥ 'khor 'das gnyis med gnas lugs ka dag don yin min re dogs bral ba gnyug ma'i ngang: so ma rang grol ye bab lhun mnyam gshis: ma bskyed ma sgom byang chub sems la gnas gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni na mo bde gshegs snying po sku gsum lhar phyag 'tshal thams cad dag mnyam kun bzang rgyan mchod 'bul: rtag chad mu bzhir bltas pa mthol lo bshags: rang grol ye rdzogs don la rjes yi rang ye bab don rtogs rig pa'i chos 'khor bskul: sku gnyis zung 'jug ngang la 'da' med bzhugs: dge tshogs 'khor gsum yongs su dag par bsngo: gdod ma'i drug ldan rgyal sar mnga' brtes shog: bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni dre sna tshogs ma 'dres rgyan rdzogs sprul sku'i dal ro mnyam lnga grol ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs: zang thal 'dzin bral ye shes chos sku'i zhing: sku gnyis mngon gyur mdzad pa mthar phyin phyir: lhun rdzogs rig

ba tshu pa'i maṇ+ḍal dbul bar bgyi: tram̐ e dam rat+na ya mi na mo sarba pu tsa ho: lnga pa bgegs la bka' bsgo na hūṃ hūṃ hūṃḥ snang srid ma bcos dag pa rab 'byams la: rang byung rig sku bla ma drag po'i sku: che ba'i stobs rdzogs rdo rje'i 'du 'phro 'byed nga bdag mtshan ma'i gdon la sdang mig bsgrad dug gsum rū dra bcal la chos skur gzhir: 〉 kro ta rā dza bṛ he ru ka khro bo lod shra spra ra ṇa phaṭa: seng ha ra ṇa sa: drug pa lan chags bsngo zhing mayis bcod ni hūṃ hūṃ trīḥ ye shes gsang chen lhu grub dkyil 'khor 'dir: nga bdag gnyis snang glo bur 'khrul ba'i gdon: ma 'gags glud gtor rgya mtshos tshims gyis la: rang grol chos dbyings ngang du mtshams bcad do: bka' la mi nyan 'khrul rtog 'byung po rnams: ye shes mtshon cha 'bar bas gzhom ta re: de bas ngang nyid rol ba chen por dengs: ( hūṃ u tsa ta ya phaṭa : / bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab bdun pa bsrung 'khor sgom pa ni 1 tī 1ཿ steng 'og phyogs mtshams dag pa rab 'byams la: ye stong gang shar rang grol dkyil 'khor ste bar chad gdon gyi ming yang mi dmigs so: chos sna thig le nyag

gcig mngon du bya: o dz+nyā nabadz+ra rakru raka (ཿ brgyad pa brda sgo dbye ba na hū hrī dri med mtha' bral sku gsum 1nga yangs zhal: sgrib byed ma rig gsum gyi dri ma yis: gsal byed ye shes zhal spyan lkog tu gyur brda thabs rig pa'i gar gyis rmongs tshogs dbye: ma badz+ra maṇ+ḍal dz+nyā na tsakyu pra we sha ya phaṭa dgu pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ri hūṃ hrīX mtha' bral ye shes chos sku snang mtha' yas ma 'gags rang grol longs sku nam mkha' rgyal: rtsol med blo 'das sprul sku pad+ma 'byung: lhun rdzogs rang byung rig pa mjal phyag 'tshal: skyod dz+nya na dṛ na mo na ma ho: bcu pa dam bca' bzung ba ni hūṃ hū dam pa 'du 'bral med pa'i gzungs thag la: rang byung rig pa'i ngo bo lu gu rgyud: dus 'dir ye shes snying po'i don rtogs nas:sgog gi slad du sku gsum lha khyod 'dzin: cha dz+nyā na tsit+ta sa ma ya shā: bcu gcig byin chen dbab pa ni hū hūṃ (ཿ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten bye phrag brgya'i: gsang chen o rgyan rang byung ngur khrod nas: gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma bral ba'i ye shes sko: padu 'byang gnas rdo rje khro bo lod: sko lnga mtshan bgrod 'phrul mtshan nyi shu lnga: gu ru sde drag lo paṇa rig

ba:tshu 'dzin tshogs: ngo bo thig le nyag gcig chos sku las rang bzhin ma 'gags longs sku mtshan ma bral: thugs rje sprul sku ma 'dres so sor shar: rig stong ngo bor ma grub gang ma mchis klong nas zang thal rtogs phyir 'dir byin phob: ye shes lnga ldan dgongs par byin gyis rlobs: badz+ra gu ru kro ta ra dza sarba sa ma ya dza dza: e a ra li hring hring pho pho : bcu gnyis mchod rdzas byin rlabs na nyes a (ཿ dbang po ma 'gag yul gyi gsal sgo dza sna tshogs ma 'dres so sor shar ba'i chos: tshogs brgyad rang grol ye shes rol bas brlabs: spang blang med par kun bzang rgyan du shar: skyes āḥs: ha ho hrī: badz+ra spa ra ṇa /: bcu gsum bshags pa bya ba ni ho med la yod par bzung ba lta bas bcom: yod snang dngos por blta ba sgom pas bsgral: 'jur bcing re dogs spyod pa la dor nas: 'bras bu dri bral rig pa mchog la blta: badz+ra sa ma ya ā: sbyor ba sngon 'gra'i rim pa'o sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya de nas dngos gzhi'i las rim la rnam grangs bdun gya sgo nas bstan dang po tang 'dzin rnam gsum ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ye stong rtsa bral chos sku de bzhin nyid: ma 'gags snying

rje longs sku kun la shar: rtsol bral sprul sku thabs shes zung 'jug rtsal: rang byung rig pa pad+mas 'di don bstan: o uhwaḥ dz+nyā na sa ma ti /: gnyis pa lha bskyed sgom pa ni hū hrī:gra zur bral ba klong chen chos kyi dbyings ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'byung lnga lhun grub gzhir stong gzugs 'dod pa rang grol ri rab khar tshogs yul rang grol dur khrod brgyad brgyad rdzogs de dbus mtshan 'dzin rang grol gzhal med khang: gnyis snang rang grol phyi nang rim gnyis shar thabs chen rtsal rdzogs rin chen lnga'i rtsig pa: tshad med rang bzhin gru bzhi rta babs ldan: phrin las lhun grub sgo rnams las bzhi'i dbyibs snang stong zung 'jug nyi zla'i seng skar har: zeg brgyad ma 'dres rdzogs ba'i ka ba la: rgyu brgyad 'khrul ba bcad phyir ka gdan bting: ma 'dres lhun rdzogs 'bras bu'i gdung ma gsal: dug gsum rtsad gcod chos phung brgyad khri'i gral: chos dbyings ye mnyam ya phub mthing gsal mdzes kun zlum thig le nyag gcig bum pa la: bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i bre mgul dang: chos gzugs zung 'jugs sa lam gcig rdzogs rtags: pad+ma

badz+ra: chos 'khor gdugs tog 'od zer 'bar: lhun grub sgyu mar rol ba'i cho rol las: 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed dang: shar bu mda' yab ba dan rgyal mtshan 'phan: gnyis rtog rang grol mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad ri dwags chos nyan chos 'khor brda thabs bsgyur 'dod yon rang grol mchod pa'i lha mo ni: bsam mi khyab pas rdo rje'i gar bsgyur spro: shes rab lhun rdzogs nang khang khro bo'i dal: rgyu drug dbyings sgol me rlung rab tu g.yo: 'brul ba rtsad gcod pho nya'i 'du 'phro 'khrigs: chags pa rab bsgral rak+ta'i rba rlabs 'khyil sku gsum lhun grub thod pa'i rtsig pa la: 'gyur ba med phyir gnam lcags 'ur mos gdab: dga' stong zung 'jug rak+ta'i spyin thabs sbyar zhe sdang dpa' bskong tsit+ta sbrul 'phyang dang: ma rig ru bzlog mig gi drwa ba sbrel gti mug bcar gnon ba su'i 'phyang pa 'phur: rtogs grol dus mnyam mchog chen lag pa'i mod: sku dang zhing khams bkod pa lhun rdzogs phyir: ma 'dres rgyan dang yon tan lhun gyis grub: de dbus chogs brgyad rang grol rin chen khri yul brgyad rnam dag byol song

brgyad gyis btegs: thabs shes zung 'jug nyi ma zla ba'i steng: rtog bral ro mnyam dz+nya na wa ra nyi'i: rnam rol za byed stag mo grus ma'i khar: sku lnga yongs rdzogs rig stong khro bo mod: nyag gcig zhal la sku gsum spyan mig zlum: bden gnyis snyan la dri bral dung gis brgyan don gnyis shangs las ra tsa hri ya sgrogs: mnyam nyid zhal la tshad med mche ba gtsigs: rngam spyod rab 'du' am gtsigs rab tu bsdams: ma rtog log 'khrul rab bsgral khro gnyer 'khrigs: srid gsum rab gnon dbu skra wa mig 'khyil: theg dgu'i don ston thod pa rim dgus brgyan: ye shes lnga ldan dar sna'i cod pan 'phur: thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug phyag gnyis pa: dug gsum gdon 'dul gnam lcags rdo rje dang: rū dra'i snying 'byin rno ngar lcags phur ni: gdengs thabs 'dzin zhing 'khor ba chos skur bsgral: gsang sngags sde drug don ston phod chen klubs: sde gsum ma 'dres 'gyed pa'i chos gos bkra: kun rtog gnas dag mgo phreng lnga bcu 'phyang: skye 'chi gnyis spang sag lam 'ja' khra mdzes: srid zhi gnyis med zhabs gnyis gyad stabs bsgrad

gtsa/ ma rig rab bsregs ye shes me lnga 'bar: ngo bo gdod nas rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i rtags: sku gsum kun 'dus rigs bdag pad 'byung bzhugs 'khrul snang gdon tshogs dbu mar bsgral ba'i phyir: lcags sdigs phag khyung khro chung 'du 'phro 'gyed sku lnga rab rdzogs thod phreng sde lnga la: bde stong kha sbyor phag mo rigs lnga'akhril: rigs bzhi'i rtags 'dzin dpa' bo sde bzhi dabhe : tshad med rang gdangs dpa' mo rigs bzhi rol: las bzhi lhun grub ging chen sde bzhi dang: bdud bzhi rtsad gcodargyal chen sde bzhi sogs: lo pan rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams: til gong phyur bzhin sku yi dbyings su rdzogs : ngo bo gtso la rang bzhin ma 'gags 'khor: thugs rje'adu 'bral med pa'i sgyu 'phrul ste: ma bcos ma rtsal lhun grub chen por sgom: gsum pa spyan 'dren bya ba na hūṃ trīḥ chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i gzhal yas nas rig stong zung 'jug rdo rje khro bo lod: ye shes lhun rdzogs gtso 'khor sprul bar bcas: dbyings nas spyan 'dren sgrub la byin chen phob: tshe badz+ra gu ru khro bo lod kro ta rā dza sarba sa ma ya dza dza

bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni hū hrīḥ gdan gsum ye rdzogs dam tshig rten gyi lhar: mi dmigs 1nga yangs las dbab ye shes pa du ma ro gcig chu la chu bzhag bzhin: sku dang ye shes zung 'jug chen por bzhugs: ma badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal bya ba ni na mo skye 'gag 'gyur ba med pa'i ye shes skuḥ rang byung thugs rje brtse bas 'gro rnams sgrol: yid bzhin nor bu lta bus re ba skongs: lhun rdzogs rang ngo rig pas phyag 'tshal lo: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ trī skye med dbyings las 'gag medasprin shar ba: snang stong mdzes pa'i me tog dbu la 'bul tshor stong bdug spos ngad ldan shangs la bstab: gsal stong snang ba'i sgron mes spyan la bskangs: rig stong bde ba'i dri chab sku la 'bul: grags stong rol mo'i tshogs kun snyan la bstab: dgyes bzhes ro mnyam rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol snang ba ma 'gags gzung 'dzin a dar+sha: sgra grags 'gags med rgyud mang dam bu ra: dri snang zhen med sbyar dud sbos sprin 'khrigs: myong grol ro mchog brgyad ldan ba lidha: reg rtog rnam dag bde mchog lha yi gos: ma

ba tshu 'gags ro mnyam 'dod yon lnga'i mchod 'bul:rkyen ngan lam du sgong ba'i dngos grub stsol chos dbyings 'gyur med byang sems a dṛ ta:chags pa rab bsgral rak+ta dmar chen po:'dod yon rnam dag ro ldan ba lidha:thab shes dbyings sbyor rdo rje pad+ma'i bcud:gnyis med gnyis 'dzin bsgral ba'i mchod pa dang:'dod yon ro mnyam lha mo'i rol rtsed bcas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bul:tshogs rdzogs don gnyis lhun grub dngos grub stsol:ma hā pañca puts+tsha ho:bdun pa rdo rje glu bstod ni hūṃ trīḥm bcos spros bral chos sku sna mtha' yas:bde chen rang shar longs sku spyan ras gzigs:rtsol med sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas ste:sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod:bla ma 'tshor bor khros pa'i he ru ga dpal chen stobs brgya'i bdag nyid khro bo lod spug nag gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs ye shes sku:lhag pa'i lha mchog nyid la phyag 'tshal bstod ye shes lnga ldan thod phreng sde lnga shar:dga' bzhi'i 'byungs gnas phag mo rigs lngar spyor tshogs brgyad rang grol gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad:yul

brgyad rnam dag dur khrod rdzogs la bstod: phar phyin drug rdzogs 'gro 'dul gu ru drug: phyogs bzhi mtsham brgyad 'gro 'dul rig 'dzin brgyad: thabs mkhas brtul zhugs 'phrul mtshan nyi shu lnga: mdzad pa bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshad med rang bzhin dpa' bo sde bzhi dang: bde stong dga' bzhi'i 'byung gnas dpa' mo bzhi: phrin las lhun grub ging chen sde bzhi dang bdud bzhi rtsad gcod rgyal chen sde bzhir bstod: rgyal bstan nub med srung ba'i so kha ba: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod cing:rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi grogs gcig pu: pho nya dam can sde lngar phyag 'tshal bstod: ro bo chos kyi dbyings nyid thig le che: rabhe bzhin ma 'dres ye shes cir yang 'char:thugs rje so so rang rig mtshan ma bral: mnyam nyid rang byung rig sku nyid la bstod: chos rnams mi dmigs dbu ma chen po'i dbyings: 'pho med mi shig sems kyi rdo rje che:yul dang yul can nyi zla'i 'gros mgyogs can: rig pa ye shes nyid du dag gyur cig: badz+ra 17 ta bṛ sa ma ya a hūṃ: dngos gzhi las kyi rim pa'o sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya de nas rjes kya rim pa la

ba tshu rnam gra sa lnga yi sgo nas bstan da po thugs dam gnad bskul ni hūṃ trīḥ mi shig thig le chos sku'i klong yangs nas: ma 'dres ye rjogs rdo rje khro bo lod: thugs dam gsang ba gsum gyi ye shes bskul: mi g.yo skye ba med pa nam mkha'i khams: ma bcos rdo rje phra ba'i 'du 'phro dkrigs: log 'khrul dug lnga'i gdon gyi sgog snying 'gem:grags stong ma 'dres 'brug sgras khams gsum g.yo: rtsal rdzogs rdo rje lta bu'i dbang dngos grub: lhan skyes gnyug ma'i ga'ur stsal du gsol badz+ra sa ma dhi ā: gnyis pa 'dzab kyi bzlas dmigs na hūṃ trīḥ ye shes 'od sku dngas ba'i gzhal yas dbus: stong gsal dbu ma 'od 'khyil thig le'i klong: thab shes zung 'jug 'bras bu ye shes sems: mi shig srog gi rdo rje'i lte ba rtsa skye med hūṃXl 'gag med lug rgyud bskor: phyed bcing ye shes rlung gis rab bskul te: snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i ngang: oṃ badz+ra gu ru khro bo lod kro ta ra dza ṭ+wāṃ phaṭa: ma yengs ting 'dzin stobs rdzoṭa pa'i ye shes thig le nyag gcig ngang mi spro mi bsdu bde ba che so ma rang grol don la blta gsum pa sgrub pa'i 'dzab dmigs ni hūṃ&ḥ 'gro drug

gnas stong ye shes gzugs skur sad: lhun grub zhing bkod ka dag chos sku'i ngang: dbyings rig ma bu zung 'jug bde ba che gang shar rang grol dgongs pa'i don la gnas:mchog thun dngos grub gsang ba gsum klong rdol: ma badz+ra gu nas bo lod ma ha ri ni sa lo ka sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā sdum 'ardug bde ba pho po yis lasar 'das chos sku nyid du gzhag rol ba rtsal rdzogs ye shes ngang de bzhin nyid du 'ub chub rol bzhi pa las sbyor 'dzab dmags ni hū hrīḥ bdud 'joms rdo rje gar gyi ye shes las chags thogs bral ba'i phrin las pho nya 'gyed:nga bdag mtshan ma'i gdon tshogs drung nas 'byin: thams cad mi g.yo chos sku khyab brdal ngang: ma badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭa ta ka ha na ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: gsal ba'i sgrom btsud ye zhes srog las kyi bu gu'i rdar bcud nas ma 'gags phrin las rgya mtsho'i sgo phyes nas don kun 'bad med 'grub lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni hū hrīḥ rdo rje'i 11ga ldan ye shes rta byas pas : gang snang sku gsum rol bar dag smin rdzogs: las kyi pho nya dam tshig sgog 'dzin pa'i: ye shes gsang ba'i srog la mnga' brnyes shog: chos kun chos nyid rol ba'i rten 'brel gyis:

badz+ra mtha' bral dbu ma'i dgongs pa mngon gyur shog: 'dzag med stobs kyis bcing ba'i ye shes 'khyil mi shig phyag rgya chen por 'ub chub shog: 'khor 'das ro mnyam ma bcos rdzogs pa che: wan skyes ye shes btsan sa zin par sgo ga: sna tshogs ma 'dres bkod pa rgya mtsho yang: chos zad blo 'das chen por sgrol bar sgo ga: sa lam rim pa bsam yas thod bsgal te: khyad chos drug ldan rgyal sar mnga' brnyes regag: gdangs gyi 'khor ba dbyings su ma stongs bar: rgyun mi chad par phrin las 'byed par shog de ma thob pa'i skye dang tshe rabs kun: lhag pa'i lha yi thugs kyi mthil bzung nas: dad mos 'od zer brgya ba'i sgyu 'phrul dru'i: lha dang dbyer med skal ba mnyam par re/ga: de lta ra smon sa re 'bras 'byu— rgyal kun thugs kya gas mdzod rdol dpa sa grub nyi ma klo nas 'char lta ba'i rgyal po rdzogs pa che gsang gsum gnyug ma' 7 sku mjal yon tan rgya mtsho rab mdzes nas 'bras bu'i 'bras bu skad cig 'char ma bcos don rdzogs e ma ho rjes kyi chas rnams tshang ba'o sa ma rwa rgya rgya rgya ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma nga'i snying gi yang bcud dam pa ste ma 'o sa 'gro la brtse sems kyis grub dbang khye 'u

chung lo tsār gtad da dung spel dus ma yin pas brda la thob cig sa ra h+ye mi 'gyur bkra shis rdzo la sbos klu bdud btsan la gnyer byang gtod snyig ma lnga mtshang mngon gyur skabs nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan pa nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed 'gro don bsam ma khyab pa 'byu dus gzug nad yams rgud pa gso phyogs las rnam rgyal snang ba maro na the tshom med do sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya them med rtsa sgrub gnyug ma'i gsang mdzod rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gu hre o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pa d+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkha' chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim ñcā ces pa 'ad 'ang lung zin 'gyur med rgya mtshos rin chen dang po bkra shis la reg kha tshar ma nyams ba' ras yug thabs shes kya brda thabs 'dzoms pa'i skyes dang bcas te ya ya bskul ba da chos bdag dharma ku mud kyis ran chen sbogashel bkra shis pa reg rnga bo che 'brug sgra zil gnon sogasakyi skyes bcas yang yang bzhed ro ra don da ldan pa'i phyir du bdag 'dra dpa 'a bo dri med klo yas sa rdo rje 'am khrag 'thung nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las zhal bshus te gtan la dbab pa'i yi ge pa ni sa marnya bha dra ma ṇas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo lam/

btsa/: rdo rje glu bstod bya ba ni snyan pa' dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug da yon tha dran pa'i mos gus kyis pa trīḥ rdo rje ma chagasadri ma bral ba'i dbyings: rdo rje thabs chen rol rtsed bsgyur ba ni: rdo rje skye 'chi bsgres rgud mi mnga' ba: rdo rje 'od mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje'i gdung 'dzin dpal ldan pad+ma skyes: rdo rje gar gyis gdul bya thabs kyas 'dul: rdo rje rigs kyi myu gu smin mdzad pa'i rdo rje pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje 'jigs byed gar dbang khro ba'i sku: rdo rje ha la ma rung bgegs kyi gshed rdo rje gdung drug ye shes 'jigs pa can: rdo rje khro lod sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje'i gdung can sgeg bzhad rngams pa'i sku: rdo rje dpa' rngams mche gtsigs skan sgra ldeb rdo rje khros pas rū dra'i snying khrag 'byin: rdo rje bye kri mu khar phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje ye shes skye 'gag mi mnga' ba: rdo rje cir yang 'char ba'i brtul zhugs can: rdo rje'i stobs kyis dug lnga'i 'khyal 'khor gzhom: rdo rje thod phreng sde lngar phyag 'tshal bstod rdo rje 'dus ma byas pa chos kyi dbyings: rdo rje chags thogs bral ba rgyal kun gsang: rdo rje mi

shig gsang gsum 'byung gnas mchog:rdo rje phag mo lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod:rdo rje tshad med byams brtse'i mnga' dbang can:rdo rje 'gugs byed thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dren:rdo rje cir yang 'char ba'i brtul zhugs can rdo rje'i dpa' bo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥrdo rje yab la dgyes bskyed pad+ma bskyil:rdo rje thabs mkhas mdzad pa bsam yas 'gyed:rdo rje mi g.yo phyogs ris kun dang bral rdo rje dpa' mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥrdo rje'i gar gyis bskor zhing chags pa bral:rdo rje gdung drug byi nang mi mnga' ba:rdo rjezhi rgyas dbang drag thogs pa med:rdo rje las mdzad ging bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod rdo rje thogasapa med pa'i ye shes kyi:rdo rje rab 'bar bdud bzhi'i mtshan 'dzin bsregs:rdo rjeyon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas dpal:rdo rje'i las mdzad rgyal chen bzhi la bstod:rdo rje gsang ba'i sgog gi thig le can rdo rje 'da' med dam tshig gnyer byang 'dzin:rdo rje pho mo sa drug spro bsdu'i gzhi:rdo rje'i bka' nyan lnga la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje rigs kyi phrin las mi nub par:rdo rje bstan pa 'dzin srung spel byed pa'i:rdo rje'i pho nya myong byed nus

badz+ra stobs ldan: rdo rje chos skyong rnamasal phyag 'tshal bstodaX rdo rje'i rang zhin gzhom gzhig mi mnga' ba rdo rje sku gsung thugs kyi rten can la: rdo rje mi 'gyur pa yi gzer chen gdab: rdo rje las grub gzhal med khang la bstod rdo dze+eye shesadrug rdzogs rus pa'i rgyan: rdo rje sngags dang sde gsum rtags su 'dzin: rdo rje chags pas ma gos rgyal po'i tshul: rdo rje'i cha lugs rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstodardo rje stong pa chen po chos kyi sku: rdo rje rang 'od rang gsal longs spyod rdzogs : rdo rje cir yang 'char ba sprul ba'i sku rdo rje mnyam pa nyid la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje'i snang ba gang shar rang grol te: rdo rje spang blang gnyis med rdzogs pa che: rdo rje snying po theg mchog kun gyi rtse: rdo rje 'bras bu'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod rdo rje'i gdung 'dzin rnal 'byer bdag cag niḥ rdo rje gsum rdzogs dgongs pa'i don la gnas: rdo rje mi shig gnas lugs mngon gyur nas:rdo rje'i mdzad pas 'dzanar ba dongs ༷/gas de ga: ces brjod rdo rje'i phyag rgya lngas dkyal 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa bska sa gang 'dod dngos grub ma lus pa gegs med yid bzhen stsol bar 'gyur sa ma yu

gas/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dpal chen bla ma drag po yiḥ hūṃḥsgrub thig le'i rgya can las: khro rgyal chen po'i gsang sgrub mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i las rim rdo rje gar gyi rdzong zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ba tshu na rmo gu ru padha ka ra kro ta rā dza ye rwa thachadasnya39/ci ma rung 'dul mdzad khro rgyal mas pa 'i sku gdug tshogs 'byung po 'a gshed gyur khro bo lod dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gtso 'bor sprulabacas la gus pas btud de snying nas phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ong snyigasamasa'agro ba dmu rgod rnams bya spyod las rtsub dug lnga chos snyogs spyod sde ba nang 'khrug ku nus nang dme 'thab nye ba 'thab mo mkhon 'dzangs nga la 'da' btsun pa grir 'chi bud med nal bu gsod yul la yul bud 'byung pos shul 'dzan zhing nag phyogs mi dang 'dre bdud mgo 'phang mtho bstan pa nyams dma' chos khrims mkhon kyis gtor sa gnad 'og tu dam sri'i gnas tshangabaca' rgya 'dre me zhen 'tshubs pas than pa gtong 'jag rten khams su mtha' ma'i sna drangs 'ong 'byung po rlung zhon g.yo ba' char chu skams dmag 'khrug mtshon chas gzengs pa slong bar byed rgya yi pu tsan nag mo hor mgo mas gnyan rim bco brgyad gas rkya dmu chu slong bya tsha skya rbab nag po sum spril dang rgya 'brum chu bur lug mag la sogs pa' nad yams gdon rgod ro sa mi zin pa 'tshubs klo gdon dred da ra spyang glang mgo yis mi phyugs mibade' nad yams nyes dgu gtong smon log brgya dang nya shu mtha' ru son dbus bcud bstan pa rin chen 'phrog par rtsom las su dmag dang mtshon cha'i bya ba byed gos su mtha' mi'i mon gos sna tshogs bgo zas su mi rta ba

—4( glang khya sha rol rdzu bag thun 'bebs lcags bya mkha' la 'phur sde brgyad bskrad pa 'i phung rdzas sna dgu gtor sdo zla jing dir dbang phyug pho thos byed srung ba'i lha la mi 'jigasago med na nus mthunyams bcug rang la yo log 'bebs de 'arjegasamed lha lnga snying la 'chongs rdo rje'i rdzo dgu bzhom med go char bsgo mi thub mtshon gsum bstan pa'i pho nyar sbran srog gi lha gcig kho yi gshed du bsgyur 'byu po brngan zhingadam sra 'dul rten bzhe sa gzhom med dar lnga phyogs kya ri la phyar dgon grong sba 'dzan skyes pa tho mo da ban btsun sngags skyes grub pa thams cad kyis nub med sngar srol tshul skyo sa spyod lam zhib ru 'dzing bzlog pa' thabasal brtson nus na mi mthun khug sna mkha' la 'ja' bzhin yal rdzo dgu' ya gyal dpa' khrom rdo rje'i rdzong 'di nyid ma bor srog ga gta' ru zungs sa ma yu ཿ rgya rgya rgya deyang rab 'arjegasadur khrod la phyi na nas gzha ma grubazhi'i dbus su du dra bri ste bar gru gsum dmar nag 'khor rtsibs bzhi rtsibs chung bzhi dang rno ba' mtshon 'khor bzhi drag 'khor rtsibs lnga da bcas legs pa ra bkod de dbus gsang chen rdo yi gtor ma ni phyogs mtshamasabrag snyil rdo ba gru gsum rigs bsags nas mas brjid 'jigs su rung ba bya rtsang mtshe dug khrag ke shing drwa ba byed sngo dmar zhags pas 'khyud cing dar mthing phub rnam lnga nyer spyod zor rnams mdzoms par bkram ra nyid

drag po'i bsnyen sgrub las rung bas drag po' smrar bzlog byed pa' dgos gal tshe mdun bskyed gsang sgrub 'ad la nan du brtson sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya rnal 'byor rtogasapa'i gdeng bsnyed blta sta sa bsgrad snyan pa 'i dbyangs dang rol mo' sgra rnams sbar mtshams gcod rgya bdun srung ba' la drug gsol mi 'da' ti re 'dzan la rtag tu gnas de nas ma ṭaṃ bskyed pa' rim pa na phaṭa: mdun du yi spug bab pa de skad cig gis sku ngas su gyur pa las: gru gsum 'bar ba thar 'chor dang bral ba'i gur kho: sra brtan lci zhing 'thas rgya che la khyon yangs pa: 'chi bdag bdud po nag po'i lto ba: bskal ba'i me 'bar zhing srid pa'i rlung nag 'tshubs ma g.yo ba: rak+ta khrag gi rba rlabs 'jubs shing: sod sod dang chod chod kyi sgra sgrogs pa: gnam lcags kyi ser ba 'bebs shing drag po' 'brugasgra 'ur ba: shin tu skyi g.ya' zhing ya nga ba'i gnas su: dṛ dri du dra du sa: zhes yongs su gyur pa las ma tram̐ rū dra rgya 'dre srin po'i rigs su gtogs pa: bstan pa la 'tshe zhing rgolabar byed pa'i dam sri nag po dredakyi mgo can: khyi dang phag gi ba spu gzengs pa: bya yi sder tshogs bsgrad cing mjug ma sprel gyi rnga ma can: bong bu'am rta yi zo khog dang 'dra ba

gas/ rkang lag lcags gzir gyis bsdams pa bu ga rnams las dug khrag 'dzag pa de lta bu'i snying gar sa bon gsal ba las 'od 'phros rgya 'dre dam sri'i regs su gtogs pa thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags blang ba ltar 'ub kyis bsdus te yobhe sa su bstim mo: de nas bden brdar 'gugs bstem bya ba ni na moḥ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum rig 'dzin brgyud ldan rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang: khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po bdud 'dul khro bo lod kyi bka' bden pa dang:rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i lha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden stobs kyis: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems can gyi bde skyid bcom par byed pa'i rgya 'dre me zhon: 'byung po rlung zhon dam sri spun dgu: jing dur srin po'i rigs brgya dang lnga bcu: su tsin nag po stong phrag bco brgyad: a pa ha cang gi sde rigs bye ba bco brgyad: gzhan yang pho mo ma ning gi sde rigs: lha min lha ru brdzu ba: mi min mi ru brdzu ba: phag tu yib cing 'gab tu 'khri ba: sa btsan 'dzin zhing rdzong khroms bca'
