ba rgya 'dre srin po'i rigs su gtogs pa thams cad khra gyi li liX nag rga ra ra byis chung khra yis ded pa ltar skad cig rang dbang med par mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten ma tram̐ 'di la khug cig: lan grangasagasum bdun dgu sogasagang skabasabarjod dzaḥtriḥbadz+ra75ṅku sha dza: rat+na pa sha 〉ཿ pad+ma spo ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṣ+ṭi ho: zhes phyag rgya bzhi g.yo 'gul med par bya'o du dra a we sha ya sa:rgyu khams gsum gyi bag chags las nyon thams cad bsdus gnyis su med par bstims: rū dra pra we sha ya phaṭa: bstan pa'i rū dra zhing bcu tshang ba rnams kyi phung po khrol gyis zhig pa las: lpags pa zhing chen gyi sa gzhi la: rak+ta rgya mtsho 'khyil ba: dbugs rlung gi 'tshubs ma 'phyo zhing: drod me yi rang bzhin kun tu 'bar ba: rgal rgyud rus pa'i ri rab zur bcu drug pa sra brtan brjid ldan rgya chen la khyon yangs pa'i steng du: rū dra'i tsit+ta gyen du gzengs pa rin po che mchong gur phub pa lta bu'i rtse mo na o rgyan rang byung gi dur brod chen po: shin tu 'jigs shing rab tu rngams pa'i gnas su: lngan zab rang rgyang gi gzhal med khang thod pa nid pa'i gdan la thod rlon gyi rtsig pa raku'i sprin thabs su sbar

gas/: ba:thod pa skam po'i kha bad byas pa:phyogs skyong ba bcu'i mgon po'i kha sgrog gi mtshams 'dzin pa:nang lha brgyad kyi ka ba:klu brgyad kyi ka gdan gza'abargyad kyi ka zhu:rgyu skar gyi gral khebs ba su ta yi dra ba dang mig gi spril 'phyang:lag pa'i mod 'dzin dang glo snying gi 'phan byas pa:man mkhal gyi rus pa'i 'dod snams dpung pa'i pha gu dang mi rkang gi shar bu:rgal rus kyi mda' yab zhing gyi rgyal mtshanaḥchu srin lpags pa'i gdugs chen:stag gzig gi shun pa'i ba dan sbrul nag gi 'phanayab:mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa du mas bar sbrel bar byas pa'i mtha' na:dur khrod mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa lce spyang dang gcan gzan gyi mgo brnyan can rnams kyis haha rgod pa:dur bya gang ka ro zan la sogs pa'i ma rung 'byung po' mig tshil 'bri ba:las byed pho nya mtshon thogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas byad ma kla klo bsad gtubs bcomagasum byed pa:ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing srid pa'i rlung nag 'tshubs ma 'khyil ba'o:de lta bu'i pho brang chen po' dbus su rū dra pho mo bsnol ba'i steng durngams brjed stag mo ri

bkra mgo dgu pa: dmar la zlum pa'i spyan rnams bsgrad cing: rno dkar gyi mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa: shangs nas rngam pa'i na bun 'thul zhing smin ma dang kha spu las me yi tshwa tsha 'phro ba: sder bzhi bsgrad pas phyogs bzhi'i dmag tshogs brlag par byed pa rngam brjid 'gying thabs su rol ba'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las bdud 'dul dpal chen rdo rje khro bo lod sku mdog smug nag me yi tshwa tsha tho ro ro 'phro ba las 'byung po thams cad bsreg par byed pa: khro gnyer chu yi rlabs bzhin 'khrugs shing rno dkar mche ba am gtsigs man du bsdams pa: dmar ser dbu skra wa mig g.yas su 'khyil zhing thod pa skam po sum rim gyi dbu rgyan dang dar sna lnga yi cod pan 'phur ba: rab mdzes dung gi rna cha byas shing dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rnams rdzogs par spras pa: phyag g.yas log rtog 'dul byed rdo rje rtse dgu nam mkha' la phyar thabs su gdengs shing sde brgyad bran du bkol ba: g.yon pas gnam lcags kyi phur ba sa la gzir bas bshigs rū dra'i snying khrag dmar sob sob khol bar byed pa sku sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su

badz+ra: rung ba'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang ldan pa: gsung rgod dang gshe ba drag shul gyi glu dbyangs bzhad mo sgrogs pa: thugs snying rje rngam pa zhi ba'i yon tan bsam mi khyab pas mdzes par byas pa'o: zhabs gnyis rab mdzes sag lhum dang bcas te stag mo'i khri la 'gying thabs su bzhugs pa: ye shes kyi me dang bskal ba'i rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i klong na snang stong sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i sku ru bskyed do: de ltar gsal ba'i sku yi cha thams cad nas las byed kyi pho nya: khyung rigs lnga nyi rdul ltar 'phro bas klu bdud gdol ba'i rigs rnams zil gyis gnon zhing dam la 'dogs pa mdze grum 'bras sgran dreg lhog sogs ming tsam yang mi gnas par byed pa: dur phag nag po mgo dgu pa dpag med 'phro bas gnyan a ma dros sogs ma rung ba'i sde rigs dang: gtod yod pa mgo dgu gting ba mig dmar sogs 'jigs su rung ba'i tshogs dang: sa bdag shing rtsi nag po ha la sde khyi du ra phag zhon sogs gtum zhing gdug pa'i sde tshogs thal ba rdul phran brlag par byed pa: de dag gis byas pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad drung nas 'byin zhing zhi

bar mdzad pa: lcags sdigs nag po 'jigs su rung ba skar ltar 'khrigs pas rgyal bsen dam sri pho mo'i snying khrag 'jib par byed pa: gcan spyang mgo dgu khu sbrang ltar 'tshubs pas rgya 'dre dam sri'i rigs rgyud gtogs pa thams cad bsad gtubs brlag par byed pa: rngam brjid stag mo mgo dgu grangs med pa 'phros pas dus mthu'i 'gong nag du ru ga'i byad phur rbod gtong ngan pa thams cad bzlog par byed cing ngan gtong pho mo rdul phran phye ma ru 'thag par byed pa dang: ye shes kyi khro chung me yi tshwa tsha ltar spros pas mi min dam sri 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad cing drung nas 'byen par byed pa'i lha mchog las kyi rgyal po gzhom med rdo rje'i rdzongs su bskyed do: rtsa ba'i lha de yi spyi bor 'jam dpal gshin rje bshed ser nag: mgrin par pad+ma dbang chen dmar nag: thugs gar phyag na rdo rje mthing nag lte bar yak+ka me dbal spug nag: gsang gnas su rdo rje gzhen nu ljang nag: kun kyang khro la rngam pa sgeg nyams can phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje gdengs shing g.yon pa lcags phur bgegs la gzir ba zhabs gyad stabs su bsgrad

badz+ra cing stag sham mgo phreng sbrul chun gyis brgyan zhing: ye shes kyi me dpung dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong du bskyed do: dpal chen po'i spyi gtsug tu o rgyan rak+ka thod phreng rtsal smug nag rdo rje dang bhan+ta 'dzin pa: zhi ma khro 'dzum gyi nyams can he ru ka pa'i cha lugs rdzogs pa snang stong sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i dkyil 'khor du gsal gdab po de yi phyi rim gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa'i shar du badz+ra khro bo lod mthing nag: lho ru rat+na khro bo lod sngo nag nub tu pad+ma khro bo lod smug nag: byang du garma khro bo ma da ljang nag kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum sdang mig bsgrad pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar gyi mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa: smra smin las me 'bar zhing khro gnyer chu yi rlabs bzhin 'khrigs pa: dmar ser ral pa gyen du brdzis shing thod skam gyis brgyan pa: nyi ma dang zla bas snyan cha byas shing dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs pa phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis bzlog pa'i gtor zor dang g.yon pas lcags phur mtha' mi kla sgo'i snying la 'drol ba: ba spu'i gseb nas rdo rje'i thog ser 'bebs shing zhabs

gnyis bsgrad pas dam sri pho mo gnon pa:rang rang rigs kyi sprul 'khor dpung dang bcas pa ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su bskyed do 'khor lo de dag gi rtsibs mchan rnams su thabs mchog yab rnams kyi dgyes bskangs shar lhor badz+ra wa ra nyi mthing skya lho nub tu rat+na wa ra hi sngo skya:nub byang du pad+ma wa ra hi spug nag byang shar du garma wa ra hi ljang skya:kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bsgrad pa: zhal gdengs shing ljags 'dril ba:rno dkar gyi mche ba gtsigs shing sma smin las me yi tshwa tsha 'phro zhing khro gtum gyi nyams rdzogs pa:ral pa gyen brdzis thod rgyan rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram gyis mdzes par byas pa:rna ltag g.yas nas phag skad ca ra ba:dar dpyangs rus rgyan mgo phreng gzig sham dril bu g.yer kha rat+na dag gi mdzes par brgyan pa:phyag g.yas rnams kyis bzlog pa'i khrag zor dang g.yon pas bhan+ta da mar gyi bkang ba bsnams nas gzhib par byed pa:'od lnga ye shes me yi klong na zhabs rnams gar bsgyur du rol zhing las byed garma mkha' 'gro bsam yas pho nyar 'gyed par

badz+ra bskyed do: de yi phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i shar durdo dzodapa' bo mthing gsal lho ru rin chen dpa' bo ser nag: nub pad+ma dpa' bo dmar nag byang du garma dpa' bo ljang nag: kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ma khro brja ma sgeg pa: spyan gsum mkha' la gzigs shing dbu sgra wa mig g.yas g.yon 'khyil zhing mdzes pa thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang dar sna'i cod pan 'phur ba: dung gi snyan ca rus pa'i rgyan drug dar tshon gyi dpyangs pa 'phur zhing mjes pa'i ye rag dang pad+ma'i do shal byas pa'o phyag g.yas pa rnams na bzlog pa'i nyung zor thogs shing: g.yon pa mtha' dmag rdul du brlag byed thun dung re bsnams pa'o: 'od 'bar ye shes me yi klong na zhabs rnamasagyad stabs bsgrad pas dam sri gnon pa rang rang rigs kyi 'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum phrag re dang bcas gsal bar bskyed do: 'khor lo de dag gi rtsibs la shar ltorardo dzodapa' mo dkar gsal: lho nub tu rat+na dpa' mo ser gsal nub byang du pad+ma dpa' mo dmar gsal: byang shar du garma dpa' mo ljang gsal kun kyang zhi ma khro 'dzum sgeg

nyams chags pa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mkha' la gzigs shing: dbu sgra gyen tu brdzes shing rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram gyi thod gdengs byas pa: rin po che'i snyan cha dang mgul rgyan dar gyi dpyangs pa rus pa'i rgyan drug 'ja' sham pad phreng sogs kyis mdzes par brgyan pa: phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis byad ma bzlog pa'i khrag gi rkong zor thogs shing: g.yon pa rnams kyi gri gug dku la brten pa: ye shes 'od lnga'i klong na zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i gar thabs bsgyur ba rang rtsal 'khor tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa stong gsal 'dzin pa bral bar bskyed do: de yi phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi ba'i shar durdo rje rigs kyi kaing ka ra dkar gsal: lho ru rin chen rigs kyi king ga ra ser gsal: nub tu pad+ma rigs kyi king ga ra dmar gsal: byang du garma rigs kyi king ga ra ljang gsal: kun kyang rus pa'i gzugs can ru dar dam rtags mdzes pa: dar zon gyi dpyangs pa dril bu g.yer kha'i chun 'phyang mdzes par spras pa: sku smad stag gzig seng ge sbrul gyi sham thabs byas pa: phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis byad ma bzlog byed

btsañca mtshe mda' gri rdo'i zor chen thogs pa:g.yon na dngul gser zangs lcags kyi phur ba dgra dang bgegs kyi snying la 'dril ba:rang rang rigs kyi sprul pa'i'adu 'phro 'gyed pa:'od 'bar 'ja' gur char sprin 'khrigs pa'i dbus su zhabs rnams rdo rje'i bro gar bsgyur bar bskyed do:de yi rtsibs mchan rnams su shar lhorayul 'khor srung dkar gsal pi waṃ bsgyur ba:lho nub 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri phyed phyung mdzad pa:nub byang du spyan mi bzang dmar gsal mchod rten dang sbrul zhags 'dzinapa:byang shar du rnam thos sras ser gsal rgyal mtshan dang ne'u le bsnams pa:kun kyang dung lcags zangs gser gyi khrab rmog bgo zhing dar dpyangs sag s+t+waṃ rin po che'i phrengab rnams kyis mdzes par spras pa:ra rang rigs kyi 'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum sde'i dpung da bcas pa me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i dbus su rgyal po rol ba'i stabs subazhugs shing bstan pa srung ba'i po nyar bskyed do:de yi phyi rim mnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs lnga pa dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du:mdun rtsibs su dpal ldan nag

po kro ti shwa ri yum dang bcas te lha dmag 'bum sde'i dpung gis bskor nas dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las byed par bsam:shar rtsibs su bdud mgon nag po seng ge'i gdong pa can ru mtshon dang snying zhags bsnams shing dar ber nag po bgo ba yum mchog si pa las mkhan dregs pa sde brgyad zhing skyongs dregs pa stong rtsa gnyis sogs gtso 'khor sprul ba g.yog dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis mtha' dmag bzlog bsgral gyi las byed par bsam sto rtsibs su dbang drag shan pa dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'jigs rngam bzod par dka' ba me khyung rlung gshog la bcibs shing yum gsod byed chen mo dang 'khril ba:las mkhan mched brgyad dregs pa sde brgyad yang 'khor 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis zab gas rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa srung zhing nyes 'gyed dam sri'i tshogs rnams rdul tu brlag pa'i las byed par bsam:nub rtsibs su sngags srung e ka dza ṭī mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: spyan gcig srid pa'i legs nyes sa ler gzigs pa: g.yu yi ral ba 'bru gcig gze sa shing tshems rno

ba:tshu dkar gyi mche ba gcig dgra la rngams pa: zhabs gnyis bstan dgra'i snying gar brdzis pa'i mtha' bskor du tsa ti spun drug bran mo bcu bzhi g.yog mo lngabacu: yang g.yog 'bum khri 'bum stong sogs kyis gsang sngags kyi bstan pa srung zhing nyams pa'i bdud sde drung nas 'byin pa'i las byed par bsam: byang rtsibasasu dpal ldan lha mo ri ma ti sku mdog mthing nag dril rta la zhon zhing dur khrod kyi chas rnams rdzogs pa rngam brjed srin mo khros pa'i rnam 'gyur can gyi 'khor du skems ma chen mo chu srin gyi mgo can sku gsung thugs kyi ma lnga dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad: mkha' 'gro chen mo sum cu rtsa gnyis: ma yam bstan ma bcu gnyis dpal ldan lha mo'i sde rigs 'khor du gtogs pa thams cad kyis bskor nas bstan pa'i dgra sde thal bar brlag pa'i las byed par bsam: de dag gi mtha' bskor rtsang gi dra mig la shar du lha dmag 'bum sdes dgra la dal yams gtong ba: lho ru bdud dmag 'bum gyis dgra la nang 'khrug 'gyed pa: nub tu btsan dmag 'bum sdes dgra la spre 'bogs gtong ba: byang du ma yam 'bum

gyis dgra la khrag nad 'bebs pa: de yi phyi rim gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi rtsibs rtse rno zhing ngar ba rtag tu 'khor zhing dal ba'i gnas med pa: mtha' yi dmag tshogs du ru ga'i sde rigs thams cad dmar nyi li li gtub cing rdul du brlag par bsam: ri rab bang rim dang po na las byed gshin gyi dmag tshogs sha la rngams shing khrag la dgyes pa'i sde rigs rnams kyis gang la bya ba'i mtha' dmag gi sde tshogs dmar g.yos byed par bsam: bang rim gnyis pa la las byed bka' sdod lce spyang seng ge stag gzig dom drad 'phar ba g.yi spyang khyi te lo sogs shin tu mang ba: de dag kyang che ba brjid pa stobs dang ldan pa rtsal rlung las che ba myur shugs thog mda' las ngar ba rdzu 'phrul bar snang glog zhags las myur ba: rngams pa'i rkan sgra dang bcas te bstan pa'i dgra sde mtha' mi kla kle'i sha khrag la hab thob byed paradamigs ri rab bang rim gsum pa la sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyi sde rigs bsam mi khyab pas bstan pa'i dgra la nad rims dug gi kha phru 'debs par bsam: bang rim

badz+ra bzhi pa la dug mtshon khrag gi yo lang 'tshubs par bskyed do: bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams bskul: lha tshogs de rnams kyi gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa 'phros te rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul kun kyang chos kyi dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs nas bskyed pa'i lha la sib sib thim nas drag po mngon spyod kyi las thogs med du sgrub par bsam la: rol mo spos dudabacas te 'di skad do hūṃ bh+yo 'og min gsang chen o rgyan dur khrod nas: 'jigs rung rngams brjid srin po'i tshogs rje bo bdud 'dul dpal chen rdo rje khro bo lod: za byed yum dang thod phreng sde bzhi dang: dgyes bskyed phag mo mched bzhi rang rang 'khor: dpa' bo dpa' mo sde brgyad sprul par bcas: king bzhi rgyal chen sde bzhi srog bdag lnga: sprul 'khor dpung dang bcas te gshegs su gsol : bstan pa'i du dra bsgral phyir gshegs su gsol : glo bur dus 'khrug bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol : mi nad phyugs nad

bsal phyir gshegs su gsol : mtha' yi dmag tshogs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol : dus kyi ru 'dzing gzhes phyir gshegs su gsol : grub pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po da ston la: mngon spyod phrin las 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: sa badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: de nas bzhugs phyag mchod pa las byang ltar grub rjes bstod pa dang bskyed lcags kyu bzhin de nas bzlas pa sngags kyi 'byul 'bar ni bdag nyid dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: mdun bskye rdo rje khro bo yod kyi thugs rgyud bskul: thugs dam dbyings las bzhengs nas dus kyi ru 'dzing ngan pa thams cad tshar bcad nas drag po mngon spyod kyi las thogs pa med par grub nas mtha' yi dmag tshogs du ru sde yi sde dpung thams cad thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par dmigs la oṃ badz+ra gu ru khro bo lod wa ra hi bye kri ma badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garma thod phreng rtsal wa ra hi rba ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta king ga ra dhi ta ra be ru ta ka bhe ru bhak+ta ba shi shra ma ṇa byur kur ma hā kwa la dhi tri ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri dme ru rtse e ka tsa dza ṭī re ma ti sarba sa ma ya dza dza gri ma hā sarba sid+dhi pha la hūṃ a: dmigs gsal r+ṣa nge 'dzan gyi rno ldan

ba rte pas 'bum phrag bzla zhing lha tshogs byan rlabs bsdu de nas las la rbad pa'i drag sngags ni oṃ badz+ra gu ru khro bo lod sarba sa ma ya dza dza: stod hor ci la jing dur ho paṇa du ru be zhi sde'i sha la dza: khrag la khub: rus la rdub: tsit+ta gtor: snying rtsa sgog rtsa khrag rtsa la 'ub 'ub 'dus 'dus mā ra ya sod: myag myag sarba duṣ+ṭa mā ra ya phaṭa: khro rgyal go po bstan pa'i dgra la bskul oṃ badz+ra wā ra hi bye kri mu kha sarba sa ma ya dza dza: stod tor ci la jing dur ho paṇa du ru be zhi sde'i sha la dza: khrag la sdong: rus la rdub: tsit+ta gtor: snying rtsa srog rtsa khrag rtsa la 'ub 'ub 'dus 'dus mā ra ya sod: myag myag sarba du khya mā ra ya phaṭa: za byed pho mo mtha' mi'i gshed du bskulaḥ zhi badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garma khro bo lod sarba sa ma ya dza dzaX stod hor ci la jing dur ho paṇa du ru be zhi sde'i sha la dza: khrag la shub: rus la rdub: tsit+ta gtor: snying rtsa sgog rtsa khrag rtsa la 'ub 'ub 'dus 'dus mā ra ya sod: myag myag sarba du ca mā ra ya phaṭa thod phreng sde bzhi phyogs bdud tshod du bskul oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garma wā ra hi sarba sa ma ya dza dza stod hor ci la jing dur ho paṇa du ru be zhi sde'i sha la dza: khrag la hub: rus

la rdub tsit+ta gtor: snying rtsa srog rtsa khrag rtsa la 'ub 'ub 'dus 'dus mā ra ya sod: myag myag sarba du ca mā ra ya phaṭa phag mo sde bzhi wang po'i gshed du bskul o badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garma dha bi lo ki me sarba sa ma ya dza dzaḥ stod hor ci la jing dur ho paṇa du ru be zhi sde'i sha la dza: khrag la hub: rus la rdub tsit+ta gtor: snying rtsa sgog rtsa khrag rtsa la 'ub 'ub 'dus 'dus mā ra ya sod: myag myag sarba duṣ+ṭa mā ra ya phaṭa: dpa' bo sde bzhi dam sri'i spyod du bskul ma badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garma dz+nyā na gu h+ya mu drwa sarba sa ma ya dza dza stod hor ci la jing dur ho paṇa du ru be zhi sde'i sha la dza: khrag la chub rus la rdub: tsit+ta gtor: snying rtsa srog rtsa khrag rtsa la 'ub 'ub 'dus 'dus mā ra ya sod myag myag sarba du ca mā ra ya phaṭa: dpa' bosde bzhi ma rung bdud spyod bskul oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garma king ga ra shrī me ra dza sarba sa ma ya dza dza stod hor ci la jing dur ho paṇa du ru be zhi sde'i sha la dza: khrag la shub: rus la rdub tsit+ta gtor snying rtsa srog rtsa khrag rtsa la 'ub 'ub 'dus 'dus mā ra ya sod: myag myag sarba du ca mā ra ya phaṭa: king bzhi mtha' dmag brlag pa'i pho nyar bskulaḥ mo badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garma be ru

badz+ra rā dza ma hā sarba sa ma ya dza dzaḥ stod hor ci la jing dur ho paṇa du ru be zhi sde'i sha la dza: khrag la hub rus la rdub: tsit+ta gtor snying rtsa srog rtsa khrag rtsa la'ub 'ub 'dus 'dus mā ra ya sod: myag myag sarba du ta mā ra ya phaṭa: rgyal pho sde bzhi ma rung 'dul phyir bskul snye bhurkur ma hā kā la kro ti shwa ri dhi tri ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri e he dme rurtse gu ṇa tri da e ka dza ṭī rasmo re ma ti sarba dharmā pa la k+ṣe ṭa pa la lo ka pa la sarba sa ma ya dza dza stod hor ci la jing dur ho paṇa du ru be zhi sde'i sha la dza: khrag la chub: rus la rdub: tsit+ta gtor: snying rtsa sgog rtsa khrag rtsa la 'ub 'ub 'dus 'dus mā ra ya sod myag myag sarba duṣ+ṭa mā ra ya phaṭa: drag po sde lnga dub lnga'i gdon gshed bskul bzlog pa'i drag sngags smrar pholtar du bzla yang cig byad ma 'bum bzlog drag sngags ni shā hūṃ dza dzaḥ trig khrom bh+yoḥ ma ra du na bh+yo: rasmo rakru bh+yo ti ya sarba duṣ+ṭa bh+yo: mtha' mi'i snying la dzaḥ mtha' mi'i khrag la zud mtha' mi'i sgog snying tshal bar gtubs: drag tu bzla zhing thal mo mnye bar bya slar yang mja cang stod la gnad bskul ni yang rang githugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs

la phog ste thugs rgyud bskul: lha tshogs thams cad las rang 'dra'i khro chung las byed pho nya gcan spyang dur phag sdigs khyung seng stag sogs grangs med pa spros nas gang la migs pa'i dgra dpung de thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam la: dral dkrol rka ja gli bzhug pa'i sgras bskul te hūṃ bye rngams brjed gsang chen rol ba'i dur khrod nas khro bo'i rgyal po che mchog drag po rtsal: dpal chen yongs 'dus gu ru khro bo lod: gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rngod gtong bzlog ཿ ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: bcol ba'i las rnams ma g.yel grub par mdzod: / bh+yo shin tu khros pa za byed phag mo yum:

bsgo/ bye kri mu kha stag mo mgo dgu pa:gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la:las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la:hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog:du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms:dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ཿma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul:ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms:la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog:byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod:pa bh+yoḥ'adod chags tshul gyis 'dod chags dbyings su gcod:pad+ma thod phreng yab yum sprul 'khor bcas gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la:las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la:hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms:dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs:mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ༷ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon

pa thul ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: hū bh+yoḥ zhe sdang tshul gyis zhe sdang dbyings su gcod: rdo rje khro lod dgyes bskyed phag mo bcas gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs:mtha' mi'i rjas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlogaḥ ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: hū bh+yoḥ nga rgyal tshul gyi nga rgyal dbyings su gcod: rat+na thod phreng yab yum sprul 'khor bcas: gnad nas bskul lo na byings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: tor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog:

badz+ra: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms:dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs:mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ༷ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms:la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog:byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: / bh+yoḥphrag dog tshul gyis phrag dog dbyings su gcod :karma thod phreng yab yum sprul 'khe ra bcas:gnad nas bskul 61 dbyings nas da bzhengs la:las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la:hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog:du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms:dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs:mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ཿma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul:ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms:la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog:byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: ( bh+yoḥsnying rje'i bdag gis 'gro ba'i mgon po ni:rdo rje rigs kyi dpa' bo gtso 'khor

bcas: gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs: mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlogaḥ ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: hū bh+yoḥbyams brtse'i rang bzhin thugs rje ye shes gar: rin chen rigs kyi dpa' bo gtso 'khor bcas: gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs: mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog: ma ru mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la

ba:tshu yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog:byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod:pa bh+yoḥdaga' ba'i mnga' bdag mchog dman yongs kyi mgon pad+ma rigs kyi dpa' bo gtso 'khor bcas:gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la:las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la:hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog:du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms:dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs:mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ཿma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul:ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms:la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog:byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod:/ bh+yoḥbatang snyoms chen pos 'gro khams dongs sprugs pa'i:karma rigs kyi dpa' bo gtso 'khor bcas:gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la:las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la:hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog:du ru ka yi sde

'dul mtshon cha choms dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs: mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: hū smyo dga' ba'i rang bzhin 'dzin rtog spros pabral badz+ra rigs kyi dpa' mo sprul 'khor bcas: gnad nas/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ mchog tu ga' ba'i rang bzhin 'dzin rtog bral: rat+na rigs kyi dpa' mo sprul 'khor bcas: gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor ma 'dun khang shigs: mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rngod gtong bzlog ma rung mgon grogs me rjang zhon pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzodatshwa byuḥ khyad par dga'

ba'iye shes las byu ba'i: pad+ma rigs kyi dpa' mo sprul 'khor bcas: gnad nas bskul ma dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag gyed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang 'dun khang shigs: mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ཿ ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod hūṃ sbyoḥ lhan skyis dga' pa'irang bzhin 'gag pa med: karma rigs kyi dpa' mo sprul 'khor gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: hor sogs dmag gi brtsam pa bzlog du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs: mtha' mi'i rjas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ཿ ma

rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: hū bh+yoḥrdo rje'i rigs 'chang zhe sdang gdon tshogs 'dul: bzhad king chen po gtso 'khor sprul dang bcas: gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: hor sogs dmag ga blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs: mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ཿ ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod hūṃ bh+yoḥ rin chen rigs 'chang nga rgyal gdon tshogs 'dul: mgyogs king gtum byed gtso 'khor sprul dang bcas gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la

pa(: hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ཿ ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad maming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: nyu spyo pad+ma'i rigs 'chang 'dod chags gdon tshogs 'dul: rgyugs king 'bar ba gtso 'khor sprul dang bcas: gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: tor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs: mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ཿ ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mjod: hūṃ spyoḥ

las rab rigs 'chang phrag dog gdon tshogs 'dul sgrol king rngams pa gtso 'khor sprul dang bcas: gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: tor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs: mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ༷ ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhen pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: hā bh+yoḥ shar gyi gdon 'dul zhi ba'i las mdzad dpal yul 'khor srung ba dri za'i 'khor dpung bcas: gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra drobs dmag dpung 'gyed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs mtha' mi'i rdzas spyor rig sngags rbod

badz+ra gtong bzlog ཿ ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur tor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma mingamed rdul du brlag par mdzod: / bh+yoḥ sa yi gdon 'dul drag po'i las mdzad dpal: 'phags skyes po dang grul bum dmag dpung bcas: gnad nas bskul lo dbyingasanas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'byed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yisde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs: mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ཿ ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzodahūṃ jeḥ nub kyi gdon 'dul dbang gi lasamadzad dpal mig mi bzang dang gla dbang 'khor dang bcas: gnad nas bsgral lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed brgyan pa'i

mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms: dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor la 'dun khang shigs mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlogaḥ ma rung mgon grogs me rlung zhon pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dgabazlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: hūṃ bh+yoḥ byang gi gdon 'dul drag po'i las mdzad dpal rnam thos sras po gnod sbyin sde 'khor bcas: gnad nasabaskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs la: las byed pho nya khra thabs dmag dpung 'gyed: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: hor sogs dmag gi blo 'dun brtsam pa bzlog: du ru ka yi sde 'dul mtshon cha choms dmag mi'i mda' byang gtor ma 'dun khang shigs: mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor rig sngags rbod gtong bzlog ཿ ma rung mgon grogasame rlung zhon pa thul: ci la nag mo jing dur hor mgo choms: la yog cho 'phrul than ltas tha dag bzlog: byad ma ming med rdul du brlag par mdzod: bcol ba'i mdzod
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dpal chen rdo rje khro lod kyiḥ hūṃ sgrub thig le'i rgya can las: bla ma drag po'i phyi sgrub rdo rje'i rdzong chen bdud 'dul 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gtsar+sha na mo gu ru kro ta rwa dza ye smomasgogyu1/snye she ngo bo ye sang rgya mod kyang thugs rje thabs kyis gdug pa 'dul dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal po la sgo gsum gus pa'i phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ongs lasacan pho mo rnams bar chad g.yul las rgyal ba'i phyir dpal chen bla ma khro bo lod 'di phyi'i re stos la 'chang dge phun tshogs dben gnas 'jigs rung tshul gong ma'i zhabs bcag byin rlabs gnas thabs kyis btsal la cho gni lag len rgyas par bya ba'o maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzhi pa rdul tshon ris bris tshom bu rnams spros pa che chung gang skabs bya sgrub gtor bla rdo srog 'khor dang phur sgrom mkho ba'i yo byad rnams rgyas pa dag las byung bzhin sgrubs bar chad bdud bgegs dbyangs su bskrad bsru ba'i 'khor lo rim brgyad gtams gnas dang yo byad byin gyas brlabs la sngags tang 'dzan ldan pa yas ye shes lha las lhar gsal ba skyid ma hā sdo/ n+ya smra bsam brjod bral chos sku'i rol ba las: rang gsal ma 'gags byang chub sems kyi mdangs: spro bsdu'i ngo bo hūṃḥyig dmar gsal las: bskyed pa'i dpal chen badz+ra khro bo lod: sku mdog dmar spug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje nam mkhar phyar: sde brgyad 'byung po'i sgog dbug 'dren par byed: g.yon pas lcags

bsgo/: phur lcags sdigs snying nas gtser:rgyal bsen dam sri 'gong po 'dul bar byed:spyan gsum dmar zlum nam mkha'i dbyings su gzigs:dug gsum las byung gdon bgegs zil gyis gnon dmar ser dbu sgra wa mig g.yas su 'khyil:khrag 'thung rngams bajid rol ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs:mi 'gyur thod skam gsum rim dbu rgyan la dar sna lnga yi cod pan dpyangs pa 'phur:snyan cha dung gi wa mig zla ltar bkra:mnyam pa nyid las drag po'i hūṃ sgra sbir:rno dkar mche ba am gtsigs man du bsdams:rngam spyod gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul bar byed:khro gnyer chu yi rlabs bzhin 'bar 'khrigs rngams smar smin me yi tsha tshas bdud bgegs bsregs:sngags kyi phod chen mthing nag mdzes pa klubs:dmar ser 'char ga'i mdog 'dzin chos gos dang:thod phreng sbrul gyi do shal stag sham bkra:rus rgyan g.yer kha me long dril bus mdzes:zhabs gnyis sog lho 'ja' khra ldan pa yis:phag mo sbas tshul stag gi khri la 'gying:rngams brjid za byed khros pa'i sder tshogs bsgrad:ye shes me rlung dud sprin

'khrigs klong bskyed las byed khro chung khyung sdigs seng dang: dur phag gcan spyang tshogs kyi 'du 'phro 'gyed: bar chad dus mtha'i 'gong nag 'dul bar byed: snang stong 'dzin bral 'od kyi sku ru gsal: shar du khro chenaseng ge sgra sgrogs ni sku mdog mthing nag dur khrod chas rgyan spras: rdo rje phur ba gdengs thabs tshul du 'dzin ma rig ru bzlog me yi 1nga du bskyed: lto ru stobs ldan rgyal po thor cog can: khams gsum dbang sdud rgyal po'i cha lugs 'dzin: gdug pa tshar gcod be con zhags pa brten: dngas gsal 'od phung lnga ldan klong du bskyed: nub tu pad+mad+mag po gtum drag dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum gar dgu'i 'khyud: g.yas g.yon rdo rje sdigs pa gdengs thabs 'dzin : dur khrod chas rdzogs me dpung slong du bskyed: byang du rngams brjid sharnya rak+ṣi ta: dkar dmar mdangs ldan he ru ka pa'i chas: thab shes dbyer med phyag 'tshan mda' gzhu 'geng zhi ma khro 'dzum 'od lnga'i klong du bskyed: de yi byi rim 'dab brgyad kya: shar du rdo rje rigs kyi dpa' bo ni dkar gsal cang te'u bum pa mkha' la bsor: zhi ma

badz+ra khro 'dzum rat+na rus rgyan brgyan: stag sham rgyan rdzogs zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur rol: lhorurin tshan rigs kyi dpa' bo ni: ser gsal nor bu rat+na'i zhags pa 'chang: zhi ma khro 'dzum dar dang rat+nas brgyan gzig sham klubs shing zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur rol:nubatupad+ma rigs kyi dpa' bo ni: dmar gsal thod dbyug grigug dku la brten: zhi ma khro 'dzum dar dang mgo phreng spras: seng sham rgyan rdzogs zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur rol: byangadulas rab rigs kyi dpa' bo ni: ljang la rgya gram sbrul gyi zhags pa bsdams: zhi ma khro 'dzum sbrul chun mgo phreng ngo: dar gyi sham thabs zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur rol:sharaltorardo rje'i pho nya dpa' mo ni: dkar gsal lcags kyu gter bum bsgol thabs 'dzin: rus pa'i rgyan spras dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur: zhi 'dzum lang tsho'i dpal 'khyud gar bsgyur rol lhonub rin chen pho nya dpa' mo ni: ser gsal bhan+ta shel dkar phreng ba 'dren: rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs dar sna'i dpyangs pa 'phuraḥ zhi 'dzum dgyes brtse'i dpal 'khyud gar bsgyur rol: nubabyang pad+ma'i pho nya dpa' mo

ni dmar gsal kha ṭ+wāṃ bhan+ta dku la brten: dar gyi dpyangs pa rus pa'i rgyan drug spras zhi 'dzum chags pa'i nyams rdzogs gar bsgyur rol: byang shar las rkyi pho nya dpa' mo ni: ljang gsal gri gug dril bu dku la brten: dar dang rat+na rus pa'i rgyan drug spras: zhi 'dzum bde ba'i nyams rdzogs gar bsgyur rol: de yi phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi ging: dkar ser dmar ljang lcags zhags sgrog dril 'dzin: bhan+ta dkur brten ging rus ha ha rgod: 'od 'bar me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs klong bskyed ཿdemathar bka' sdod dregs pa sde bzhi dang: dpal mgon dregs chen gtso 'khor dang bcas pa: nyi rdul 'khrigs ltar ma 'dres yongs rdzogs bskyed: kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag med 'phros: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin sbyan drangs te: bskyed pa'i lha tshogs rnams la sib sib bstim: sbos bsregs rol mo' sgra bcas 'di skad do hūṃ hrī rngams brjid srin po 'tshogs pa'i yul dbus nas: che ba'i che mchog pad+ma drag po'i sku: gdug

pa(: pa 'dul mdzad rdo rje khro bo lod: yab yum sprul 'khor las byed pho nya bcas: dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sgrub mchog byin gyisabarlabs phyir gshegs su gsol: bskal ba'i g.yo 'khrug bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: nad mug mtshon gsum bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: mi nad phyugs nad bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol rgyal 'gong dam sri 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yu: snyen badz+ra kro ta ra dza sarba sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: de nas bams su gsol ba ni hūṃ nyi gdug pa bdud dang dam sri bsnol ba'i steng: lha mchog khro rgyal badz+ra khro bo lod dam tshig rtenagyi lha la brtan par bzhugs: mi mthun drung nas 'byin pa'i phrin las mdzod: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ni na mo snye'agags 'gyur med phrin las 'bad med rdzogs rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams dbyi sa su sgrol: sgrub pa po la dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: pad+ma drag po'i lha la gus phyag 'tshal na mo na ma ho: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ hūṃ

rmad byung kun tu bzang po'i rol ba las:shar ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin:snang ba mi 'gyur thabs kyi rdo rje dang:shes rab mi 'gag stong nyid dril bu dang:chos sgras stong gsum khyab pa'i rnga bo che:bya ba mthar phyin rol mo ting ting shag:bde stong chos kyi rang sgra thod rnga dang:bcu drug rol rtsed bsgyur ba'i gling bu'i sgra:'dod yon zhen pa bral ba mchod sprin rnams:nam mkha' rab 'byams khyon rnams yongs bkang ste:yi dam lhag pa'i lha la gus pas 'bul:dgyes bzhes mchog dang thun mongs dngos gyub stsol:ma ma hā pañca pu dza ho:de nas bstod pa bya ba ni hūṃ hrīḥbade chen dbang drag rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:snang ba mtha' yas longs spyod rdzogs mdzad gar:gdug pa bdud dang dam sri'i gshed po che:rdo rje khro lod sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rjes sde brgyad 'dul:g.yon pas lcags phur gzir bas rgyal bsen 'joms:sde gsum klong dgu'i sgol 'dzin rtags chas brgyan rab 'jigs he ru ka la phyag 'chal bstod:brtse chen thugs rje lcags kyus 'gro ba 'dzin:brda thabs gar gyi phyag rgyas

btsa/ bdud tshogs 'dul: mkhyen gnyis shes rab 'bar bas gzung 'dzin skem: lha mchog thugs rje'i gter la phyag 'tshal bstod: bcu pa ril bu'i bskyed bzlas ni oṃ ma hā shu n+ya sogs kyis stong pa ra sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las lhun grub rang byung gi gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo khyud rta babs bang rim dang bcas nas mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su: pad zla dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las: gu ru drag po sku mdog spug nag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs pa 'dzin pa: mi lpags kyi stod g.yog da stag gi sham thabs klubs pa: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs su bsgrad cing: ye shes me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus su snang stong sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i sku til gyi gong bu phyur ba bzhin gsal ba rnams kyi spyi bor sku mi 'gyur ba'i ngo bo oṃ gyi mtshan pa: mgrin par gsung mi 'gag pa'i brda don ā yis mdzes paḥ snying gar thugs mi 'khrul ba'i rtags su hūṃḥgis brgyan par gyur: de dag las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pas rngams brjid rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nas rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya

mtsho'i tshom bu dang bcas pa thams cad sku phyag rgya gsung yig 'bru: thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par kun ling ling byon nas bskyed pa'i lha tshogs rnams la sib sib bstim mo oṃ badz+ra gu nas bo lod ma ha riḥni saḥsarba sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: ye shes dbab bstam phyag mchod bstod par bya de nas bsnyen pa'i skabs su bzlas dmigs ni bum pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du ril bu rnams dpal chen rdo rje khro bo lod du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul: byin rlabs 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par phyung ste bskyed pa'i lha la sib sib thim par bsam la bsnyen pa bzla de nas nye bsnyen ral dmigs ni sbyoḥ ye shes lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su ril bu rnams yi dam gyi lha sku til gyi gong bu byur ba ltar gsal ba'i gnas thams cad nas 'od zer 'phros: gu ru rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: thugs rje byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par byung nas ril bu lhar gsal ba rnams la sib sib thim par

gas/: dmigs la bzlas pa bya de nas sgrub pa'i 'dzab dmigs ni gi snang srid thams cad yongs su gang ba'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su: ril bu rnams yi dam gyi lha sku mtshan nyid rdzogs pa til gyi gong bu phyur ba lta bur gsal ba rnams las ra 'dra dpag tu med pa 'phros te: kun gyis 'dzab dbyangs ti ri ri bsgrags pas bdud bgegs nye mi nus shing dngos grub char ltar 'bebs par bsam la sgrub sngags bzla sgrub pa chen po'i bzlas dmigs ni bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: bum pa gzhal yas khang gi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: de dag gi sku re re las kyang brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya dung phyur grangs med 'phros te: kun gyis 'dzab dbyangs ti ri ri bsgrags pas stong gsum g.yo 'gul byed cing 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bsam la sgrub sngags dang: a ra pa tsa mi da hri da ye swā hā: sbyar la ci 'grub bzlas pa bya de nas las sbyor bzlas dmigs ni (ཿ ril bu ye shes lha yi skur gsal ba rnams las 'od zer rdo rje'i tsha tsha las byed pho nya'i 'du 'phro 'khrigs shing: phrin las rnam pa bzhi gegs med yid

bzhin du sgrub par bsam la: las sngags dang badz+ra pañca shidz+nya ku ru (ཿ rat+na pañca puṣ+ṭi ku ru sa: pad+ma pañca wa shaṃ ku ru trī: karma pañca gnod byed mā ra ya phaṭa: ci 'grub bzlas rjes 'dodagasol 'di re re bzhin tu rtsa sngags mjug nad gdon sdig sgrib 'jigs pa brgyad sogs shirnyi ku ru swā hā: zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par gyur cig: tshe bsod dpal yon 'byor ba bcu drug puṣ+ṭi ku tu swā hā: rgyas pa'i phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par gyur cig khams gsum srid gsum mos pa rnam bzhi wa shaṃ ku ru swā hā: dbang gi phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par gyur cig: gnod byed dug lnga dug gsum las byung ba'i log par lha ba tham cad ma ra ya pā ṭa swā hā: drag po'i phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med par lhun jes grub par gyur cig dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying gsum gsum brjod la kha bskangs nas gsol ba gdab pa 'i rim pa ni hoḥ dpal chen bla ma drag po rdo rje khro bo lod kyi lha tshogs mkhyen brtse nus pas bdag la

'amatshu dgo sa su gsol: bdag cag sgrub pa po'i mi mthun nyes pa'i phyogs rnams zhi ba dang : legs tshogs yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang: khyad par du nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad zla ba yar tshes ltar rgyas nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa dus da lta nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gadza 05: zhes bskul mchod bstod bska tshogs bya gsol btab dbang bzhi blang ba yis grub pa brgyad la 'byor ba dang nyams rtogs yon tan go 'phel 'gyur sa ma wā bcu gcig sgrub phur bskyed bzlas na yin ma hā shu n+yaḥ tas stong pa ra sbyangs stongapa'ingang lasadapal chen rol ba'i sgrub phur rnams bla ma drag po'i sku rngams brjed 'jigs su rung ba smug nag bzod par dka' ba g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse lnga nam mkhar phyar zhing g.yon ri rab kyi phur ba 'dril ba: sku stod mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang mgo phreng khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba: smad dbal phur zur gsum mgar gyi so mal nas phyung ba lta bur dmar zang nge ba me yi tsha tsha 'dza ba: gdug pa dam sri'i snying la gzir zhing bar chad byed pa'i dam sri rnams rdul du brlag

par byed pa: ye shes me rlung 'tshubs ma'i sang du snang stong sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i lha ru bskyed do: hū lha mchog rdo rje srin po yi: dpral bar oṃ las 'od 'phros pasaḥ rgyalakun sku yi byin rlabs bstim: 'gyur ba med par rgyas gdab po dbang chen rol ba'i rdo rje yi: rngam 'khyil ā las 'od 'phros pas: rgyal kun gsung gi byin rlabs bstim 'gag pa med pa'i nus mthu thob: spros bral ye shes rdo rje yi: dran 'dus (ཿlas 'od 'phros pas: rgyal kun thugs kyi byin rlabs bstim: 'khrul ba med pa'i dbang rgyasagadab sa /rdoswā eḥrwa hūṃḥlīḥshrī ṭ+wāṃ two cha ā hūṃ badz+ra ye shes spyan drangs dbab bstim bskyar kun bzang mchod 'bul bstod pa bya bzlas pa sngags kyas 'khrul 'khor ni bdag nyid rtsa ba'i lha phyogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can dpag tu med pa 'phros: mdun bskyed sgrub phur ye shes lha ru gsal ba rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul dbang byinadangos grub ma lus pa thams cad dang: nus mthu stobs kyi yon tan gzhan snang zil gnon gyi che ba gdug pa 'dul ba'i drag sngags dam sri 'joms ba'i nus rtsal: che ba'i

btsa/: yon tan ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad bdag nyid sgrub pa po la stsol bar dmigs la: masahūṃ badz+ra gu ru khro bo lod sarba bisnan gī li ki la ya hūṃ phaṭa: brgya stong la sogs ca 'grub bskyar 'od zhu byin rlabs ra la bstim gnad des bar chad g.yul ngo zhi daro sa grub rnam gnyis thob pa ra 'gyur sa ma yu bcu gnyis bdud rtsi'i sman mchod ni snyen yisahūṃ mtshan ldan bhan+ta yangs pa'i nang: mu tig dkar po dri bral dang: tsan dan smug po rma med bcudaḥ dri chen rnam par snang mdzad dang: mo sa chen po rin chen 'byung pad+ma mtshal chen snang mtha' yas: dri chu las rdzogs don yod grub kun+dha'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems: mi seng rta glang khyi yi sha: yum chen lnga yi rang bzhin no: dngos kun bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can:thams cad byang chub sems kyi sprin: rgyud lngas bsdus pa'i 'gro ba 'dren: dug lnga ye shes lnga klong sbyor: mnyam gnas mnyam nyid rol ba'i sman rdo rje lha mo'i rtse gar bcas:sbo byu rtse spod brnga thabs kyis: a mṛ ta yi bcud blangs rte: zegs ma mkha' khyab zhing la spo:yoya tīsarba pa3 a mṛ ta hūṃ hri 'i oṃ hūṃ gdod nas yi sangs rgyas pa kun du bzang:

kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang: ma chags dri bral snang ba mtha' yas la: sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol:ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha ram̐ kha tīX rje gas chen ston pa dga' rab rdo rje dang: klong chen sgo 'byed rig 'dzin bṛ seng: snying thig mdzod 'dzin bī ma mi dra la: sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a dṛ takha ram̐ kha tīḥ 'dzam gling mjes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang: bud+dhā gu h+ya paṇa chen nyi shu lnga grub ba'i dbang phyug hūṃ chen ka ra laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grubastsol: ma hā pañca a dṛ ta kha ram̐ kha tīX sngags kyi dbang phyug ku ku rā dza dang: ro langs bde ba brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang: o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng la: sman mchoda'abul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha ram̐ kha tīḥ bstan pa'i gzhi ma khri sgong lde'u btsan: dgyes bskyed mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal da : be+e ro tsa na chosakyi lhun po la: sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a dṛ ta kha ram̐ kha hrīḥ dpal chen bka' bab snying gi bu dgu dang: bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin ska cog

badz+ra nam mkha'i snying: chos kyi spyan ldan khye'u chung lo tsa la: sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a dṛ ta kha ram̐ kha tweḥ lo paṇa rje 'bangs rig 'dzin brgya rtsa dang: bstan pa'i rgud gso gter ston rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'gro ba'i dpal mgon skyes chen thams cad la sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol:ma hā pañca a dṛ ta kha ram̐ kha hiḥ lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje khro bo lod: rigs kyi bdag po rak+ka dbu 'bum da : dgyes bskyed phag mo bye kri mu kha la sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha ram̐ kha tīḥ lasamadzad dpa' bo thod phreng sde lnga dang: dgyes bskyed phag mo rigs lnga dga' bzhi'i mdzod: sprul ba'i pho nya nyi rdul grangs mnyam la: sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a dṛ ta kha ram̐ kha tweX tshadamed rnam bzhi'i rang bzhin dpa' bo bzhi: bde stong gar sgyur dpa' mo mched bzhi dang: rigs bzhi'i gar 'dzin ging chen sde bzhi la : sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hwa pañca a dṛ ta kha ram̐ kha hiḥ bdud bzhi rtsad gcod rgyal

chen sde bzhi dang: bka' nyan ra pho mo bsam mi khyab ma rung gdon 'dul sgog bdag sde lnga la sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha re khatwe dur khrod brgyad dang g.ya' gangs yangs le re da: stag tshang seng ge bsam 'grub ke'u tshang sogs: sgrub gnas gnyan po'i srung ma thams cad la: sman mchod 'bul lo mthudabang dngos grub stsal: ma hā pañca a dṛ ta kha ram̐ kha hiX khoḥ ste yi dam chig rdo rje pad mo la: rdo rje spyan gyi gsang bar hūṃḥsgom ste thab shes mtheb srin rtse sbyar nyi zla'i bcud:oṃ uhūṃ gi rnam par wal gyis drangs: rdo rje lce yis nyams su myong ba'i mthus : bder gshegs rgyal ba'i dgongs don mngo na gyur zhing: byang chub sems thob rdo rje'i btsan saṭ+wāṃX:saX 'dul 'gro ba'i phan bde spel nus shog rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya sirnyi tshoḥ wāk+ka sirnyi u tsat+ta sirnyi hūṃḥ sarba sirnyi hrī: bdud rtsa gnas gsum la reg cing nyams su myong bas dngos grub

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dpal chen rdo rje khro lod kyiḥ / sgrub thig le'i rgya can las: sngags bdag e ka dza ṭa'i gsol mchod bstan dgra'i srog 'dren zhes bya ba bzhugs so: rwa(: na mo gu ru parnya ka ra ye man2chen ma 'ongasalas ldan pho mo yis sgrub pa lhur len byed pa 'i tshe bdud kyis rgol ba g.yo srad pas bstan srungasrog gi gta' ru zungs sa ma yā las gzhung sngon nas song ba'i rjes sngags bdag gsol mchod bya ba la thugs mthun dam rdzas sna tshogs bsags bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs rjes su: nyu jed na/na thamab brda05 ba chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag mkha' spyod gling: o rgyan yul dang dur khrod brgyad: grub gnas gtsug lag chos 'khor gling: gar bzhugs dag pa'i pho brang nas e ka dza ṭī gtso 'khor bcas: dad pas bskul lo gnas 'dir byon dam tshig sgrub rdzas rten la bzhugs kun bzang bstan pa srung phyag 'tshal : legs nyes rdzi bur mnga' gsol lo gdung dbyangs rtse gcig dad pas bstod: khyod kyi thugs dang mthun pa'i rdzas: phyi mchod longs spod spin ltar gtibs: nang mchod stsa tshogs gangs lngar brjid: gsang

chags rigs dkar bshos dmar gtor dza gad chang:'dod yon nam mkha'i khyon mnyam pas:e ka dza ṭī gsol mchod bskangs:dkar mo spyan gcig gsol mchod bskangs ser mo khro gtum gsol mchod bskangs:dmar mo dbang sdud gsol mchod bskangs:ljang nag dbugs len gsol mchod bskangs:sngon mo kha hal gsol mchod bskangs:bran mo bcu bzhi gsol mchod bskangs:ma mo bcu gnyis gsol mchod bskangs g.yog mo lnga bcu gsol mchod bskangs:yang g.yog 'bum khri gsol mchod bskangs:srid pa'i ma mo gsol mchod bskangs:'khor 'bangs bran g.yog gsol mchod bska sa:de ltar bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis:nad kha chod la rims kha bsgyur khram kha gtor la dgra bdud rlog sgrub pa po la 'tsho ba sbyor lta ba nor na chos skur bshags sgom pa g.yang na rig pas bcos:spyod pa nor na tshogs kyis bskangs:a ti

'tshan sgom sgrub rnal 'byor la: kun bzang dgongs pa cal phog sprod: bka' 'das dam tshig med pa la: zab gsang ma spel dam du srungs: bya btang rnal 'byor pho mo rdoms: 'od skur grol ba'i phrin las mdzod: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: grang bsogs gser skyems gtsang sar gshegs 'dod don dmigs bsa' phrin las te gegs med yid bzhan bcol ba na sngags kyi srung mas dam khas so sa ma rwa i ma rgyal kun gsang jogasasaṃ bha was bstan 'gror phan bsam thugs bskyed kyas: shin du ya zab bcud 'dus skor 'aprog ban khye'u chung go tsār gtams spel ba'i dus min brdar bstims la mdo khams bkra shis rjo gnas su gter rgyas thob gsu sa de bzhin du klu bdud btsan la gnyer byang gtad ma 'o sa snyags ma'i dus skabs su spru' nus lan rdo rje yis rted nas bstan 'gro'i bde legs spel don kun 'grub pa ra the tshom medaḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya sngagasabadag spug naga'ad 'phros ma'i gsol mtshadabastan dgra'i srog 'dren rjogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu h+ya ma rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas brkod pa'o brda thimaḥsnyi ces pa snga mor phab pa'i sngags bdag ma'i gsol mchod zhig yod pa sa: chos bdag nas bskul kya snyom las su shor ba phyis su srung ma gnyis gzhan
dang mthun pa'i 'dzum nyams zla zhal mi bstan pa sa mod la nusaldan pasabarda mdzod las dag par phab pa make lam

pa(: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dpal chen rdo rje khro lod kyi: hūṃ sgrub thig le'i rgya can las:bstod pa dad mos bskyed pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so: bsgo/: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye 5411rgyu/ rgyal kun 'dus zhal rdo rje gshog rgod sa ma 'ongs las ldan skal bzas pho mo yi bgo skal bdag gi sgrub pa zab mo ni hūṃsgrub thag le'i rgya can zhes bya bstan sa ma yu de ya lha tshogs yon tan dran pa yas bstod pa dad mos bskyed pa 'a lcags kyu ni mos gus gdung ba drag pos skabs skabs brngo da dpal gyi ri nas byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur sa ma yu de ya spos bsregs rol mo sna tshogs snyir snyan pa' dbyangs dang bcas te 'ad skad do / hrī:nub phyogs bde chen dbang gi pho brang du:ye sangs rgyas pa snang ba mtha' yas sku:chags bral 'dus ma byas pa ye shes gar:chos dbyings rol ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:ma 'gag ri bo da la'i pho brang du:brtse chen thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa byams dang snying rje'i gter chen spran ras gzigs mnga' mdzad thugs rje'i bdag la phyag 'tshal bstod mi shigs lcang lo can gyi pho brang du:thugs mchog mi g.yo bde gshegs

rigs kyi gdung:srid gsum zil gnon che btsan 'gran zla bral:phyag na rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:rnam dag lhun grub ri bo rtse lnga na rgyal kun sku yi gsang rdzogs 'gro ba'i mgon:mkhyen brtse gter chen 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs:sgrib bral smra ba'i nyi mar phyag 'tshal bstod0brjod 'das zhing khams bsam mi khyab pa dza gang 'dul ston 'khor thabs kyis rol rtsed bsgyur:dug gsum 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo stong mdzad pa:rnam 'phrul mtha' yas klong la phyag 'tshal bstod dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin sna tshogs thugs rje'i zlos gar chu zla bzhin bstan dang 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig thugs rje can:in+t+ra bho dhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:mdangs ldan dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho gling du:ya mtshan rmad byung khye'u chung ye shes sku:brtul zhugs rol ba'i mkha' 'gror chos 'khor bskor:mtsho skyes rdo rje de la phyag 'tshal bstod:bsod nams bsags pas zhing bas rab bskul te:smon lam ldan pa'i rgyal pos spyan drangs nas:3 rgyan rgyal srid thabs kyis skyong mdzad pa'i :rgyal po thor cog can la phyag 'tshal

bsgo/ bstod:dus su srid 'khor thabs kyis spang byas te:bka' skyong phug tu dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin:brtul zhugs thabs mang gang la gang 'dul bsgyur shirnyi rak+ṣi ta la phyag 'tshal bstod:bya skyib tshal dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i ljongs:ri rab zom dang lha klu'i gnas rnams su ston pa mang brten theg pa'i sgo rnams mkhyen:blo ldan mchog srid sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:a su ra yi brag phug chen po dza 'dul 'dzin mkhan po kun dga' la brten te bslab gsum mdzod 'dzin sangs rgyas gnyis par grags:shākya seng ge'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:las smon ldan pa za hor dge ba'i yul:dbang du sdud tshe phra men tshogs 'dus nas:mer bsregs chur bsgyur grub pa'i rtagasamatshan brnyes:smin grol zung 'jug pad+ma saṃ bhar bstod:lhun grub pad+ma brtsegs sogs mchod rten drung:be+e ro sgrub cing mkha' 'gror chos 'khor bskor:gdug pa'i tshogs rnams thabs kyis 'dul mdzad sku nyi ma 'od zer sku la phyag 'tshal bstod o ṭi ya na'i rgyal srid chos kyis bskyangs rmad byung grub pa'i rtags brtes 'gro khams sdud

'bum phrag tshom bu 'og min zhing la 'god: pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod bde byed brtsegs par zab rgya'i dngos grub brtes: phra men mu stegs tshar bcad dpa' skongs shing: gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me rab tu sbar: seng ge sgra sgrogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: rū lu tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'dren stangs bsgyur: bar chad bgegs tshogs rdo rje'i phyag rgyas btul: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: ma ra ti ga'i sgrub gnas chen po rtsardo rje'i tshe sgrub tshe dpag med dngos phyon: skye 'chi bral ba ye shes 'od dbang bskur: 'chi med rig 'dzin mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: be dkar sdigs par sprul nas skabs tshol tshe: shin du khros pa'idapa' bo skur bzhengs nas: ngan gtong sdigs pa'i snying khrag lhud mdzad pa'i rab 'jigs he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: chags med chags bral bde ba'i brtul zhugs kyis rngam pa'i dur khrod rtsub 'gyur chen po nas: zab mo'i gter dang bstan pa'i so nam bsgrub: gtum drag rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzhan yang mi mjed 'jig

badz+ra rten bye brag brgyar: gang la gang 'dul rnam sprul mtha' yas pa'i: sbyor sgrol smin grol chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i: pad 'byung bye phrag brgya la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku ni mi g.yo bde chen ye shes ngang : gsung ni mi 'gag rang byung ye shes gdangs: thugs ni mi zhabrul bsam brjod 'dzin pa bral: mtshungs bral pad+ma nyid la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūṃ trī: 'di nas lho nub rak+ka srin yul gyi: zhing gi g.yang gzhi thod pa'i sku mkhar nas: rngams brjid pa d+ma drag po khro ba'i sku: rab 'jigs he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: che mi'i nyams rdzogs khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams: rdo rje'i sdang mig phyogs bcu kun tu bsgrad: drag po'i hūṃ sgras sa gsum shig shig g.yo: rngams pa'i skan sgra sgrogs la phyag 'a la bstod: smar smin mi yis srid gsum bag chags bsregs: khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i pho brang dbu la brgyan: srid zhi mnyam brdal dbu sgra wa mig 'khyil: dar sna'i cod pan 'phur la phyag 'tshal bstod gdug pa 'dul phyir khro gnyer chu rlabs 'khrigs tshad med thugs rje'i mche gtsigs am btsigs bsdams: thal tshom khrag thig khag

gi zo ris bkra: 'bar ba'i gar dgu rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag g.yas gnam rdo rje lcags rtse dgu phyar yar rtse 'bar ba'i theg pa rim dgu spel mar rtse dgu yis sa dgu'i 'gro ba 'dul: che ba'i stobs rdzogs bdud 'dul dpal la bstod: g.yon pas lcags nag phur pa sa la gzir: rtse mo rgya mdud 'chang zung gnas rnams su: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i 'du 'phro 'khrigs: dpal gyas gdon bgegs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod sngags kyi phod chen be+eḍūr ris su bkra: gsang gos dkar po 'dung ma dmar mo klubs: sde gsum mdzod 'dzin chos gos dmar po spras: kun rtog dbyings sgrol thod phreng spras la bstod: zhe sdang rtsad gcod stag gi sham thabs can: ye shes drug rdzogs rūs pa'i rgyan drug spras rgyal po rol ba'i cha lugs sog lho mdzes: khre rgyal rngams pa'i 'byings thabs mdzad la bstod dgyes bskyed phag mo za byed rngams pa'i sku mgo dgu rngams pa'i dam sri sde dgu 'dul: sder tshogs bsgrad pas bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon: rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: ma rig mun sel ye shes

btsa/ me lnga 'bar:dug lnga rnam dag 'ja' 'od gur khang 'khrigs las mdzad pho nya phag khyung sdigs seng 'phro:phrin las bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal bstod:'gro 'dul dus gsum sangs rgyas yin pa'i rtags:dbu la pad 'byung rak+ka thod phreng bzhugs:rgya bod lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho rdzogs:lha mchog thugs rje'i gter la phyag 'tshal bstod:zhi ba'i las mjad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal dga' ba'i ra gzugs badz+ra dpa' mo yum:snying rje'i rang gdangs las byed ging ga ra:bde gshegs rigs kyi klong la phyag 'tshal bstod:rgyas ba'i las mdzad rin chen dpa' bo dang:mchog dga'i rang bzhin rat+na dpa' mo yum byams pa'i gdangs snang las byed ging ga ra:yon tan 'dus pa'i gter la phyag 'tshal bstod:dab gi las mdzad pad+ma dpa' bo dang:khyad dga'i rang bzhin chags bral dpa' mo yum:dga' ba'i rang gzugs las byed ging ga ra:chags bral pad+ma 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod:drag po'i las mdzad las rab dpa' bo dang:lan dga'i bdag nyid garma dpa' mo yum:btang snyoms rang gdangs las

byed ging ga ra rngams brdzid drag rtsal klong la phyag 'tshal bstod:rgyal 'gong gshed du lcags sdigs mgo dgu pa klu gnyan 'dul mdzad me khyung lcags sder bsgrad dam sri 'joms mdzad lce spyang mgo dgu sogs :pho nya phra men tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:gsang sngags rgyud kyi bdag po legs ldan nag:ldog med a ti'i gnyer 'dzin spyan gcig ma:gzes po'i sgog 'dren dbang sdud dme rū rtse:sgrub la snying nye rang byung rgyal mor bstod:rgyal bka' gnyan zhing bstan pa'i so kha srung:legs nyes stang 'dzin dam tshigs rjes gcod cing:zab gsang gter kyi bcud la lhag par gdung:pho nya yang 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod:che ba'i yon tan pad+ma sgod phreng rtsal mthu stobs bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo lod:yid la dran zhing rtse gcig gsol btab mthus:bskal ba'i g.yo 'khrug ru 'dzing zhi ba dang:'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod:lha min dam sri'i dpung tshogs tshar gcod cing:rgol ba ngan pa mu stegs bstan pa bsnubs:smon log dam sri'i mtha' dmag drung nas 'byin:rgyal bstan nub med yangs pa'i khams su

badz+ra sbor: rgyal khams gtsen pa'i bdud spyang ha la dang: sgrub pa'i sgo gtor smon log dam sri'i rigs: chos mdzad tshe chos 'phrog pa'i dam log sde: ming tsam med par rdul du brlag par mdzod: chos mdzad yongs kyi tshe dpal lang tsho dar: zab gsang mdzod 'chaja kun gyi gcug na sbud: mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bstan pa'i mnga' 'og tu: 'bum phrag 'du ba rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: snang grags rig gsum bla ma drag po yi la sngags chos sku'i rol bar rtsal rdzo gas te gzhi lam 'bras gsum byang chub bde ba'i klong: 'og min me ri 'bar bar sangs rgyas mdzod: de ma thob pa'i skye dang tshe rabs kun: la mchog thugs kyi thig le dang 'grogs nas: rgol byed bstan pa'i gnod 'che rmang nas bsgyur: gu ru pad+ma'i mdzad phrin mthar phyin re ga: de ltar bstod pa mos gus gdu dbya sa kyi brngo da pas don 'grub phyi na bar chad sel nyams rtogs yon tan yar ro zla ltar 'phel don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa ra ze tshom med sa ma yā
